Job Description:

Lead Test Engineer, Sr Principal:

Join GDIT’s mission‑driven team supporting the Department of Defense as we help unify the Air Force’s cyber defense to outpace threats with shared insight, faster decisions, and stronger mission protection.


MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:


  • This Lead Test Engineering role governs the Enterprise Test Framework and independent verification activities across all pipelines and platforms.
  • The Test Engineer, in conjunction with the Government, develops, governs, and enforces an overarching Enterprise Test Framework to standardize testing methodologies and quality assurance blueprints across all Task Order repositories, defining and mandating a unified, modern software testing approach (e.g., BDD or TDD) that serves as the authoritative standard for all execution teams.
  • The role conducts independent, multi-faceted penetration tests on platform engineering and applications, including emulation of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • It also conducts independent reviews of all source code utilizing government-furnished tools (e.g., Fortify) for deep codebase analysis before staging deployment (Static Application Security Testing).
  • The engineer provides formal "Go/No-Go" release recommendations to the PMO based on objective test results.
  • Technical acumen required: Deep knowledge of BDD/TDD testing methodologies, SAST/DAST tooling (Fortify, Syft, Grype), penetration testing/adversary emulation, and CI/CD pipeline auditing.
  • Must understand testing security boundaries, data flows, and firewalls between Dev/Test networks, the System Integration Lab (SIL), and operational production networks to prevent data spillage (Cross-Domain Validation), and auditing automated security gates and scans within the CI/CD pipeline to ensure they are properly configured and effectively identifying vulnerabilities (Pipeline Auditing).
  • Daily SCIF access supports hands-on penetration testing and classified test result evaluation.
  • This role directly delivers the win theme of enforced test standards and RMF/ICAM/Zero Trust compliance through independent security testing and pipeline auditing before releases reach production.

Priority Technical Skill Sets

  • Expert knowledge of BDD/TDD testing frameworks, enterprise test governance, and automated test integration.
  • Skilled in independent security testing: penetration testing, adversary emulation, cross‑domain validation, pipeline auditing.
  • Experience facilitating UAT in staging environments and delivering formal Go/No-Go recommendations.
  • Ability to test and validate hybrid cloud architectures, Kubernetes deployments, and container security.
  • Strong experience using government-furnished tools such as Fortify, Grype, Syft, ClamAV, etc.

QUALIFICATIONS - WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and 10–12 years software/system test engineering; 5+ years independent IV&V; 5+ years cybersecurity testing (SAST, DAST, pen testing); 3+ years CI/CD pipeline integration.

• Security Clearance Level: Top Secret with SCI eligibility

• Certification: CISSP or Certified Test and Evaluation Professional (CTEP)

• Location: San Antonio, TX

• US citizenship required

The Training & Development Specialist works within the People & Culture (P&C) department in coordination and collaboration with agency partners in development, implementation, and facilitation of live and online trainings and materials related to agency needs and objectives. The Training & Development Specialist will assist with onboarding new staff, train, and support staff in using the Learning Management System (LMS) and facilitate training which supports a wide range of Cascadia staff. They will provide opportunities for employees to maintain and improve performance as well as grow in their job functions.
This position includes a unique focus on training related to OCHIN Epic, our health records system. The duties below reflect the wider range of what our team of trainers do, and could become part of this role in the future in addition to the focus on OCHIN Epic. We will be most excited to hear from candidates with experience in OCHIN Epic or other complex clinical applications, especially in integrated healthcare settings.

This position must understand, appreciate, and respect the diversity and cultural differences within our Cascadia community. As such, it is expected that this position promotes integrated care, our vision of trauma-informed and person-first approaches, and helps create a work environment of inclusion, safety, and acceptance.

Our ideal candidate will be:

· Highly comfortable navigating complex technology systems such as OCHIN Epic, and motivated to stay up to date on frequent changes within these systems.

· Organized, detail oriented, and a strong communicator.

· Willing and able to patiently support staff with a wide range of comfort and experience with technology.

· Excited to provide in person training and “elbow support” at a variety of Cascadia sites across the Portland Metro area to boost staff skills and confidence in performing job duties in complicated tech systems.

· Comfortable facilitating live trainings, and creating and maintaining self-paced training materials including screen recordings.

· Eager to track down answers and solutions presented by our Cascadia community of staff!

Essential Duties

This position description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, or working conditions associated with the position. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

Live Training Facilitation:

• Facilitate in-person and virtual orientation training for new hires, including providing foundational training on technology systems in use at Cascadia.

• Develop and provide training designed to support staff knowledge and skills including Documentation Golden Thread, EHR Documentation, Motivational Interviewing (MI), crisis communication and de-escalation (ProACT), management, leadership, equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI), safety, and more. This may include facilitating independently for up to 8 hours (all day), either in person or virtually.

• Develop and facilitate training for new employees, students, and current employees in accordance with regulating requirements and agency needs for quality improvement. Maintain knowledge of core required trainings to provide facilitation support and backup for teammates as needed, which may include full or multi-day training such as ProACT.

• Deliver in-person or virtual training to employees across the agency and in the community. Provide Continuing Education (CE) approved training where applicable.

Technology Systems & Staff Support

• Assist in Learning Management System (LMS) administration including creation and maintenance of user accounts, managing new and existing modules, creating and maintaining training plans and auto-enrollments, recording attendance, running reports, and more.

• Train staff in technological systems including LMS, Electronic Health Records (EHR) Systems, Human Resource Information System (HRIS), and meeting and collaboration software such as Microsoft Teams. Provide basic technical support in navigation of these systems in person as well as via phone, virtual calls, and emails.

• Provide technical support and backup for colleagues during virtual training to ensure all attendees are able to effectively attend and engage with training content.

• Aid and support to staff at all levels of the agency.

Agency Collaboration, Coordination, & Support:

• Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing with all levels of staff and leadership.

• In coordination with team leadership, assess agency training needs and work to develop and implement effective instructional material and live training. Support overall training needs as directed by leadership.

• Participate in workgroups and projects as determined in collaboration with leadership. Represent training team and P&C department interests and perspectives in a positive and professional manner.

• Research and vet appropriate external training resources, as directed by leadership.

• Provide input on relevant documentation and procedural requirements related to training.

Regulatory & Compliance:

• Comply with laws, regulations, policies, and procedures under which the program and company operates.

• Assist in crisis situations as appropriate; follow protocols and procedures in coordination with the treatment team.

• Respect and honor client rights and responsibilities and demonstrate professional boundaries and ethics.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation that ensures compliance with all agency policies and procedures and local, state, and federal regulations, and billing requirements.

• Understand safety regulations and evacuation procedures; participate in regular safety drills in compliance with program policies and procedures.

• Complete assigned employee training in compliance with program and company requirements.

• Provide guidance, support, and training to other staff in alignment with company mission and values.

• Participate in all scheduled staff meetings, supervision sessions, and other departmental and company meetings.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education:

Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred.

Experience:

Required: Two years of experience providing training or teaching skills.

Preferred: Virtual facilitation experience strongly preferred; experience in healthcare/behavioral health.

Specialized Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

Effective communication and active listening skills.

Effective interpersonal and customer service skills.

Ability to work proactively and effectively in a team and independently.

Operate computer hardware and software at a level needed to effectively perform job functions.

Other:

Possess a valid driver’s license, minimum of one year driving history, ability to pass Driver Motor Vehicle (DMV) check and complete the Cascadia online Defensive Driving course.

OR

Must have the ability to travel to multiple locations throughout the Portland Metro area.

All client-facing positions must have the ability to perform Basic Life Support (BLS) and properly use AED equipment. BLS certification training will be provided within the first 60 days of hire. Certification must remain current.

Core Competencies

Teamwork:

Contribute to a culture that promotes cooperation, respectful communication, and mutual trust. Collaborate across interdisciplinary teams by working together and sharing ideas, skills, and knowledge to achieve common goals. Foster environment that fuels creativity by combining differing perspectives and experiences to generate innovative solutions.

Ethics, Values, & Integrity:

Maintain a respectful, diverse, and inclusive work environment where decisions are transparent and objective. Hold yourself and Cascadia Health accountable for their actions while contributing to a positive organizational culture.

Demonstrate ethical behavior, adherence to professional codes of conduct, and promoting ethical standards.

Emotional Intelligence:

Understand and manage one’s own emotions and biases while respecting diverse emotional expressions and communication styles of others. This includes recognizing the varied ways emotions can influence thoughts and behaviors, and adapting interactions to enhance interpersonal effectiveness and self-awareness.

Safety:

Actively contribute to the safety and welfare of the Cascadia community through prevention, education, and awareness. Participate in and promote a work environment that identifies and prevents workplace safety issues.

Working Conditions

Environmental:

Work is performed in one or more of the following: clinical office, acute care settings and community setting including client residences, correctional facilities, shelters, hospitals, public places and other social service sites. Meal periods and breaks are subject to interruption. Universal Precautions and remaining alert to the environment are critical to address the potential for violent behavior, exposure to disease, biohazards, noise, and contaminants.

Mental Demands:

The work assigned is diverse and involves addressing new and unusual circumstances. The work regularly involves a degree of unpredictability and disruption of planned tasks requiring a flexible time management approach. In addition, this position requires exercising sound judgment.

title: Travel and Expense Analyst
description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

JOB SUMMARY

  • The Travel and Expense Analyst reports into the Executive Director, Global Procurement and supports TriNet's
  • Travel, Corporate Card (P Card), and Expense (T&E) programs by performing day- to-day operational activities,
  • monitoring transactions for compliance and assisting with reporting and issue resolution. This role focuses on
  • execution, analysis and support rather than enterprise-wide ownership.
  • The analyst partners closely with the Senior Travel and Expense Analyst, Procurement teams and internal
  • stakeholders to ensure accurate processing, adherence to policy and a positive colleague experience across all
  • supported regions. This position contributes to continuous improvement efforts and supports system
  • enhancements under the guidance of more senior analysts and managers.

Essential Duties:

  • Support the daily operations of TriNet’s Travel, P Card, and Expense programs in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Review and audit expense reports and P Card transactions for accuracy, policy compliance, and proper documentation.
  • Assist with P Card administration activities, including cardholder setup, maintenance, transaction monitoring, and issue tracking.
  • Support travel management processes, including assisting with vendor inquiries, booking issues, and service requests.
  • Identify and document common issues, trends, and compliance concerns, escalating more complex matters to senior team members as appropriate.
  • Assist with resolving user questions related to T&E tools, policies, and processes.
  • Support Oracle Expense system activities, including basic troubleshooting, testing, and user support, escalating complex system issues to senior analysts or IT partners.
  • Prepare standard reports and assist with ad hoc analysis related to spend, compliance, and transaction activity.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, documentation updates, and operational enhancements.
  • Assist with developing and maintaining user guides, training materials, and communications related to T&E and P Card programs.
  • Collaborate with Finance, HR, Procurement, and other internal partners to support consistent application of policies and procedures.

Required for All Jobs

  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required

Work Experience

  • Typically 2+ years Experience with travel and expense processing, accounts payable or related financial operations required
  • Experience supporting corporate card program management preferred
  • Experience working with Global and cross functional teams preferred
  • Experience with Oracle Expense preferred
  • Understanding of General Ledger accounting preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Working knowledge of travel and expense processes, policies, and best practices.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify errors, discrepancies, and compliance issues.
  • Analytical skills to review transaction data and summarize findings.
  • Ability to follow established procedures and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Proficiency with Excel and standard financial reporting tools.
  • Willingness to learn systems, policies, and processes in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment

  • Work in a clean, pleasant, and comfortable office work setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • This position is 100% in office.

Please Note: TriNet reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity.

title: Lead IT Security Engineer
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay and Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
  • Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
  • Pension / Retirement benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
  • DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The impact you will have in this role:

Being a member of the IT Cybersecurity & Platform Strategy team, the Cloud and Compliance Engineering Operations Specialist will provide day-to-day operational support for DTCC's cloud security and compliance programs across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The role is responsible for monitoring security controls, supporting compliance activities, coordinating remediation efforts, managing cloud security tooling, and assisting platform teams in maintaining secure and compliant cloud environments.

Your Primary Responsibilities:

  • Operate and support cloud security platforms and services across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including CSPM, CNAPP, vulnerability management, compliance monitoring, and identity security solutions.
  • Investigate, analyze, and assist with remediation of cloud security findings, vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance gaps in partnership with application and infrastructure teams.
  • Implement and maintain cloud security controls, baselines, monitoring capabilities, and security automation solutions.
  • Develop and enhance scripts, workflows, and automation to improve operational efficiency, security coverage, and response times.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles to support cloud security operations.
  • Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities related to cloud security services.

NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above.

Qualifications:

title: Internal Audit Associate
description:
Excited to grow your career?

BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.

About the job:

BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.


BBVA Internal Audit is a global function with more than 670 professionals across 14 countries playing a critical role in the Group's governance and risk management. In the United States, the Internal Audit team operates as part of this global function, working collaboratively within the broader international network to ensure consistency, insight, and impact.


As the third line of defense, Internal Audit provides independent assurance and advisory services, acting as a strategic partner to the business by delivering risk-based insights that support decision-making and strengthen the control environment. Beyond its assurance role, Internal Audit acts as a strategic partner, providing independent, risk-based insights that support decision-making and strengthen the control environment and overall performance.


In addition, we are at the forefront of transforming the audit function, driving the use of advanced data analytics and integrating artificial intelligence solutions to anticipate risks and deliver greater value to the business.


Joining the USA BBVA Internal Audit team means becoming part of both a local team and a global community of professionals with extensive opportunities for learning, collaboration and career development.


ROLE OVERVIEW

As an Internal Audit Associate, you will be responsible for the monitoring and validation of audit issues, participate in the Internal Audit continuous monitoring / Risk Assessment process, support the development of the Internal Audit plan, and preparation of management reporting and preparation of supporting documentation for regulatory requests. The Associate is expected to independently manage assigned activities, exercise sound judgment within established Internal Audit methodology, and escalate significant matters appropriately.


You will gain in-depth knowledge of BBVA’s U.S. operations and risk profile, as well as the Internal Audit function, its methodology, governance framework, issue management processes, and reporting requirements.


Working closely with Internal Audit teams, business and control functions, and relevant stakeholders. The role provides broad exposure across the organization and contributes to the continuous improvement and effective operation of the Internal Audit function. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in internal audit, risk management, governance, or related disciplines, strong attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate multiple activities and stakeholders effectively.


PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Internal Audit Risk Assessment & Planning

  • Support the Internal Audit continuous monitoring and Risk Assessment process, including the collection, consolidation, analysis of relevant information and the documentation of risk assessment conclusions.
  • Analyze changes in business activities, risk profiles, emerging risks, regulatory developments, control environment and other relevant factors and assess their potential impact on Internal Audit priorities.
  • Support the development and periodic update of the Internal Audit Plan, including preparation of supporting analysis, documentation and management information.
  • Support the maintenance of the Internal Audit Universe, helping ensure that changes in business activities, organizational structure, products, processes, systems, emerging risks and regulatory developments are appropriately reflected.

Open Action Monitoring and Internal Audit Issue Validation

  • Monitor Internal Audit open actions and remediation commitments, including aging and overdue actions, extensions and changes to target completion dates. Coordinate follow-up with responsible stakeholders and support the timely escalation of overdue, delayed or higher-risk actions.
  • Prepare periodic reporting on the status of Internal Audit findings and open actions for Internal Audit management and relevant governance bodies.
  • Support the independent validation of Internal Audit issues and remediation actions by reviewing management-provided evidence, assessing whether actions have been appropriately implemented and documenting validation conclusions in accordance with Internal Audit methodology.

Regulatory Examinations

  • Support Internal Audit activities related to Federal Reserve Board (FRB) and other regulatory examinations, including coordinating regulatory information requests and requirements.
  • Coordinate the preparation, review and submission of Internal Audit documentation requested by regulators, helping ensure responses are timely, complete, accurate and appropriately supported.

Internal Audit Reporting

  • Support the preparation of materials for Internal Audit management and relevant governance committees, ensuring information is accurate, consistent, well documented and delivered within established timelines.
  • Leverage data analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to analyze risk information, identify trends and anomalies, improve reporting, and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Internal Audit activities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Academic Background and Certifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required; preferred fields include Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or other related fields.
  • Professional certifications or progress toward relevant certifications (e.g., CIA, CISA, FRM, CAMS, CPA, or other relevant credentials) are highly valued as they demonstrate both relevant knowledge and a strong commitment to professional development.

Professional Experience

You already have professional experience in Internal Audit, External Audit or consulting/advisory firms and you are looking for a role that will accelerate your development and broaden your perspective of Internal Audit and banking.

  • Experience: Candidates should have a minimum of 3-4 years of relevant experience in internal audit, external audit, risk advisory, or consulting, preferably within financial services. Experience in risk assessment, issue management, regulatory examinations, or management reporting is preferred.
  • Experience working within a financial institution or at a consulting/advisory firm, particularly in issue management, risk assessment, or reporting activities, is preferred.
  • Experience supporting U.S. regulatory examinations (including FRB examinations) is strongly preferred. Experience coordinating regulatory requests, preparing supporting documentation, attending examination meetings, and tracking deliverables and commitments is highly valued.

Skills & Competences

  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and report-writing skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
  • Working knowledge of internal audit, risk management, governance, internal controls, and issue-management processes.
  • Understanding of the U.S. financial-services regulatory environment and relevant regulatory expectations. (FRB, NYDFS, SEC,..)
  • Proficiency with productivity and data-analysis tools; experience with Excel/Google Sheets, Power BI, SQL, or Python is a plus.
  • Advanced computer skills required, with preferred proficiency in the Google Workspace suite, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Slides.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job Description

The IoT Software Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable IoT data pipelines and platforms that support real-time and batch analytics across field operations. title: Curtain Wall Fabricator
description:
Title: Curtain Wall Fabricator

Location: Etobicoke, ON

Company: Triumph Group of Companies

Reports To: Marc Chevrier, Plant Supervisor

Role Overview

The Curtain Wall Fabricator is the backbone of the Commercial Window Wall and Curtain Wall department at our Primeline Windows and Doors plant in Etobicoke, stepping into a role that the current fabricator has run solo for years as he heads into retirement. You will read fabrication and shop drawings for curtain wall and window wall systems, then cut, drill, and assemble the work to precise measurements, operating with minimal day to day supervision and reporting to Plant Supervisor Marc Chevrier. The real skill here is not the cutting itself, it is understanding a drawing well enough to execute it correctly the first time and catching a measurement or interpretation error before it becomes a problem on the floor. You will also be a main point of contact between the shop floor and project managers, so being comfortable communicating across that wider group of stakeholders matters as much as the technical work. As the department grows beyond one person, there is room to help bring others up to speed and take on a more senior role within it.


What We Offer

  • Hourly wage of $30.00 to $35.00 (commensurate with experience)
  • Group benefits coverage
  • Full-time, non-union hourly position
  • A chance to step into a well-established department and help shape it as it grows
  • On-site role at our Primeline Windows and Doors plant in Etobicoke
  • A direct line to the Plant Supervisor, with real autonomy once ramped up
  • Opportunity to mentor and lead as the department adds headcount
  • A role with a diversified, multi division construction and infrastructure company

What You Bring to the Table

Technical Skills

  • 5 or more years of commercial fabrication experience, ideally specific to curtain wall or window wall systems
  • Strong ability to read and interpret fabrication or shop drawings accurately
  • Precise measurement, drilling, cutting, and assembly skills
  • Canadian commercial curtain wall experience specifically, not just general construction or fabrication
  • Stick building experience is an asset

Attributes

  • Comfortable operating independently with minimal day to day supervision
  • Catches a measurement or drawing interpretation error before it becomes a problem on the floor
  • Strong communicator, comfortable working with the plant supervisor and project managers
  • Leadership qualities, ready to mentor others as the department grows
  • Takes ownership of the work and is straightforward when something needs correcting

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Read and interpret fabrication and shop drawings for curtain wall and window wall systems
  • Cut, drill, and fabricate aluminum components to precise measurements
  • Execute stick building and related curtain wall fabrication methods as required
  • Operate independently with minimal day to day supervision
  • Catch and resolve measurement or drawing interpretation issues before they reach the next stage
  • Communicate regularly with the Plant Supervisor on production priorities and issues
  • Liaise with Project Managers on fabrication scope, timelines, and clarifications
  • Maintain consistent quality and accuracy across all fabrication work
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer as the department transitions from a single fabricator
  • Mentor and help train additional fabrication staff as the department grows


Company Overview: Triumph Group of Companies

Triumph Group of Companies is a diversified construction and infrastructure services organization supporting projects across multiple sectors. We provide specialized services in roofing, waterproofing, cladding, energy, restoration, and glazing, ensuring comprehensive care of building envelopes and infrastructure.

Our culture is built on safety, accountability, teamwork, and consistent standards across all divisions. We value people who take ownership, communicate directly, and help move work forward

title: Sr. Environmental Compliance Specialist
description:
Summary

Under general supervision, the Sr. Environmental Compliance Specialist performs routine investigations and inspections, ensuring compliance with Federal, State, and local environmental laws, ordinances, rules, and regulations.


Pay Range: $58,877.69 - $76,469.47 (Depending on qualifications and experience)

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Perform stormwater inspections of industrial and commercial facilities to verify compliance with Federal, State, and local environmental laws, ordinances, rules, and regulations such as TCEQ TPDES permits and Garland’s Stormwater Ordinance.
  • Conducts enforcement actions against regulated facilities, prepares documentation and affidavits, and represents the city in court cases and hearings when necessary.
  • Issue citations or suspend operations of regulated businesses based on failure to comply with ordinances.
  • Respond to on-call emergencies related to illicit discharges and hazardous materials spills.
  • Inspects, investigates, and eliminates illicit connections and discharges to Garland’s MS4 system and illicit discharges to watercourses within Garland.
  • Performs Dry and Wet Weather Screening activities to ascertain levels of environmental materials or contamination present.
  • Walks and kayaks miles of creeks and lake banks to conduct illicit discharge and illicit connection investigations and to inspect outfalls.
  • Responds to and investigates complaints related to stormwater violations and homeless encampments.
  • Interprets environmental laws and regulations for contractors, public and private officials, and the general public.
  • Participates in community outreach and professional educational events.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, including 30 semester hours in any combination of courses in the following fields: environmental science (preferred), biological sciences, microbiology, chemistry, physical sciences, environmental engineering, or related fields.
  • 3 years related experience.

Or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

Preferred Qualifications

Education/ Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental science (preferred), biological sciences, microbiology, chemistry, physical sciences, environmental engineering, or related fields. Additional coursework in communication skills is highly desirable.
  • Experience conducting inspections and investigations; federal, state, and local regulations governing environmental quality and stormwater compliance, and best management practices as determined by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Ability to apply policy and procedures in decision making.
  • Exhibits excellent and professional customer service skills.
  • Ability to communicate verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to communicate in all forms and formats.
  • Ability to solve problems.
  • Ability to perform established testing procedures for water sample analysis and use sampling and testing equipment.
  • Skill in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Licenses and Certifications

  • HAZWOPER 24 Certification.
  • Stormwater Qualified Person Certification.
  • Texas Registered Sanitarian.
  • Registered Environmental Health Specialist through the National Environmental Health Association.
  • Qualified Industrial Stormwater Manager.
  • Valid Class C Texas driver's license.

Physical Requirements / Work Environment

The incumbent works primarily in an outdoor environment and occasionally in a standard office setting indoors. Frequent exposure to noise, extreme weather conditions, unpleasant environmental conditions or hazards to include mechanical and/or electrical hazards, and hazardous physical substances, materials and fumes. The employee will be exposed to bloodborne pathogens such as human waste, needles, syringes, and drugs and drug paraphernalia. Physical tasks may include walking on uneven and unpaved surfaces, bending, stooping, kneeling, reaching, pushing, and pulling, obtaining samples, setting up equipment and the ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and objects weighing up to 100 pounds.

description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

About This Role

The Staff Electrical Engineer will lead the design, development, validation, and integration of electrical power systems for transport refrigeration units (TRUs) used in heavy-duty trucks, trailers, and commercial vehicle applications. This role requires deep expertise in automotive and heavy-truck electrical architectures, power distribution, Electrical safety, and integration of power electronics converters. The engineer will serve as a technical leader, driving system architecture decisions from concept through production while ensuring compliance with reliability, safety, regulatory, and customer requirements. The role supports Carrier’s transport refrigeration business.

Key Responsibilities

System Architecture & Design

  • Lead development of Transport refrigeration electrical system architectures.
  • Design low-voltage and high-voltage electrical power distribution systems.
  • Define electrical interfaces between:
    • Refrigeration unit
    • Battery systems
    • Alternators and charging systems
    • Inverters and converters
    • Controllers and telematics devices
  • Develop wiring harnesses, power distribution modules, and control panels.
  • Create electrical schematics, system block diagrams, and interface control documents.

Product Development

  • Lead electrical design activities through concept, prototype, validation, and launch.
  • Perform electrical load analysis, power budget calculations, and fault analysis.
  • Evaluate and select electrical components, sensors, relays, contactors, connectors, and protection devices.
  • Drive design-for-manufacturing and design-for-serviceability improvements.

Validation & Compliance

  • Develop and execute electrical validation plans.
  • Support EMC/EMI, environmental, durability, and reliability testing.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and regulations, including:
  • Investigate and resolve field quality issues using root cause analysis methodologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering
  • 8+ years of electrical engineering experience.
  • 5+ years designing automotive, commercial vehicle, or heavy-truck electrical systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with transport refrigeration systems, auxiliary power units, mobile HVAC systems, or electrified vehicle systems preferred.
  • 12V, 24V, and high-voltage DC electrical systems.
  • Battery technology and power management systems.
  • CAN communication networks.
  • Electrical protection strategies and fault management.
  • Wiring harness and connector system design.
  • EMC/EMI design and mitigation.
  • Electrical diagnostics and troubleshooting.

Pay Range

The annual salary for this position is between $96,000.00 - $192,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

Other Compensation

This position is entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

Benefits

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

  • Health Care Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives

  • Retirement Benefits

  • Time off and Leave: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation

Job Description:

GDIT is looking for a Logistics Analyst to join our OCONUS team. As a Logistics Analyst, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of 1st TSC MSS. You will play a crucial role in providing logistic support

Selected candidate will support a 60-hour work week with overtime after the first 48 hours and must be able to meet CENTCOM medical and deployment standards

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

As a Logistics Analyst at GDIT, you'll make a significant impact on the mission of the 1st TSC MSS by providing vital logistic support through the following:

  • Manage customer logistics requirements via analysis, organization, planning, and administration of provisioning, spares, maintenance, and/or repair activities.
  • Assist the G4 cell in developing, updating, and implementing local and theater policies and procedures for distribution operations.
  • Support the Theater Support Command GCSS-A Sustainment Cell Property Book Lead by monitoring theater priorities, maintaining material flow, and managing the Defense Reutilization and Marketing Office (DRMO) operations.
  • Maintain continuous liaison with staff directorates, contractors, commands, and coalition nation liaisons.
  • Attend staff meetings to provide estimates and analyses for situational awareness of combat and logistics operations.
  • Track and validate equipment loans, maintenance costs, and manage customer data requirements related to GCSS-A, ASL Management, Receipt Operations, and other logistics metrics.
  • Conduct weekly logistics research and present trend analyses using relevant logistics support websites.
  • Develop, analyze, and report trends to improve Requisition Wait Time (RWT) and double handling of materials.
  • Analyze proposed changes in logistics policies and business processes to recommend improvements for USARCENT and coalition partners.
  • Produce and disseminate Excess Management Metrics Report and Detailed Customer Wait Time (CWT)/ Requisition Wait Time (RWT) Metrics.
  • Provide logistics assistance, ensure proper closure of supply, and assist in processing Exchange Pricing requests.
  • Review and provide executive level analysis and recommendations for more efficient logistics operations.
  • Update and convert complex logistical data into PowerPoint presentations as required.
  • Assist with the development of logistical doctrines and TTPs, particularly for multinational logistics.
  • Prepare standard products such as talking points, briefs, memorandums, and FRAGOs as needed.
  • Support deliberate and crisis planning efforts, including the Military Decision-Making Process (MDMP).
  • Coordinate logistics operations with USCENTCOM, USARCENT, DLA, AMC, and other organizations.
  • Serve as a SME in logistics operations, contingency planning, and multinational logistics programs.
  • Generate and manage Form 1-3a in AGATRS, serve as the ACSA point of contact, and compile usage reports.
  • Maintain accurate and complete historical files for audits and inspections.
  • Provide financial analysis, advice, and projections on logistics activities.
  • Maintain a document library on SharePoint and assist in developing courses of action for managing equipment and materials.
  • Oversee the movement, distribution, and storage of materials.
  • Resolve transportation, logistics systems, import/export, and customer issues.
  • Maintain metrics, reports, process documentation, customer service logs, training, and safety records.
  • Coordinate logistical functions for the life cycle of items, including acquisition, distribution, delivery, recycling, and disposal.
  • Provide recommendations to improve efficiency and minimize costs from logistics activities.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED (Required):
Bring your supply chain and program management expertise along with a drive for innovation to GDIT. The Logistics Analyst must have:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 2 years’ experience. An additional 4 years of experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.
  • Minimum of an active Secret security clearance.
  • Ability to meet CENTCOM medical and deployment standards.
  • 2+ years of experience in logistics and supply chain management at a Brigade Level or higher.
  • 2+ years of experience in logistics and supply chain management within USCENTCOM AOR.
  • Possess clear understanding and comprehension of current and projected financial, logistical and support concepts at the Corps and Theater levels.
  • Possess a familiarity in retail and wholesale supply systems, functions, and policies at the strategic level.
  • Possess senior level (Brigade or Higher) knowledge and understanding of certain systems and how they tie in together for research: GFEBS, FCM, LIW, ASEIP, SAAS-MOD, GCSS-A.
  • Possess a strategic level understanding of the GCSS-A system and knowledge of SSF/GCSS-A activities, history, and system functions; data manipulation skills and Standard Query Language (SQL) writing abilities.
  • Skilled in MS Office automation to include SharePoint, and a clear understanding of Knowledge Management (KM) principles.
  • Possess a familiarity in retail and wholesale supply systems, functions, and policies at the strategic level.
  • Active US Passport.

O firmie Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, światowy lider w dziedzinie inteligentnych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, angażuje się w tworzenie innowacji, które zapewniają komfort, bezpieczeństwo i zrównoważony rozwój. Dzięki nowoczesnym rozwiązaniom w zakresie kontroli temperatury, jakości powietrza oraz transportu poprawiamy jakość życia, wspieramy kluczowe sektory gospodarki oraz zapewniamy bezpieczny transport żywności, leków ratujących życie i wielu innych produktów. Od momentu wynalezienia nowoczesnej klimatyzacji w 1902 roku działamy z jasno określoną misją: poprawiać jakość życia oraz świat, który wspólnie tworzymy. Jeśli łączysz praktyczną wiedzę z zakresu logistyki z podejściem Lean Management, potrafisz skutecznie prowadzić projekty usprawniające i przekładać je na wymierne rezultaty biznesowe, dołącz do nas i wspieraj rozwój nowoczesnych rozwiązań logistycznych.


Twój wpływ


  • Prowadzenie projektów z zakresu Operational Excellence i Lean Logistics, ukierunkowanych na poprawę efektywności procesów logistycznych, magazynowych, planistycznych oraz przepływu materiałów.
  • Projektowanie, optymalizacja i wdrażanie rozwiązań w obszarze Material Flow, w tym supermarketów, systemów Kanban, milk-run, replenishment oraz staging.

  • Prowadzenie i facylitowanie warsztatów doskonalących, m.in. Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), A3 oraz Problem Solving.
  • Wdrażanie i rozwijanie standardów Lean Management i Lean Logistics oraz monitorowanie trwałości osiągniętych rezultatów.
  • Wykorzystywanie danych operacyjnych i wskaźników KPI do identyfikowania potencjału usprawnień, monitorowania efektów i wspierania decyzji biznesowych.
  • Realizacja inicjatyw ukierunkowanych na generowanie oszczędności, optymalizację poziomu zapasów, skracanie lead time oraz poprawę przepływu materiałów.
  • Ścisła współpraca z zespołami logistyki, produkcji, planowania, zakupów, jakości, inżynierii i IT w celu wdrażania przekrojowych zmian.
  • Wspieranie kultury ciągłego doskonalenia poprzez angażowanie zespołów operacyjnych i interesariuszy na różnych szczeblach organizacji.

Profil stanowiska


  • Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w obszarze Operational Excellence, Lean Management, Continuous Improvement lub Lean Logistics, najlepiej w środowisku produkcyjnym.
  • Udokumentowane doświadczenie w samodzielnym prowadzeniu projektów usprawniających, zakończonych mierzalnymi rezultatami biznesowymi.
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość procesów logistycznych i magazynowych oraz zasad zarządzania przepływem materiałów w środowisku produkcyjnym.
  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu, optymalizacji lub transformacji koncepcji logistycznych i systemów przepływu materiałów.
  • Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi i metod Lean, takich jak VSM, Kaizen, Kanban, Standard Work, Visual Management, PDCA, A3, 5 Why oraz Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Znajomość koncepcji Material Flow, PFEP (Plan For Every Part), supermarketów logistycznych oraz metod optymalizacji zapasów.
  • Umiejętność analizy danych operacyjnych, pracy ze wskaźnikami KPI oraz korzystania z systemów ERP; znajomość SAP będzie dodatkowym atutem.
  • Umiejętność przekładania problemów operacyjnych na konkretne działania usprawniające oraz podejmowania decyzji w oparciu o dane.
  • Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności komunikacyjne i współpracy międzyfunkcyjnej, w tym zdolność budowania zaangażowania i wpływania na organizację bez formalnej podległości.
  • Umiejętność swobodnego działania zarówno w środowisku operacyjnym, na hali produkcyjnej, jak i podczas prezentowania wyników oraz rekomendacji kadrze zarządzającej.
  • Dobra znajomość języka angielskiego, umożliwiająca efektywną współpracę w środowisku międzynarodowym.

Szukamy osoby, która łączy analityczne podejście z praktycznym działaniem, koncentruje się na trwałych efektach biznesowych i potrafi angażować innych w proces ciągłego doskonalenia.




Zakres wynagrodzenia

Wynagrodzenie roczne na tym stanowisku wynosi od zł115 200,00-zł229 200,00 rocznie. Na wysokość wynagrodzenia w tym przedziale mogą wpływać m.in. umiejętności, wykształcenie, doświadczenie oraz inne indywidualne kwalifikacje wybranego kandydata. Czynniki, które mogą wpływać na wysokość wynagrodzenia w danym przedziale płacowym, obejmują między innymi: umiejętności, wykształcenie, dotychczasowe doświadczenie, udział w układzie zbiorowym pracy (CLA), typowe rynkowe wynagrodzenie dla danego stanowiska oraz inne indywidualne kwalifikacje wybranego kandydata.

title: Graduate Research Appointment - Biomedical Ethics- Limited Tenure
description:
Mayo Clinic seeks applicants for a one- or two-year post-baccalaureate research experience in empirical bioethics research.

The Graduate Research Appointment (GRA) at Mayo Clinic is a post-baccalaureate appointment for individuals with an interest in biomedical research. The primary purpose is to provide a post-baccalaureate research experience that applies skills in science, technology, engineering or math to biomedical research including basic science or translational research. GRA participants will have the opportunity to participate in selected graduate classes and seminars while working in this role.

The Biomedical Ethics GRA program is designed for individuals with a bachelor's degree who have an interest in conducting research on topics in bioethics using empirical methods (surveys, interviews, focus groups, chart review). Research work is supplemented by weekly seminars, optional graduate school courses, and optional clinical shadowing opportunities, giving participants an experience that will help them decide on a career path related to biomedical ethics. In addition, the experience can increase the participant’s competitiveness and preparation for the next step in their career. Past trainees have gone on to study at graduate, medical, and law schools across the United States.

Successful applicants will be:

• Committed to pursuing a career related to biomedical ethics

• Able to work independently and in a collaborative team environment

• Proficient in written and verbal communication

• Competent in identifying relevant peer-reviewed publications on specialized research topics

• Able to demonstrate interest in biomedical ethics and its methods through past coursework or research

1-2 candidates will be selected to begin in Summer 2027. The application deadline is 11:59 pm CST Monday, February 15, 2027.

This position has an end date of one or two years after the start date, the preference is two years.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree.

Interest in biomedical ethics research

Authorization to work and remain in the United States, without necessity for Mayo Clinic sponsorship now, or in the future (must be a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, permanent resident, refugee or asylee)

This position will require a MN background check

Candidates must attach the following to the application to be considered. Applicants who do include the required items listed below will not be considered.

• Cover letter describing career goals and how biomedical ethics research relates to those goals

• Resume/CV

• 5–10-page writing sample, preferably on a topic in biomedical ethics

• Current, unofficial college transcript

• 1-2 letters of recommendation from research mentors or undergraduate professors sent directly to Dr. Jessica Hirsch at bioethics@mayo.edu. Two letters are strongly recommended.

Applicants who will have completed a Master’s degree, or who will be enrolled in Graduate or Medical School during the GRA appointment are not eligible.

BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. Key Responsibilities

  • Support senior bankers across the Global Institutional Business franchise in Asia, covering Public Sector, Banks, Asset Managers, Insurance Companies and Financial Sponsors.
  • Support day-to-day client coverage activities, including the preparation of client presentations and briefing materials, as well as the coordination and follow-up of senior management meetings, client visits and business trips.
  • Conduct client, sector and market analysis to identify potential business opportunities and support senior bankers in developing client strategies and account plans.

title: Product Owner, Workday HELP (Case & Knowledge Management)
description:
The Pitch


As Product Owner for Workday HELP, you’ll own how our employees get answers and resolve HR issues: the cases, the knowledge, and the agents that make both smarter. You’ll implement, break things in sandbox, decide what ships, and turn Workday’s newest AI features into something employees actually use. This is a hands-on IC role. You will configure, test, and launch, not manage a backlog from a distance. And the exciting part: you will continue your consulting journey as we roll the implementation to our portfolio companies across the globe. Also, Workday is shipping AI faster than most teams can evaluate it. We want someone who gets excited about that, not overwhelmed by it.

What You’ll Do

Own and implement Workday HELP

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of Case Management: case categories, case types, routing, SLAs, escalation paths, security, and integrations
  • Build and run Knowledge Management: article structure, authoring and approval workflows, audience targeting, and content lifecycle
  • Own the HELP product roadmap, backlog, and release readiness, including triaging each Workday bi-annual release for what matters to us

Experiment with what’s next

  • Evaluate and pilot new Workday AI capabilities as they arrive, including Illuminate and self-service agents
  • Run structured experiments: define the hypothesis, configure in sandbox, test with real scenarios, and measure results
  • Make clear, evidence-backed recommendations on what to adopt, defer, or skip
  • Help shape our agent-led self-service approach, from deflection to guided resolution

Make it measurable

  • Define the metrics for HR service delivery: case volume, resolution time, deflection, knowledge usage, and employee satisfaction
  • Build case analytics and dashboards that show leaders what is working and where to act next

Work across the Workday ecosystem

  • Partner with Core HCM, Talent, Recruiting, and Payroll teams so HELP works smoothly with the rest of the platform
  • Work with People Operations, HR Centers of Excellence, and IT on process design, content ownership, and change management
  • Coordinate with Workday and implementation partners on features, defects, and early-adopter programs

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • Hands-on Workday HELP implementation experience. This is non-negotiable. You have taken Case Management and/or Knowledge Management from design to go-live
  • Strong Core HCM background. You understand worker data, business processes, security, organizations, and how HELP depends on all of it
  • Experience as a product owner, functional lead, or senior consultant who owns configuration, not just requirements
  • Ability to translate HR service needs into clear user stories, configuration designs, and test plans
  • Strong stakeholder communication across HR, IT, and business teams

Strong plus

  • Experience implementing or piloting Workday self-service agents or Illuminate AI features
  • Case management analytics experience (Workday reporting, people analytics, or dashboards on case data)

What makes you a top candidate

  • Experience in Peakon, Learning, or Journeys. We want someone who sees how HELP connects to the wider employee experience, such as a Journey that triggers a case or Peakon feedback that reshapes knowledge content
  • Workday certifications in HCM or related modules
  • Prior experience in a shared services or global HR environment

You’ll Thrive Here If You

  • Treat every new Workday release like a gift basket and open it immediately
  • Are comfortable saying “that didn’t work, here’s why, here’s what we do instead”
  • Prefer building and testing over writing 40-page decks
  • Care about the employee on the other end of the case, not just the configuration
  • Can make a judgment call with 80% of the information

Why This Role

  • To bring HELP to life, hands on.
  • Early access to evaluating Workday’s AI roadmap, with real influence on what we adopt
  • A role built around experimentation, not maintenance
  • Visible impact: every employee touches HELP
  • Opportunity to grow into broader People Technology and AI-in-HR leadership as our platform scope expands

title: Senior Specialist, Geology & Data Science
description:
Location: Edmonton or Calgary, Alberta

Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time

Salary Range: T4, Level 6, $130,050 - $153,000 per year. The final compensation for this position will be determined based on individual factors, including education, qualifications, experience, and internal equity.


Senior Specialist, Geology and Data Science


The Opportunity­­


The Alberta Geological Survey (AGS), a branch of the Alberta Energy Regulator (AER), is recruiting for a Senior Specialist, Geology and Data Science position. This role is a critical piece of AGS’ geospatial intelligence capabilities and will work alongside data management experts, geomodellers, geologists and geophysicists, remote sensing experts, reservoir engineers, as well as regulatory specialists, business stakeholders, and IT partners.

In this role you will will be a major contributor to both strategic and hands-on work across multi-disciplinary projects related to oil and gas, minerals, groundwater and other natural resources. You will extract insights and create predictive models that utilize information from a wide array of geospatial and non-geospatial data, across geoscience, industry operations, and regulatory fields. Importantly, you will capably work and communicate in 3+ dimensions, leveraging the Geological Framework of Alberta and vast archives of industry and AGS data. You will be a central figure in AI enablement initiatives at the AGS.


What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Providing technical leadership and guidance while being a significant contributor on multi-disciplinary projects requiring a broad range of data science expertise
  • Lead AI enablement initiatives by advancing AI literacy, identifying opportunities for responsible AI adoption, promoting effective AI use, and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous business process improvements
  • Own scientific interpretation, method development, and validation of predictive products to ensure they are scientifically sound, meet QA requirements, and results are fit for purpose.
  • Compile and clean geological, operational, and regulatory data, extract insights, and create predictive models, using AI and machine learning for the purposes of geological mapping/modelling, landscape susceptibility analysis, assessing operational risks including induced seismicity and addressing other geological/geoenvironmental issues. Translate data into actionable insight through interactive visualizations, reports and dashboards to support internal and external requests.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts across data management, geosciences, engineering, and regulatory processes to facilitate modern, integrated, high-confidence database architectures and analytical tools.
  • Collaborate with our IT team to align data science practices with enterprise platform strategies, architecture, and technology standards.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship in the data science space, enabling capability development and success of staff and the organization.
  • Communicate complex data solutions, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders to support data literacy and responsible data use across AGS.

What we’re looking for in you:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, geoscience, or geoscience related discipline.
  • 7+ years in the energy industry managing geological datasets, developing and applying modern data science workflows, and exhibiting advanced programming skills.
  • Expert knowledge and experience in geological data validation, manipulation, visualization, and presentation, including using machine learning and AI.
  • Strong technical proficiency with Python, R, SQL, or other high-level programming languages and software tools used to support data management and analytics.
  • Experience designing, developing, and deploying machine learning, statistical, and predictive modelling solutions to address complex scientific and business challenges.
  • Experience applying advanced analytics using libraries such as tidymodels, mlr3, xgboost, and ranger in R, and scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, and PyTorch in Python.
  • Experience integrating machine learning solutions with cloud, geospatial, and enterprise data platforms to support scalable and operationalized analytics.
  • Preferred experience developing and applying machine learning, statistical, and AI methods for subsurface characterization, risk, resource evaluation, and predictive modelling using geological, geophysical, petrophysical, engineering, and spatial datasets.
  • Awareness of integration of data and its relation to geoscience applications (e.g. Schlumberger Petrel and Studio, IHS Accumap and Kingdom, LASWorx, ESRI ArcGIS Pro, etc.).
  • Preferred experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions using R and Python within enterprise analytics environments (e.g., Posit Connect, Databricks, Azure ML), including reproducible workflows, model governance, and integration with geoscience and spatial data systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership in the selection, development, and application of machine learning methods, mentoring teams on best practices for reproducible and scalable data science solutions.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, adapt to changing priorities with limited direction, and communicate complex data concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with public-sector geoscience organizations and regulatory environments is considered an asset.

Additional Information:

  • All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada at the time of application.
  • Should an individual with the required qualifications not be available, applicants with closely related qualifications may be considered. As a result, the position may be redesigned and/or reclassified.
  • If you need accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please email PeopleServices@aer.ca. Information relating to the need for accommodation and accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

What we offer you:

  • Opportunity to make a difference and be part of a performance driven team that is responsible for the efficient, safe, orderly, and environmentally responsible development of Alberta’s energy and mineral resources.
  • The ability to leverage your expertise and critical thinking skills to contribute in wide-ranging, challenging, and complex work.
  • Robust total reward packages including; a competitive compensation program, defined benefit pension plan(s), flexible benefits, and wellness programs.
  • Flexible work options and hours, aligned with organizational policies.


More information about working at the AER including our comprehensive Total Rewards package can be found in the careers section of our website .

At the AER, our values of Accountability, Collaboration, Transparency, and Trust & Respect are foundational to our culture – a culture where every individual, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected factors, thrives and contributes their unique perspectives.

description:
Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

Join us as a Senior Principal Engineer – eCAD PCB Layout on our Core Hardware Electrical Engineering team in Round Rock, Texas to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.

What you’ll achieve

We are seeking a passionate and visionary Hardware Senior Principal Engineer to lead PCB layout and to define the eCAD design processes behind our electronic products. You will own our most complex, highest-speed board layouts in Cadence Allegro PCB Designer and System Capture, set the layout standards, workflows, and tooling the entire organization relies on, and lead the modernization of PCB layout and the broader hardware development flow through AI and agentic workflows.

This is a build-the-future role. Dell ISG is advancing PCB layout through a multi-stage automation framework — Library, Placement, Fan Out, Rules & Routing, Modem Readiness & Release — powered by leading industry design tools and bound together by Dell’s cutting-edge AI. You will be the technical leader who takes this the rest of the way, partnering with electrical, mechanical, signal and power integrity, thermal, and manufacturing engineering, and with suppliers from concept through production — turning layout from a serialized, manual craft into a connected, model-driven, continuously validated discipline.

You will:

PCB Layout & Design Leadership

  • Own and lead the layout of our most complex, high-density, high-speed multi-layer PCBs — from placement and routing through fabrication and assembly release — on the platforms that define Dell’s Enterprise AI compute, storage, and networking portfolio
  • Define stackup, placement, routing, and constraint strategies in partnership with electrical, signal and power integrity, thermal, and mechanical engineering, so that architectural intent translates fully intact all the way from specification to the fabrication drawing
  • Lead design reviews and hold the line on Dell standards, IPC requirements, and DFM, DFA, and DFT guidelines, always chasing the best answer to ensure maximum product performance and quality at optimized cost
  • Serve as the technical authority for PCB layout across the Core Hardware Electrical Engineering team, mentoring designers and engineers and codifying your expertise so that it scales far beyond any one person

Process Development & Modernization

  • Create and own the PCB layout processes, standards, checklists, templates, and documentation used across the organization — treating the workflow itself as a product you ship, measure, and improve
  • Lead the clean-sheet reimagination of the PCB layout and hardware development flow: find the bottlenecks, delete the steps that no longer earn their place, and replace manual execution with automation
  • Drive the multi-stage layout automation framework from Library through Release, including AI-assisted placement, constraint-driven fan out with HDI and via rules, agentic net scheduling, and automated review with automatic issue creation
  • Evaluate and deploy new eCAD tools, features, and methods; influence our tool providers’ roadmaps through direct Dell feedback; and own tool upgrades and rollouts end-to-end

AI & Agentic Workflow Enablement

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-assisted and agentic workflows for layout tasks such as constraint setup, design rule checking, design review, and manufacturing output generation — collapsing place → DRC → fix → re-check loops that take hours today into seconds tomorrow
  • Advance our vision of Hardware Agents for CAD, to achieve design outcomes headlessly from structured intent rather than from GUI clicks, with version-linked changes and human review gates at every decision point
  • Connect layout to all other design artifacts, so that Gerbers, manufacturing files, production BOMs, and power and thermal analyses become living derivatives of a single source of truth rather than disconnected snapshots — shifting validation left and reducing prototype turns
  • Partner with CAD, IT, and software teams to integrate AI tooling with eCAD, PLM, and library systems through programmatic APIs, and measure the realized impact on cycle time and quality
  • Champion AI adoption across the team within our culture of apprenticeship — learn, learn, learn; teach, teach, teach — so that every engineer and designer becomes a force multiplier and the knowledge compounds.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Electrical, Mechanical, Signal Integrity, Thermal, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams, and lead the technical relationship with our PCB fabrication and assembly suppliers
  • Support new technology introductions and lead the resolution of layout-related build, test, and manufacturing issues
  • Strengthen Dell’s positioning via increased technical differentiation, architectural building block leverage, and innovation in our offering roadmaps

Take the first step towards your dream career

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

Essential Requirements

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s in Electrical/Computer Engineering (or equivalent) with 12+ years of PCB layout and design experience on complex, high-speed, multi-layer boards through production
  • Cadence Expertise: Advanced proficiency with Cadence Allegro PCB Designer, Constraint Manager, System Capture, and/or OrCAD Capture
  • Technical Depth: Strong knowledge of high-speed PCB design, stackups, signal/power integrity, IPC standards, and PCB fabrication/assembly processes
  • Automation & AI: Experience leveraging AI-assisted design tools, agentic workflows, and eCAD automation/scripting (SKILL, Python, Tcl, APIs/MCP) to improve engineering efficiency
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Proven success driving design standards, process improvements, and technical leadership across global teams, with experience using PLM systems and managed component libraries

Desirable Requirements

  • Previous experience leading PCB layout teams or driving process transformation initiatives at scale
  • Genuine enthusiasm for artificial intelligence and the conviction that the hardware development process can — and should — be reinvented

Compensation

Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $187k - $242k.

Benefits and Perks of working at Dell Technologies
