title: PR & Content Specialist - AdFarm
description:
Position Locations: Calgary, Alberta OR Guelph, Ontario

You don’t make it 40+ years in this business without good people behind you. At AdFarm, we are driving the evolution of agriculture, and it starts with hiring the right individuals. We are the bridge between farmers and the brands that serve them. Companies come to us for strategic planning, creative services, public relations, media planning, marketing science, content creation and research. If you’re ready to be a part of a team that does these things, and does them well, we should chat. We partner with everyone from crop protection, nutrition and seed companies to technology, sustainability, food and animal health brands. If you’re in that space, or want to head that direction, this role will be a great fit.

You will love it here if you follow these GUIDEPOSTS:

Are you being agile? Change is inevitable, whether it’s from the client, or the industry as a whole. Are you ready to get the job done well, on time and on budget? We’re all about developing and following processes that keep our teams effective and our clients happy.

Are you being smart? Knowing what to ask, how to start and what resources you have to solve problems are essential. Invest in yourself and keep up with the ever-evolving world of our clients and the wider communications industry.

Are you being helpful? If you know the ad and ag industries, you know it gets hectic sometimes. Are you ready to pitch in when it counts and do whatever it takes to deliver amazing work for our client partners? Be ready to have direct conversations when needed and set clear expectations for you, your supervisor and your team.


As the PR & Content Specialist, you will have a strong background in content planning, writing, social media and digital storytelling. You are a proactive communicator, organized planner and strong writer who can turn ideas, campaign priorities and technical information into clear, engaging content across multiple channels. This role will play a key part in supporting social media and website content, with a focus on creating content that connects with the right audiences. You’ll love coming to work every day if you Get, Want, and have the Capacity to be accountable to the following:

  • Content Planning
  • Execution
  • Community Management
  • Trends
  • Analysis & Recommendations
  • Collaboration

You’ll have success here if you value clear processes and feel qualified based on having 3-5 years of experience in doing the following things:

  • Working with an integrated team of marketing professionals to achieve client communication objectives.
  • Planning and implementing owned content, including blogs, long-form articles, sponsored content and social media.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with key industry media.
  • Develop monthly social media content calendars that align with client goals, brand voice, campaign priorities and seasonal opportunities.
  • Support community management by monitoring comments, messages, audience engagement and relevant conversation opportunities.
  • Translate complex or technical information into content that is easy to understand, accurate and relevant to the intended audience.
  • Identify social media trends, platform updates, content formats, and timely opportunities that could support client storytelling.
  • Apply SEO best practices to website articles, blog content, headlines, metadata and digital copy where appropriate.
  • Maintain brand consistency across audience touchpoints.
  • Collaborate closely with strategy, creative and account teams to ensure cohesive storytelling and unified execution.
  • Build relationships with internal teams and external partners, supporting smooth workflows and strong alignment.
  • Drive audience growth, engagement, and community loyalty across key social platforms.
  • Use analytics tools to assess performance, identify optimization opportunities and adjust strategies to improve results.
  • Analyze campaign performance across owned media channels, delivering insights that refine ongoing and future strategies.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively across disciplines, ensuring stakeholders understand performance, opportunities and recommendations.

We train our team to help them succeed, and everyone on our team helps with our success. In this role, you’ll need to come to the table with the following skills and qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, journalism, public relations, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in public relations, content marketing, social media, communications, journalism, copywriting, or a related role.
  • Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to adapt tone and style for different audiences, platforms and content objectives.
  • Experience developing social media content calendars and managing content scheduling.
  • Comfortable writing for multiple formats, including social media, websites, articles, sponsored content and more.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, content workflows and stakeholders.
  • Ability to take complex, technical, or industry-specific information and turn it into clear, useful and engaging content.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms, scheduling tools, content management systems and best practices.
  • Proactive in identifying content opportunities, improving processes and bringing forward ideas that support stronger storytelling and execution.
  • SEO experience, including keyword research and on-page optimization, is considered an asset.
  • Agency and/or agriculture experience is considered a strong asset.

The salary range for this role is $50,000 - $65,000 per year. We offer all employees health, dental, and vision benefits, automatic 3% RRSP contributions on an annual basis, a health spending account, health & cell phone reimbursements, and we can offer a hybrid working environment with a wonderful group of top talent individuals.

Culture is everything for us and so we do our best to hire according to alike values and mutual respects.

We are a TEAM and we are looking for like-minded individuals that are eager to contribute as such.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
The opportunity

Associated Engineering, a proudly Canadian, Employee-owned Company is seeking an experienced and dedicated IT Support Technician to join our team in our Regina office. In this role, you will report to the Operations Manager in Saskatchewan/Manitoba with functional reporting responsibilities to the Director of Information Technology or designate. You will provide responsive, effective, and client-focused technical support to the Saskatchewan/Manitoba operations and the Associated Engineering Group of Companies.

The IT Support Technician serves as a primary, hands-on support resource across the organization and its various business units and locations. The position collaborates with the Service Desk Coordinator, other IT Support Technicians, IT System Administrators, technology vendors, and designated software owners to resolve technical issues, coordinate equipment purchases and renewals, support new employees, maintain documentation, and contribute to technology planning and budgeting.

What we offer:

  • Market competitive salaries, with annual reviews
    • Matching company pension program, increasing over time
  • Comprehensive benefits including:
    • Health/dental/vision coverage
    • Fitness allowance
    • Employee and family assistance programs
    • Mental health supports
  • Paid time off so that you can recharge including:
    • Generous paid vacation
    • Paid office closure over December holiday break
    • Industry leading paid sick time
    • Maternity/paternity leave top up program
  • Ongoing support for your professional development and growth
    • Active Young Professional group
    • Formal mentoring programs
    • Paid professional development hours
    • Capacity building seminars
    • Engineer In Training programs
  • Opportunities to participate in social club activities and events
    • Company-wide social events
    • Regular lunch-and-learns
    • Community volunteer opportunities

What you’ll do

  • Provide timely, professional, and client-focused end-user technical support to employees, while monitoring and managing the Corporate IT Service Desk queue
  • Provide computer setup and new hire support each week for upcoming new employees, transfers, role changes, and other onboarding requirements
  • Assist employees with their user accounts, including password resets, account lockouts, authentication problems, and approved access requests
  • Manage smartphones and related mobile services
  • Maintain an accurate inventory of IT Assets and record of equipment lifecycles
  • Manage the purchasing of IT equipment through approved corporate vendors and purchasing processes
  • Assist in developing and maintaining the regional IT capital budget
  • Work with the procurement team and other designated stakeholders to support software license renewals
  • Provide remote and on-site IT support for the branch offices in your area of responsibility
  • Provide local, hands-on assistance to IT System Administrators and Corporate IT Operations personnel
  • Assist in creating, reviewing, and maintaining IT administration documentation Follow corporate IT, cybersecurity, privacy, acceptable-use, procurement, records management, and asset management policies

Does this sound like you?

  • A post-secondary diploma or degree from an accredited university, college, or technical institution in a related technology discipline is preferred
  • An equivalent combination of education, technical training, certifications, and directly related experience may be considered
  • A minimum of 3-5 years of experience providing end-user IT support including setting up and deploying computers within a standardized corporate environment
  • Experience using an ITIL-oriented service desk or IT service management platform
  • Experience with IT asset tracking, software licensing, vendor purchasing, and basic budget management is an asset
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Windows support and troubleshooting including Microsoft Teams
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 applications and services
  • Strong desktop and laptop hardware troubleshooting skills including smartphones and mobile services
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP and endpoint network troubleshooting
  • Understanding of identity, access, endpoint security, data protection, and secure equipment disposal practices
  • Ability to create clear technical procedures, support notes, and knowledge articles


About Us

At Associated Engineering, we’re passionate about not only the work we do but the communities we live and work in. Which is why sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. As a carbon neutral company since 2009, we help shape resilient and sustainable communities across Canada.

As a Platinum Member of Canada’s Best Managed Companies since 2008, we take pride in nurturing a workplace where people thrive. We are an employer of choice providing our people with a supportive, collaborative, engaging and dynamic place to build a career, while bringing inspiration and innovation to our work.


Our company culture is shaped by:

  • Growth and development of our employees – chart your career course, whatever stage you are at!
  • A broad variety of meaningful work that supports local communities – we are a medium-sized company working on significant projects, helping to shape communities!
  • We care, we commit, we create – our promise to both clients and each other!


What’s next?

Ready to make an impact? Join a company that values your ideas, invests in your growth, and empowers you to shape the future. Apply today!

Want more information?

  • Check out what a day at Associated Engineering looks like via LinkedIn
  • Our Environmental, Social and Governance Report

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
description:

title: Care & Enrichment Technician
description:
Summary:

Lifesaving impact, rewarding careers: For more than 150 years, the ASPCA has been on the frontlines to save, transform and protect the lives of millions of animals. We are looking for a Care & Enrichment Technician to provide high quality daily care to dogs at the Behavioral Rehabilitation Center, making a critical impact on the vulnerable animals who need us most.

Who We Are

The ASPCA Behavioral Rehabilitation Center (BRC), located in Weaverville, NC, is the first and only facility dedicated to the study and rehabilitation of extremely fearful, under socialized dogs, such as those confiscated from puppy mills and hoarding situations. The center focuses on two main goals: (1) the study and rehabilitation of dogs who suffer from behavioral problems that compromise their quality of life and prevent adoption, and (2) elevating shelter animal behavior programs across the country through the sharing of emerging best practices.

What You’ll Do

This key role at the BRC includes providing daily care, cleaning and enrichment for the animals in treatment at our facility in Asheville, NC. The goal of the Rehab Center is to provide behavioral interventions for dogs who are so behaviorally compromised that they suffer from a poor quality of life and cannot be placed in a home without rehabilitation. Critical to their success at the BRC is their ability to stay healthy while in the facility.

The Care and Enrichment Technicians (CETs), who comprise a team of 8 in total, work together to provide daily care and enrichment, perform low stress handling and husbandry, closely monitor and report signs of medical and behavioral change and keep all animal care areas stocked with supplies. The CETs also prepare and provide daily enrichment items to keep dogs engaged and reduce stress, facilitate playgroups, and assist the behavior staff as requested with specific parts of the interventions. One of the most critical functions of the CETs is to serve as part of a harmonious, united team of shelter operations, shelter medicine and animal behavior experts, all dedicated to collaborating with each other to provide balanced, holistic care.

When & Where You’ll Work

  • This position is based in Weaverville, near Asheville, NC, and will report to the BRC’s Senior Manager, Care and Enrichment. There will be no direct reports.

  • This role requires the ability to work a flexible schedule, including days, evenings and holidays, as needed.

When & Where You’ll Work

Compensation

Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of factors, including but not limited to education, training, experience, location, business needs, internal equity, market demands or budgeted amount for the role. The target hiring range is for new hire offers only, and staff compensation may increase beyond the maximum hiring range based on performance over time. The maximum of the hiring range is reserved for candidates with the highest qualifications and relevant experience. The expected hiring salary range for this role is set forth below and may be modified in the future.

The target hiring range for this role is $20.75-$22.19 hourly.

Benefits

At the ASPCA, you don’t have to choose between your passion and making a living. Our comprehensive benefits package helps ensure you can live a rewarding life at work and at home. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Affordable health coverage, including medical, employer-paid dental, and optional vision coverage.

  • Flexible time off that includes vacation time, sick and bereavement time, paid parental leave, 10 company paid holidays, and paid personal time off that allows you even more flexibility to observe the days that mean the most to you.

  • Competitive financial incentives and retirement savings including a 401(k) plan with generous employer contributions — we match dollar for dollar up to 4% and provide an additional 4% contribution toward your future each year.

  • Robust professional development opportunities including classes, on-the-job training, coaching and mentorship with industry-leading peers, internal mobility, opportunities to support in the field, and so much more.

For more information on our benefits offerings, visit our website.

Responsibilities:

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Direct Animal Care & Monitoring

  • Provide daily care and support for the dogs in treatment, adhering to the BRC

    standard operating procedures and low stress handling and approach.

  • Ensure the comfort and cleanliness of shelter animal population on a daily basis.

  • Monitor and help maintain the medical and behavioral health of shelter animals; documenting all medical and behavioral concerns and observations on a daily basis.

  • Ensure adherence to nutrition, sanitation and infectious disease-prevention

    protocols established by the ASPCA’s Shelter Medicine Services team and BRC Operations Management.

  • Comply with specific feeding programs established by the Senior Director of Medical.

  • Support the behavioral growth of the dogs in treatment, in coordination with the Behavior Branch and treatment paradigms of the program.

  • Assist as requested in behavior treatments and interventions.

  • Take inventory, restock supplies and put away deliveries as needed.

  • Provide a safe and compassionate environment for animals in our care, our staff,

    by using low-stress handling techniques.

Enrichment & Program Support

  • Follow guidelines to ensure that animal holding areas include appropriate music

    and/or auditory stimulation for shelter animals.

  • Manage play groups and graduate activities as directed by Senior Manager of Care and Enrichment.

  • Prepare and distribute enrichment as directed; being open to specific needs

    based on treatment status or special needs.

  • Assist in onboarding and integrating volunteers into daily care, setting clear expectations, providing guidance as needed and always communicating respect and gratitude for volunteer support.

  • Drive an ASPCA vehicle to transport animals when needed and maintain the cleanliness of the animal transport vehicles when used.

  • Assist in Learning Lab collaborative modules to provide understanding to shelter partners around BRC Operations protocols as needed.

  • Under the direction of the Senior Manager of Care & Enrichment and the Senior Director of Operations, provide hands-on coaching of Operational procedures & protocols for ASPCA visitors.

Qualifications:

  • Always treats people and animals with care and respect; must be a compassionate caregiver for animals and have a genuine interest in working with others maintains a consistently positive attitude; must enjoy working directly with people; respects team members at all levels

  • Cultivates a climate in which individual differences and perspectives are valued, respected, encouraged and supported

  • Forms authentic, trusting relationships which enhance individual and team performance

  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

  • Ability to troubleshoot and problem-solve

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

  • Meticulous organizational skills; pays close attention to detail

  • Must enjoy keeping animals and kennels clean

  • Ability to skillfully restrain, lift, and handle animals in stressful conditions

  • Ability to work closely with behaviorally compromised animals and feel comfortable working in an environment where euthanasia is performed on a regular basis

  • Interest in working with undersocialized dogs with extreme fear issues

Job Summary

Naropa University’s Master of Arts in Cooperative Management program seeks an experienced curriculum/content developer to design an online version of the three-credit course MGMT 630E Democratic Governance & Board Dynamics during the spring 2027 course development cycle. This position is for developing the online content only, though there may be the opportunity for applicants to teach the course in a future semester.

Course Description: MGMT 630E Democratic Governance & Board Dynamics

Effective governance is the defining challenge of any member-owned organization. This course focuses on the practical and interpersonal mechanics of "One Member, One Vote." Students will learn to design governance structures that ensure accountability while maintaining operational efficiency. Emphasis is placed on managing the delicate relationship between a democratically elected Board of Directors and professional management, ensuring that member voices remain central to the organization’s strategic direction.

About the Program

Traditional MBA and MPA programs focus on shareholder primacy and hierarchical corporate structures, leaving leaders unprepared for member-governed organizations. The Master of Arts in Management: Cooperative Management & Organizing bridges business administration, public advocacy, and contemplative leadership. Students master dual-bottom-line financial management, democratic decision-making, and grassroots coalition building to steer sustainable, community-centered enterprises.

The MA in Management: Cooperative Management & Organizing is a 36-credit, two-year master’s degree delivered in an accessible online format. Coursework is structured across four 9-credit semesters, combining synchronous and asynchronous online study with real-world, community-embedded practice. During their second year, students complete a hands-on field internship and capstone project with an active cooperative, credit union, housing collective, or advocacy organization.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

· Create an eight-module, asynchronous online course in the timeframe of January – May 2027
· Generate (in conjunction with the Office of Educational Technologies) online content, including recorded lectures, practice sessions, and experiential learning activities; textual material; assignments; and assessment rubrics; and
· Create the online course with support of the Office of Educational Technologies, including the implementation of ADA-compliant readings, study guides, threaded discussions, quizzes, links to web resources, as appropriate with the course.
· Work with the Naropa instructional design team, develop an asynchronous online course, to be taught in Canvas, Naropa’s Learning Management System.
· Incorporate established best practices and follow essential procedures to design a quality online course.
· Create and maintain a positive team environment and behave professionally with everyone encountered in the course and scope of the job duties.

Minimum education qualifications:A master's degree from an accredited institution in one of the following disciplines:Business Administration (MBA), Public Administration(MPA),Management, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, or a related fieldProfessional experience in the following:

  • Board governance and organizational oversight.
  • Democratic governance and participatory decision-making.
  • Strategic planning and organizational accountability.
  • Board-management relationships and organizational leadership.
  • Cooperative governance principles and member participation.
  • Experience serving on or advising a board of directors
  • Experience with organizational governance, strategic planning, and accountability.
  • Knowledge of democratic decision-making and member-owned organizations.
  • Experience developing governance policies, bylaws, or board-management relationships.
  • Teaching experience at the graduate level.

Naropa recognizes the following holidays throughout the year: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Fall Break, 4th Thursday and Friday in November, and Winter Break, the last two weeks in December encompassing the Christmas holiday as well as New Year’s.

Naropa’s health and welfare benefits include the following: medical, dental, vision, FSA, HSA, employer-paid short-term and long-term disability, employer-paid life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment, an employer-sponsored pre-tax retirement savings plan, which includes up to 2.5% employer matching, and a variety of voluntary, employee-paid supplemental insurance plans.

title: Informatica CDGC
description:
Job Summary

This hybrid day shift role focuses on establishing robust AI driven data governance and lineage practices for enterprise data platforms using warehouse technologies Databricks and Informatica tools. The specialist will design and operationalize frameworks that ensure trusted data regulatory compliance and high quality information flow across business functions supporting transparent decision making and enabling sustainable value creation for clients and society through responsible data use.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement comprehensive data governance frameworks across data warehouse and Databricks platforms to ensure consistent standards policies and controls that enable trusted analytics and responsible data driven decisions across the organization.
  • Define and maintain detailed data lineage models by configuring and optimizing Informatica EDC and CDGC tools to provide end to end visibility of data flows transformations and usage patterns for regulatory reporting and impact analysis.
  • Configure and administer Collibra environments to establish an enterprise data catalog business glossary and stewardship workflows that simplify data discovery ownership clarity and collaboration among technical and business stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain Axon and HC Data Management solutions to capture data governance metadata critical data element definitions and data quality rules that support consistent data usage and reduce operational risks in downstream applications.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams working on Databricks and data warehouse pipelines to embed governance controls metadata capture and lineage tracking mechanisms directly into ingestion and transformation processes.
  • Create and refine standards for data quality monitoring using Informatica tooling to proactively identify anomalies measure data health and drive remediation actions that protect reporting accuracy and customer outcomes.
  • Engage with business partners including asset management operations stakeholders when relevant to translate regulatory compliance and operational requirements into practical data governance controls and lineage documentation.
  • Develop clear procedures playbooks and guidance documents that explain data governance processes stewardship responsibilities and usage protocols in language accessible to both business and technical teams.
  • Coordinate periodic assessments and audits of data governance and lineage implementations to verify adherence to policy identify gaps and recommend prioritized improvements that enhance resilience and transparency.
  • Drive integration of Collibra Axon EDC and CDGC metadata repositories with data warehouse and Databricks infrastructures to maintain a single reliable view of data assets ownership quality and lineage across the enterprise.
  • Support incident analysis and root cause investigations by leveraging detailed lineage views to trace data issues back to specific sources transformations or controls thereby reducing resolution time and preventing recurrence.
  • Provide guidance and enablement to project teams on best practices for metadata management tagging standards and stewardship models so that new solutions align with enterprise data governance expectations from inception.
  • Contribute to the evolution of data governance strategies by monitoring industry trends regulatory changes and emerging AI data management practices ensuring that the organization remains compliant ethical and competitive in its use of data.


Qualifications

  • Demonstrate deep hands on experience in designing and operating enterprise data warehouses combined with strong Databricks skills to support scalable data engineering and analytics aligned with governance requirements.
  • Show advanced proficiency with Informatica platforms including HC Data Management core Informatica services Axon EDC and CDGC for implementing metadata management data quality and governance solutions in complex environments.
  • Apply practical expertise in Collibra configuration and administration to build sustainable data catalogs glossaries and stewardship workflows that enhance data literacy and accountability across teams.
  • Exhibit strong understanding of data governance principles data lineage modeling and regulatory expectations ideally complemented by exposure to asset management operations or similar data intensive financial domains.
  • Utilize effective communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities to explain data governance concepts negotiate priorities and align diverse technical and business groups around shared data standards without relying on formal leadership authority.
  • Leverage analytical and problem solving strengths to diagnose data quality or lineage issues design targeted remediation initiatives and demonstrate measurable improvements in data reliability and decision support outcomes.


Certifications Required

Preferred certifications include Informatica Data Governance or Data Quality certification and Collibra Ranger or similar data governance credential.

description:
Job description

About the Role:

We are a growing company headquartered in Kuwait, seeking an experienced and detail-oriented CNC Engineer / Programmer to manage precision metal cutting, routing, and component fabrication for our custom caravans and mobile units project based in Doha, Qatar.

In this role, you will be responsible for translating engineering designs and 3D CAD/CAM models into precise G-code, setting up and operating CNC machinery, and ensuring high-accuracy output for structural brackets, panels, and custom parts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • CNC Programming & CAM: Create, test, and optimize CNC programs using CAD/CAM software to cut, mill, shape, and drill steel, aluminum, and composite materials.
  • Machine Setup & Operation: Set up, calibrate, and operate CNC machines (routers, plasma cutters, or milling centers) to achieve tight production tolerances.
  • Blueprint & Drawing Interpretation: Read and interpret technical engineering drawings and fabrication blueprints to ensure parts match exact specifications.
  • Tooling & Quality Control: Select appropriate cutting tools, monitor machine performance, and inspect finished components using precision measuring instruments (calipers, micrometers).
  • Troubleshooting & Maintenance: Resolve any programming, tooling, or hardware issues during runs and perform routine preventive maintenance on CNC equipment.
  • Cross-Functional Workflow: Coordinate closely with our mechanical design and workshop fabrication teams in Doha, Qatar, ensuring smooth workflow and material hand-offs.

Skills

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 6 years of hands‑on experience in CNC programming and operations within a metal or structural fabrication environment.
  • Core Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency in CAD/CAM software and strong understanding of G‑code and CNC control systems.
  • Deep knowledge of metal properties (steel, aluminum), cutting speeds, feeds, and tolerances.
  • Ability to read complex technical and fabrication drawings effortlessly.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and attention to safety and quality control standards.
  • Mobility: Fully willing and able to work on‑site for project execution in Doha, Qatar, managed through our Kuwait head office.

title: Senior Workforce AI Solutions Engineer
description:
Join Verisk's Workforce Technology Services organization as a Workforce AI Solutions Engineer. This role partners directly with business stakeholders across the enterprise to identify, design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions using approved workforce AI platforms, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, and associated technologies.

The position serves as the technical lead and primary owner for a queue of business-submitted AI solution requests that require light-to-moderate implementation effort. The person in this role leads each engagement while remaining directly involved in solution design, development, testing, and delivery alongside a collaborating coworker. Requests may include workflow automation, AI agent development, system integrations, document intelligence, knowledge retrieval, process simplification, and productivity optimization.

The role works with a partner team responsible for initial intake and triage so that simple questions, training needs, and requests requiring clarification are handled separately. This position receives qualified requests that need hands-on technical design and delivery but do not require a large-scale software development engagement.

Purpose of the Role

  • Accelerate measurable business value from enterprise workforce AI investments.
  • Design and deliver AI-powered solutions that improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and simplify business processes.
  • Act as a technical advisor and solution architect for workforce AI technologies.
  • Establish reusable agents, skills, integrations, MCP components, and solution patterns that can be leveraged across the organization.
  • Drive responsible AI adoption while meeting enterprise security, governance, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Request Queue Management and Solution Delivery

  • Lead and coordinate delivery activities with the coworker supporting each request, including work allocation, technical direction, issue resolution, and completion accountability.
  • Manage and prioritize a queue of qualified AI solution requests received from business units across the company.
  • Partner with the intake and triage function to confirm scope, readiness, ownership, dependencies, and the appropriate delivery path, then lead execution with the coworker assigned to support delivery.
  • Work directly with requesters to understand business processes, desired outcomes, data needs, risks, and success measures.
  • Translate business requirements into practical AI solutions using approved platforms and technologies.
  • Estimate effort, communicate delivery expectations, document decisions, and maintain visibility into request status and outcomes.
  • Provide appropriate implementation documentation, knowledge transfer, and transition to an ongoing support model.

AI Solution Architecture and Engineering

  • Design AI-enabled workflows, agents, automations, and business process improvements.
  • Select the appropriate platform and implementation approach based on business needs, technical fit, security, maintainability, and cost.
  • Build solutions through simple builder experiences, low-code platforms, and pro-code development using Visual Studio or Visual Studio Code when needed.
  • Create reusable design patterns, templates, components, and engineering standards that improve delivery speed and consistency.
  • Evaluate scalability, observability, supportability, and lifecycle requirements before production use.

Agent, Skill, and MCP Development

  • Build and maintain purpose-specific AI agents, actions, prompts, workflows, and orchestration logic.
  • Develop custom skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or integrations when platform-native capabilities are insufficient.
  • Extend AI platforms using APIs, SDKs, custom connectors, functions, and other approved integration methods.
  • Apply software development practices such as source control, testing, documentation, release management, and reusable code design.

Integration, Data, and Authentication

  • Design secure connections between workforce AI platforms and enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, business applications, and external functions.
  • Understand and apply modern authentication and authorization patterns, including OAuth, Microsoft Entra ID, application registrations, service principals, managed identities, delegated access, and API-based credentials.
  • Partner with application owners, data owners, security, privacy, architecture, and identity teams to establish approved access patterns.
  • Ensure solutions follow least-privilege principles and protect enterprise data throughout retrieval, processing, storage, and output.

Platform Expertise and Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain strong working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, related APIs, and emerging enterprise AI capabilities.
  • Understand the strengths, limitations, licensing considerations, and integration options of each platform.
  • Evaluate new capabilities and identify where they can improve solution quality, reduce development effort, or expand supported use cases.
  • Share lessons learned and reusable practices with AI enablement, platform, security, and engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in solution architecture, software engineering, automation, cloud engineering, application integration, or a related technology discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering business-facing technical solutions from requirements through implementation.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience working with APIs, SDKs, integrations, automation technologies, and structured or unstructured enterprise data sources.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise identity, authentication, authorization, and secure integration patterns.
  • Ability to build through both low-code and pro-code approaches and to select the appropriate method for the request.
  • Strong analytical, consulting, documentation, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests, balance business urgency with technical risk, and drive work to completion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building custom agents, AI assistants, agent actions, and multi-step AI workflows.
  • Experience developing MCP servers, custom skills, plugins, connectors, or similar extensibility components.
  • Experience with Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Power Automate, GitHub, Visual Studio, or Visual Studio Code.
  • Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise search, grounding, vector search, and knowledge-management patterns.
  • Knowledge of responsible AI, data protection, security, compliance, auditability, and AI governance practices.
  • Experience identifying and measuring productivity, process, service-quality, or business-value improvements.

Success Measures

  • Timely movement of qualified requests from intake through delivery or an agreed disposition.
  • Business requester satisfaction and adoption of delivered solutions.
  • Demonstrated productivity, quality, service, or process improvements from implemented solutions.
  • Creation and reuse of standard agents, skills, MCP components, connectors, and solution patterns.
  • Reliable, secure, supportable solutions that comply with enterprise governance and architecture requirements.
  • Clear documentation, ownership, and lifecycle management for solutions placed into use.

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate combines curiosity about emerging AI capabilities with disciplined enterprise engineering. They can move comfortably between a business process conversation and a technical design discussion, explain tradeoffs clearly, build practical solutions, and recognize when a request should be simplified, escalated, or redirected. They are accountable for outcomes, thoughtful about risk, and motivated by improving how employees work.

title: Sr IT Administrator
description:
Government Employees Health Association, Inc. (G.E.H.A) is a nonprofit member association that provides health and dental benefits that millions of federal employees and retirees, military retirees and their families have counted on since 1937. Offering one of the largest health and dental benefit provider networks available to federal employees in the United States, G.E.H.A empowers health and wellness by meeting its members where they are, when they need care.

G.E.H.A has one mission: To empower federal workers to be healthy and well.

The Senior ServiceNow Administrator is a senior technical member of the Enterprise Services and Support team and reports to the Manager, Service Operations and Support. This position is responsible first for reliable day-to-day ServiceNow administration, production support, platform health, upgrades, troubleshooting, catalog development, configuration, and release quality. In addition, the role designs and delivers more complex solutions involving automation, integrations, custom or scoped applications, Strategic Portfolio Management, ITOM, CMDB and CSDM maturity, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities. The successful candidate will be a hands-on, forward-thinking technical administrator who can solve complex problems, build scalable solutions, mentor teammates, and help translate the ServiceNow roadmap into sustainable business outcomes.

SKILLS

ServiceNow Administration and Platform Support

· Provide day-to-day administration, monitoring, maintenance, and production support for the ServiceNow platform.

· Triage and resolve platform incidents, service requests, defects, access needs, user questions, and assigned enhancement work.

· Configure and maintain users, groups, roles, forms, lists, notifications, assignment rules, system properties, scheduled jobs, and other core platform functions.

· Build and maintain Service Catalog items, record producers, order guides, variables, approvals, fulfillment tasks, notifications, and related workflows.

· Create and maintain reports, dashboards, knowledge content, and user-facing platform experiences that support business operations.

· Gather and clarify requirements and translate approved business needs into scalable configurations using out-of-box functionality, Flow Designer, and approved development practices.

· Support upgrades, patches, clones, plugin deployments, testing, release activities, production validation, and post-release issue resolution.

· Maintain technical documentation, support procedures, configuration records, test evidence, and knowledge articles.

· Follow platform governance, security, change, testing, and release standards while favoring maintainable configuration over unnecessary customization.

· Lead troubleshooting of complex application, workflow, integration, performance, access, scripting, and data issues.

· Perform configuration, code, and solution reviews to improve platform quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and upgradeability.

· Mentor administrators through technical guidance, peer review, documentation, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer.

Specialty Responsibilities

After core platform administration responsibilities, this role provides focused support and capability development in the following areas:

· Design and support workflow automation, integrations, reusable components, and custom or scoped applications using approved ServiceNow development practices.

· Configure and enhance Strategic Portfolio Management capabilities, including demand, project, program, portfolio, resource, agile, application portfolio, roadmap, objectives, and outcome tracking.

· Support ITOM capabilities including Discovery, MID Servers, Service Mapping, Event Management, service health, and operational visibility.

· Advance CMDB and CSDM maturity through data-quality controls, identification and reconciliation practices, service modeling, certification, and governance.

· Develop and support integrations using IntegrationHub, REST, SOAP, webhooks, SSO, SFTP, JDBC, and other approved technologies.

· Create advanced Platform Analytics, portfolio, service health, operational, adoption, and executive reporting solutions.

· Evaluate and implement practical uses of App Engine, ATF, source control, Now Assist, Virtual Agent, AI Search, intelligent automation, and AI agents with appropriate security, testing, monitoring, and human oversight.

Teamwork, Innovation, and Business Partnership

· Work collaboratively across Enterprise Services and Support, sharing ownership of platform support and assisting teammates when priorities require it.

· Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, technology teams, security, enterprise architecture, and vendors to translate business needs into supportable solutions.

· Participate in peer reviews, troubleshooting, documentation, cross-training, and knowledge-sharing activities.

· Stay current on ServiceNow releases and capabilities, identify practical improvement opportunities, and recommend approaches that reduce manual work and technical debt.

· Demonstrate a customer-focused, forward-thinking, team-first approach with accountability, curiosity, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous learning.

Required Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered in place of formal education.

· Six or more years of progressive ServiceNow administration, development, implementation, or consulting experience.

· Advanced hands-on experience administering and configuring ServiceNow in a production enterprise environment.

· Experience building catalog solutions, flows, scripts, integrations, reports, dashboards, and other business-required platform enhancements.

· Strong working knowledge of JavaScript and common ServiceNow development and troubleshooting tools.

· Demonstrated ability to independently lead technical work from requirements and design through testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.

· Strong analytical, communication, mentoring, stakeholder partnership, and team collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

· ServiceNow Certified System Administrator required.

· ServiceNow Certified Application Developer preferred.

· Implementation certification or meaningful hands-on experience in SPM, ITSM, Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB, ITOM, HAM, SAM, or another relevant product area.

· Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine, ATF, source control, Platform Analytics, Now Assist, Virtual Agent, AI Search, or AI agents.

· ITIL Foundation certification and experience in a regulated, audited, or security-sensitive environment.

Work-at-home requirements

  • Must have the ability to provide a non-cellular High Speed Internet Service such as Fiber, DSL, or cable Modems for a home office.

  • A minimum standard speed for optimal performance of 30x5 (30mpbs download x 5mpbs upload) is required.

  • Latency (ping) response time lower than 80 ms

  • Hotspots, satellite and wireless internet service is NOT allowed for this role.

  • A dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

How we value you

  • Competitive pay/salary ranges

  • Incentive plan

  • Health/Vision/Dental benefits effective day one

  • 401(k) retirement plan: company match – dollar for dollar up to 4% employee contribution (pretax or Roth options) plus a 6% annual company contribution

  • Robust employee well-being program

  • Paid Time Off

  • Personal Community Enrichment Time

  • Company-provided Basic Life and AD&D

  • Company-provided Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

  • Tuition Assistance Program

While this is a remote opportunity, at this time G.E.H.A does not hire employees from U.S. territories or the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, California, Washington, Oregon, Colorado, Wyoming, Montana, New York, Connecticut, Vermont, Pennsylvania, Maine.

Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. G.E.H.A considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as, market and business considerations when extending an offer.

The target hiring range for this position is $108,696 - $137,507 USD. At G.E.H.A, the current maximum salary for this role is $153,222 USD. While initial compensation may vary based on experience and qualifications, there is a path to work toward this top rate through performance and continued growth within the organization.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

G.E.H.A is headquartered in Lee's Summit, Missouri, in the Kansas City area. We recognize the importance of balance and flexibility and offer hybrid and work-from-home options for many of our roles.

Advocate Medical Group (AMG) is part of Advocate Health, one of the nation’s largest nonprofit health systems. We offer the WATCHMAN™ procedure, an implant that rests in the left atrial appendage for patients who are not able to take blood thinners. Our offices are conveniently located off Technology Way near Winchester Road in Libertyville, IL, at 900 Technology Way, Libertyville, next to the Libertyville Business Park. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. title: Director of IT
description:
Hearst Television is seeking a Director of IT Operations to lead enterprise technology operations supporting approximately 30 television stations and business locations. This role is responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure while driving operational excellence across a geographically distributed organization.

Reporting to the Vice President of Information Technology, the Director provides strategic and technical leadership through collaboration with station leadership, Shared Services, Corporate IT, and external technology partners. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence teams and stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

this is an in-person position that requires periodic travel to Hearst Television locations and participation in an on-call rotation supporting critical technology operations.

What You'll Do

Lead enterprise IT operations that enable broadcast, business, and digital teams to operate securely, efficiently, and reliably. You'll establish technology standards, modernize infrastructure, strengthen cybersecurity, and leverage automation and AI-enabled tools to improve operational performance while partnering across the organization to support business priorities.

How You'll Use AI Here

Hearst Television is investing in AI-enabled technologies that improve operational efficiency, monitoring, documentation, and decision-making. You'll evaluate and implement AI capabilities responsibly while partnering with Shared Services Security to ensure appropriate governance, data protection, and risk management.

Responsibilities

Enterprise IT Operations

  • Lead day-to-day IT operations across approximately 30 Hearst Television locations, ensuring consistent service delivery and infrastructure reliability.

  • Establish and maintain enterprise standards for infrastructure, operational support, system availability, and technology lifecycle management.

Infrastructure & Cloud Strategy

  • Direct the design, deployment, and modernization of on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including virtualization, compute, storage, and backup platforms.

  • Develop long-term infrastructure roadmaps supporting scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

  • Partner with Shared Services Security to strengthen identity management, endpoint security, vulnerability management, privileged access, and multifactor authentication.

  • Guide secure infrastructure architecture, firewall standards, network segmentation, remote access, and incident response practices.

Network & Endpoint Services

  • Oversee enterprise networking including switching, routing, wireless infrastructure, connectivity, monitoring, and performance optimization.

  • Establish standards for endpoint management, operating system deployment, patch management, software distribution, and device lifecycle planning.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead technical incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and executive communications during operational events.

  • Develop operational metrics, documentation, runbooks, escalation procedures, and service performance reporting to improve consistency across all locations.

Financial & Vendor Management

  • Manage departmental budgets, forecasting, purchasing priorities, licensing, and technology investment planning.

  • Build strategic partnerships with technology vendors while overseeing contracts, renewals, service levels, and performance management.

Technology Modernization

  • Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives including virtualization upgrades, cloud adoption, and enterprise technology transformation projects.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled operational tools that improve efficiency while maintaining appropriate governance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with station leadership, Shared Services, Corporate IT, Finance, Procurement, Engineering, and business stakeholders to align technology investments with organizational priorities.

  • Influence local technology teams through collaboration, technical expertise, and enterprise standards without direct management authority.

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive Information Technology experience in enterprise or multi-site environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing complex technology operations across geographically distributed organizations.
  • Experience leading through collaboration, influence, and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Experience managing enterprise technology budgets, vendors, contracts, and service-level agreements.
  • Experience leading major incident response and supporting 24/7 operational environments.

Technical Expertise & Skills

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure including servers, virtualization, networking, storage, cloud services, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience administering Microsoft infrastructure and cloud technologies, including Microsoft 365 and Azure.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or VxRail.
  • Knowledge of Cisco networking, Palo Alto firewalls, Windows Server, and enterprise endpoint management solutions.
  • Strong understanding of identity management, Zero Trust principles, privileged access, vulnerability management, and endpoint security technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, automation technologies, and responsible implementation of AI-enabled operational tools.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical, planning, and organizational abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships across technical and business teams.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Relevant industry certifications are preferred.
  • Related military experience will be considered.

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories everyday. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected t the communities we serve.

Benefits

Hearst's benefit programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on you. As a Hearst employee, you and your spouse or partner or dependents would have access to the following benefits.

  • Medical | Dental | Vision
  • 401(k) matching
  • Emotional Wellness Support
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • LGBTQ+ Health Services
  • Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

title: Senior Director, Specialty Network Development
description:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Specialty Network Development leads the strategy, growth, and performance of Zelis’ specialty healthcare provider networks, including dental, vision, behavioral health, and other ancillary and complementary network segments. This role sets the multi-year vision for specialty network expansion and directs multiple teams and functions to build a diverse, cost-effective and access-rich provider ecosystem that supports Zelis clients across Commercial, Medicare Advantage, and other product lines.

Operating as an internal subject matter expert with direct impact on business objectives, this leader defines department strategy, leads multiple complex programs and initiatives simultaneously, and drives resourcing and direction across subordinate directors and managers who own day-to-day execution. The role is approximately 60% strategic and 40% tactical, with erroneous strategic decisions carrying business impact that can extend beyond one year.

What you'll do:

Network Strategy & Growth

  • Own the overall strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for building and expanding Zelis’ specialty healthcare networks — including dental, vision, behavioral health, and other ancillary and complementary care networks — to increase savings and access for Zelis clients.
  • Cultivate the organization’s direct-contracted specialty provider assets to support multiple products and achieve corporate objectives for network viability and product performance.
  • Establish strategic relationships across all specialty provider types, including large and key strategic groups and multi-site provider organizations, and serve as the primary resource for network partners across markets.
  • Serve as the enterprise subject matter expert on Zelis specialty network products, representing network capabilities internally and with external partners, industry groups, and professional societies.
  • Align network strategy with the Product team to ensure contracting goals support the long-term Network Solutions product roadmap; collaborate cross-functionally to define acceptance and launch criteria for new specialty network products.
  • Ensure network and contracting strategy balances client access requirements with cost-savings objectives across all specialty lines of business.

Contracting & Business Execution

  • Direct and negotiate complex, high-value contracts across multiple specialty provider types and coach the contracting organization to drive network development efficiency.
  • Execute corporate contracting strategy across multiple product lines, including Commercial, Medicare Advantage, and other emerging specialty product segments.
  • Partner with business operations to define contract terms and educate key company personnel on the implications of those terms.
  • Develop and communicate specialty network development goals, including target acquisitions, claim dollars captured, and revenue achieved, and build the tools needed to capture provider targets, measure performance, and report results and recommendations to the executive team.

Team & Talent Leadership

  • Lead a large team and manage people directly, driving and implementing talent strategies related to hiring, promotions, pay, performance assessment, and talent development, while identifying and cultivating high potential.
  • Drive talent strategy broadly and provide people-related decisions that foster a diverse and inclusive environment; sponsor and actively participate in diversity strategy and execution across the department and the Enterprise.
  • Role model success in the execution of talent systems such as performance management and development, and champion and promote diversity, inclusion, and wellness.
  • Recruit, coach, and mentor the Network Development leadership team, building bench strength and succession depth across subordinate directors and managers.

Innovation & Enterprise Impact

  • Champion enterprise-wide AI transformation within network development, embedding AI into core operating models to unlock competitive advantage, improve scalability, and drive long-term value creation.
  • Lead the development of new methods and approaches to solve company-wide network matters, bringing breakthrough ideas that create differentiated value for Zelis and its clients.
  • Establish and develop broader company strategy as it relates to specialty network development, translating that strategy into multi-functional objectives across teams and departments.

What you'll bring to Zelis:

  • Master’s degree plus 10+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and demonstrated professional accomplishment.
  • 10+ years of experience in dental, vision, behavioral health, and/or other specialty or group health network product management.
  • 5+ years of experience with provider contracting and negotiations, network development and configuration, and standards for specialty network contracting.
  • Demonstrated accomplishment and followership in the specialty network subject matter area, both internally and externally, with a track record of presenting work to department members, external consultants, and professional societies, and contributing to high-quality publications or media opportunities.
  • Leadership ability with cross-functional teams; knows how to get things done through both formal channels and the informal network.
  • Ability to understand and prioritize provider challenges while proactively identifying and driving solutions.
  • Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to apply data and analytics to strategic decisions.
  • Strong organizational and project/process management skills.
  • Strong negotiation, problem-solving, planning, and decision-making skills.
  • Proven critical thinking skills and the ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems.

Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.


Location and Workplace Flexibility

title: Patient Transportation
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Provides safe, courteous and efficient transportation services throughout the hospital environment to support the goal of providing the highest level of patient care to maximize customer satisfaction.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education:

  1. High School education or equivalent.

Experience:

  1. Preference is given to individuals with prior employment in a position which included direct patient care responsibilities or who have completed a patient care training program.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  1. Ability to follow instructions and perform routine tasks carefully and properly.
  2. Must have physical capabilities to handle patients in a safe manner.
  3. Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with team members as well as with employees of other departments.
  4. Demonstrated commitment to functioning in a manner that places appropriate emphasis on customer satisfaction.

License/Certification/Registration:

  1. Meets he American Heart Association’s standards for Healthcare Provider Basic Life Support (BLS) and renews BLS every two years.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Receives general supervision from the Nursing House Supervisor and Director, Acute Care Services.

SUPERVISION GIVEN

None.

﻿

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Performs escort duties as assigned and according to approved hospital and department policies and procedures.
    1. Greets visitors, patients, staff, and volunteers pleasantly and courteously.
    2. Accurately identifies patient by addressing the patient by name and checking identification band on each patient prior to transport.
    3. Surveys and prepares environment for safe movement of patient and equipment.
    4. Communicates with assigned nurse to coordinate appropriate patient preparation and transport.
    5. Inspects transport equipment for serviceability; reports problems immediately to Supervisor for repair.
    6. Prepares patient for transport as determined by assigned nurse.
    7. Transfers or assists with transfer of persons to/from bed to litter and/or wheelchair using proper body mechanics and appropriate equipment.
    8. Transports patients by wheelchair, litter, or as required along with equipment and/or belongings that must accompany patients for diagnostic testing, treatments, admissions, discharges and/or transfers.
    9. Provides visitor escort as well as transportation of items as detailed in policies and procedures.
    10. Obtains patient clinical chart and any other pertinent paperwork (such as diagnostic requests) from nursing unit and delivers to the appropriate area with the patient or item.
    11. Provides escort service to patients who require special needs. Including, but not limited to, oxygen, IV, and suction apparatus.
    12. Observes patients who need special attention during transport. Immediately advises personnel of potential problems or changes noted in patient's condition. Remains with unruly patients until another member of the Hospital staff can assume the supervision of that patient.
    13. Assists patients upon return to their room to meet safety and comfort needs.
    14. Returns equipment to designated areas.
    15. Monitors the schedule for needed transports in Expanse and checks frequently for phone messages.
    16. Participates in cooperative coordination of activities as needed with volunteers.
    17. Transports items as directed such as but not limited to specimens, charts, and inter-office mail.
    18. Performs other duties and responsibilities related to the job classification and nursing department operations as assigned.
  2. Maintains current knowledge of Hospital Policies and Procedures.
    1. Demonstrates constant awareness and compliance with departmental and hospital policies.
    2. Demonstrates continuous adherence to safety, infection control and quality improvement standards. Uses infection control protective and safety devices provided. Advises supervisors of potential hazards if noted.
  3. Utilizes communication skills to maintain a positive work environment.
    1. Attends and participates in 50% of scheduled department meetings.
    2. Uses assertive communication and active listening skills in conflict resolution.
    3. Maintains communication with supervisor and seeks assistance when needed.
    4. Participates in orientation of new staff as assigned.

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Performs all other related and miscellaneous duties as assigned.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to help build reliable, scalable, and intuitive internal enterprise web applications for Extra Space Storage. This role sits on the Internal Application engineering team and partners closely with product management, operations stakeholders, UX designers, and engineering peers to deliver software that powers our day-to-day store operations, transactional workflows, document management, and retail systems. The ideal candidate is self-driven, thrives in a collaborative agile environment, and is adept at translating complex operational workflows into high-quality technical solutions using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, scalable APIs, and robust engineering practices.

  • Architect & Build Internal Solutions: Translate operational and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and reliable solutions across our suite of internal business and store-management platforms.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product managers, operational stakeholders, and UX designers to create streamlined workflows that improve day-to-day efficiency and user experience for internal teams.
  • Technical Design & Discovery: Participate in technical design, discovery, and architecture planning sessions; document technical designs; evaluate tradeoffs; and ensure alignment with business goals, maintainability, and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Integrations & Platform Services: Extend and modernize core platform capabilities, including integrations with third-party services.
  • UI/UX Implementation: Ensure technical feasibility and high-fidelity implementation of UI/UX designs, focusing on usability, responsiveness, and speed for high-volume internal operational users.
  • Modern Engineering Practices: Leverage approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate routine development, explore implementation strategies, and improve overall team velocity.
  • Operational Excellence & Reliability: Drive production readiness through automated unit/integration testing, peer code reviews, CI/CD pipeline improvements, observability/monitoring, SLA/SLO adherence, and incident response.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience building web applications using modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular).
  • Demonstrated experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with enterprise backend services.
  • Experience working within an Agile/Scrum delivery lifecycle.
  • Proficiency with modern version control and collaboration workflows using Git.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on writing clean, modular, and well-tested code.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency and hands-on experience with React and modern state management.
  • Experience building and maintaining backend services and APIs using Node.js / Express, with familiarity or experience in .NET / C# for supporting services.
  • Experience with Git-based CI/CD automation, AWS cloud infrastructure, and automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end).
  • Experience developing enterprise software involving complex domain workflows (e.g., retail/point-of-sale systems, document management, payment gateways, e-signatures, or telephony integrations).
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and NoSQL data stores (DynamoDB).
  • Familiarity with enterprise software performance tuning, caching strategies, and service reliability/observability (SLAs, SLOs, logging, and metrics).

Performs sedentary work in an office environment with limited lifting (less than 10 pounds) or walking required. Close visual acuity required to perform work at computer terminal. Atrium Health Cardiology provides comprehensive cardiovascular care across the continuum, from preventive heart health and diagnostic testing to advanced treatment and long-term disease management. Exercise Physiologists are integral members of the cardiology team, working alongside cardiologists, advanced practice providers, nurses, and rehabilitation specialists to support patients with a variety of cardiovascular conditions. This role focuses on exercise testing, patient education, risk factor modification, and the development of safe, individualized exercise programs that help improve cardiovascular health, functional capacity, and overall quality of life in a patient-centered environment.

This position floats across greater Charlotte, NC area locations.

Job Description:
Performs and coordinates a variety of diagnostic procedures with the Cardiology service line.

Major Responsibilities

  • Coordinates and performs exercise and/or pharmacological stress testing following the standards and guidelines of the ACSM/AHA/ACC and the current policies and procedures of Diagnostic Cardiology.

  • Explains the procedure, verifies the order, and confirms patient identity

  • Assists with transferring patients on/off equipment and provides assistance with adaptive positioning to maximize safety and performance.

  • Recognizes electrocardiographic changes and arrythmias pre-test, during testing, and post-test to ensure diagnostic information is obtained in a safe and controlled environment.

  • Communicates abnormal results to the physician, clinical staff, operations manager or nurse manager.

  • Responds to emergency situations in a professional and prompt manner.

  • In coordination with related staff may also cross train.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Exercise Physiology required.

  • Exercise Physiologist certified by the American College of Sports Medicine or eligible to test for the same.
  • Basic Life Support for Healthcare Provider (BLS HCP) from AHA is required. ACLS required within 6 months of hire date.
  • Additional certifications may be required by the department.
  • If performing stress tests, successful completion of the exercise physiology competencies including the use of pharmacological stress testing agents required.

  • Hearing (corrected) adequate for oral/aural communication with patients, staff, family, visitors, etc. Vision (corrected) adequate for reading.

  • Must be able to transfer patients.
  • Must be able to demonstrate any appropriate exercise and activities to patients/caregivers.
  • Work is in a fast-paced clinical environment.

Preferred Job Requirements

Education

  • Master's Degree in Exercise Physiology preferred.

Experience

  • One year of related experience preferred. Experience in stress testing preferred.

Certification / Registration / License

  • ACSM-CEP (Clinical Exercise Physiologist) is preferred, required for stress testing.

Role: Product Manager – Product Strategy & Growth

Location: Bangalore

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more.
