We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role: This role defines product strategy and drives business growth by translating market and stakeholder needs into actionable priorities. The Product Manager identifies growth opportunities through adoption analysis, assesses product potential, and develops commercial strategies, including pricing and offering tiers. The role oversees the product lifecycle—from roadmap prioritization and development tracking to launch and post-launch feedback—while connecting stakeholders, engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success. It also monitors competitors and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation.


Job Responsibilities:


1. Product Strategy & Business Case

• Define the product vision, strategy, and value proposition aligned to business objectives.

• Build business cases covering market opportunity, customer need, competitive positioning, revenue potential, investment, and ROI.

• Develop financial models, pricing scenarios, and commercialization strategies.

• Present investment recommendations to leadership; track market trends and emerging technology to drive innovation.

2. Pricing & Commercial Strategy

• Define pricing, packaging, and monetization models; benchmark against competitive pricing.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and business leaders to optimize commercial models.

• Monitor profitability, ARR, margin, adoption, and customer lifetime value, and recommend pricing adjustments.


3. Roadmap & Prioritization

• Own and maintain the product roadmap; translate opportunities into initiatives, epics, and releases.

• Facilitate prioritization workshops balancing customer need, business value, technical feasibility, and strategy.

• Apply prioritization frameworks based on ROI, customer impact, and market demand.

• Drive alignment across engineering, UX, customer success, sales, and executive stakeholders.


4. Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business and customer requirements.

• Author PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional/non-functional specifications.

• Work with UX and Engineering to refine solutions and validate technical feasibility.

• Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and product reviews.


5. Launch & Adoption

• Define launch, enablement, and adoption strategies; execute go-to-market plans with Marketing and Sales.

• Drive onboarding, customer training, and customer success initiatives.

• Track adoption, usage, engagement, retention, and revenue performance.

• Identify adoption barriers, act on post-release feedback, and improve value realization.


6. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership

• Act as the primary point of contact for product decisions across internal and external stakeholders.

• Facilitate consensus and decision-making across diverse groups.

• Report roadmap progress, product performance, risks, and opportunities; influence strategy with data-driven recommendations.


7. Performance & Analytics

• Define and track product KPIs and success metrics.

• Measure adoption, retention, revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and ROI.

• Maintain executive dashboards and lead periodic product performance reviews.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, or Computer Science; or an MBA with specialization in Product Management.

• 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or Product Strategy roles.

• Demonstrated experience across business case development, pricing and commercialization, roadmap management, requirements documentation, and go-to-market execution.

• Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

• Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum product development methodologies.

• Strong analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving capability.

• Experience with SaaS, digital, or platform products and subscription-based business models.

• Exposure to product analytics tooling and data-driven decision-making.

• Experience managing products across multiple markets, segments, or channel partners.

title: Financial Reporting, AVP
description:
Who we are looking for:

Responsible for the end-to-end oversight of complex reporting services across multiple client relationships and global regions. The role provides leadership across service delivery, client stewardship, risk and controls, workforce planning, talent development, and transformation.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders while translating business priorities into disciplined execution.

Why this role is important to us:

The team you will be joining is part of State Street Global Delivery (SSGD). SSGD gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGD’s tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for:

As Financial Reporting, Assistant Vice President, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of complex periodic and ad hoc financial statements, disclosures, and related regulatory reporting across multiple client relationships, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, quality, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and client requirements.
  • Provide leadership across one or more teams or service portfolios, translating business priorities into clear delivery plans, governance routines, performance expectations, and measurable outcomes.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for material delivery, client, people, and control matters; assess business impact, make balanced decisions, and ensure timely communication, remediation, and closure.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients, auditors, and global stakeholders; shape service expectations, lead senior-level discussions, and identify opportunities to strengthen client experience, service quality, and sustainable business growth.
  • Lead workforce and capacity planning across reporting cycles, including resource allocation, succession planning, capability development, and contingency planning to support resilient and scalable delivery.
  • Lead staff management activities, including recruitment, goal setting, performance management, coaching, engagement, and talent development, while building leadership capability and accountability within the team.
  • Maintain a strong risk and control environment by overseeing adherence to policies and procedures, reviewing control effectiveness, identifying emerging operational risks, and sponsoring sustainable corrective actions.
  • Sponsor and govern new fund launches, client onboarding, migrations, conversions, and operating model changes, ensuring appropriate readiness, stakeholder alignment, risk assessment, and post-implementation stabilization.
  • Drive transformation, standardization, and automation by prioritizing opportunities, developing business cases, partnering with Operations and Technology, and ensuring benefits are realized without compromising control or service quality.
  • Oversee the quality and sustainability of SOPs, process flows, governance documentation, and training frameworks, ensuring knowledge is transferable, and processes remain audit ready.
  • Contribute to department strategy, cross-functional initiatives, and broader organizational priorities through data-informed recommendations, disciplined execution, and effective change leadership.

What we value:

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • Strategic and enterprise thinking, with the ability to connect client, operational, people, risk, and technology considerations when setting priorities and making decisions.
  • Strong leadership and influencing skills, with a proven ability to build trust, create accountability, develop talent, and lead through ambiguity and change.
  • Sound technical and commercial judgment, supported by strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with a track record of simplifying processes, strengthening controls, and delivering scalable operational outcomes.

Education & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Postgraduates (CA/CPA/ACCA/CFA qualified) preferably or bachelor's degree with Big 4 or mid-tier accounting firm relevant experience
  • At least 10 years of experience in a financial reporting or financial services environment. 4-5 years of supervisory experience is required.
  • Good understanding of managed investment funds, financial services, investment products, relevant accounting standards, and applicability.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships, operational risk, workforce planning, and multi-stakeholder service delivery in a global environment.
  • Proven experience leading migrations, conversions, automation, process transformation, or operating model improvement initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex matters clearly and influence stakeholders at different levels.
  • Good knowledge of Internal Systems, MS office (excel, word)
  • Data & Analysis - Possess strong attention to detail. Demonstrate good analytical skills in resolving the team issues and facilitates decision making

Additional requirements:

· Ability to work across time zones when required to support global stakeholders and report deadlines.

· Flexibility to support peak reporting periods and critical business events.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. description:

Are you looking for a varied and rewarding role where your judgement, communication skills and planning knowledge can make a real difference to communities?

Our Planning Service is central to shaping sustainable, well-designed places across Wiltshire. We support responsible growth by making robust, proportionate and policy-led decisions that help deliver new homes, employment opportunities and high-quality places in line with our adopted Local Plan.

We are seeking a motivated Planning Enforcement Officer to join our friendly and experienced team on a 12-month maternity cover contract. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with planning or regulatory experience who enjoys problem-solving, site-based investigation, negotiation and working with a wide range of people.

As part of our Enforcement Team, you will help maintain public confidence in the planning system by investigating alleged breaches of planning control and securing positive, practical outcomes.

No two days are the same: you will manage a varied caseload, balance negotiation with proportionate enforcement action, and help remedy planning harm while protecting local amenity and supporting sustainable development.

In this role, you will investigate matters such as unauthorised development, listed buildings, advertisements, protected trees and changes of use. You will assess evidence, visit sites, liaise with applicants, agents, complainants, elected members and partner services, and decide the most appropriate course of action. Depending on the case, this may include resolving matters through negotiation, preparing formal reports and notices, supporting appeals, drafting witness statements and contributing to prosecution files where necessary.

About you

  • You may already have experience in planning enforcement, development management, conservation, regulatory investigation or another relevant field; alternatively, you may bring equivalent experience and transferable skills from a related role.
  • You will be confident applying legislation, policy or procedures in a fair, balanced and proportionate way, and keen to develop your knowledge of planning enforcement practice.
  • You will enjoy investigating issues, assessing evidence, visiting sites, identifying planning harm and making sound recommendations based on the facts of each case.
  • You will be a clear and confident communicator, able to explain decisions, manage sensitive conversations and prepare well-structured reports, correspondence, notices or statements.
  • You will be organised, resilient and comfortable managing a varied caseload, balancing competing priorities and working effectively with colleagues, customers, elected members and partner services.

Carrier is the leading worldwide provider of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), refrigeration, fire, security, and cold chain solutions. We invented the modern air conditioning, and our team of pioneers and innovators have a long history of developing new technologies.


Addvolt, now part of Carrier, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, delivers advanced electrification technology, integrated power management and power electronics capabilities for transport refrigeration and auxiliary systems. Driving innovation in the electrification and decarbonization of onboard systems for refrigerated trailers, trucks, vans and containers, Addvolt empowers fleets to avoid fuel usage, reduce major emissions and operate efficiently at a remarkably low noise level. By combining Addvolt’s innovative power solutions with Carrier Transicold’s expertise in transport refrigeration, we are enhancing the value we deliver to fleets, original equipment manufacturers and logistics operators worldwide. Together with Carrier, we are accelerating the transition to a more sustainable, efficient and intelligent cold chain.


We are looking for an Hardware Engineer with strong technical expertise in electronics design and a passion for turning concepts into robust, manufacturable products.


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing schematics, developing PCB layouts, and executing PCB validation and testing activities, using Altium as the main design tool.


We value a proactive attitude, good communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team, collaborating with different areas of the business.

A passionate professional that wants to participate in the new cycle of clean energies who is looking for an ambitious challenge.

You will be able to be in close contact with stakeholders to determine the requirements and improvements for the new designs.


RESPONSABILITIES

  • Design electronic schematics for power electronics and control boards, based on system-level requirements and specifications
  • Develop PCB layouts in Altium Designer, considering signal integrity, EMC/EMI, thermal management, and manufacturability (DFM/DFA)
  • Select components (connectors, ICs, passives, power devices) and define footprints, ensuring availability and compliance with project requirements
  • Define and execute PCB test plans, including bring-up, functional testing, debugging, and validation of prototypes
  • Support bring-up and troubleshooting of new boards, using lab equipment (oscilloscope, multimeter, power supplies, thermal camera) to identify and resolve issues
  • Collaborate with firmware, system, and mechanical engineers to ensure correct hardware-software-mechanical integration
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including schematics, layout files, BOMs, test reports, and design reviews
  • Support manufacturing and industrialization activities, working closely with PCB/PCBA suppliers to resolve production issues
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant industry standards and quality/safety requirements
  • Stay current with industry trends, components, and best practices in electronics design, leveraging new capabilities internally

CANDIDATE VALUES AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in hardware design, schematics capture, and PCB layout
  • Proficiency in Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB layout

title: Director, Commercial Strategy & Growth
description:
The Director, Commercial Strategy drives disciplined commercial performance and growth for assigned Nabors businesses and markets by executing commercial strategy, market intelligence, go-to-market plans, sales excellence, pricing and tender governance, technology commercialization, and investment economics. The role works with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Marketing, Product, and Technology to improve pricing realization, margin, tender outcomes, and customer value, and prepares recommendations for executive decision while operating within approved risk tolerance and delegation of authority.

As Director, Commercial Strategy, you will shape how Nabors competes, grows, and turns drilling expertise and technology into customer value. You’ll connect market insights, pricing, customer opportunities, and investment economics to drive profitable growth across assigned businesses and markets. This is an opportunity to influence executive decisions, bring innovative offerings to market, and work across commercial and technical teams to turn strategy into measurable results.

Commercial Strategy, Market Intelligence & Growth Planning
Primary Skills: Corporate Strategy • Market Analysis • Marketing Research • Business Forecasting
  • Translate corporate and drilling-business priorities into annual commercial plans, growth initiatives, performance measures, and execution priorities for assigned markets and offerings.
  • Manage market intelligence, customer segmentation, competitor analysis, demand forecasting, and market-pricing assessments for assigned markets and offerings.
  • Monitor customer spending patterns, fleet utilization, industry developments, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities and emerging commercial risks.
  • Translate market and customer insights into recommendations on commercial priorities, pricing, investment, and partnerships for leadership review.
  • Prepare market assessments and maintain a forward-looking view of market conditions to support commercial decisions.
Go-to-Market Strategy, Sales Excellence & Commercial Performance
Primary Skills: Marketing Strategies • Sales Optimization • Sales Forecasting • Performance Analysis
  • Develop and execute go-to-market plans for drilling services, technologies, automation, software, and integrated commercial offerings within approved strategy.
  • Define target customer segments, value propositions, commercialization pathways, and customer-adoption approaches for assigned offerings.
  • Manage Sales Excellence analytics and support activities and implement standard commercial processes, opportunity tracking, forecasting, reporting, and performance metrics across assigned regions and business lines.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Technology to align go-to-market execution with customer demand and growth priorities.
  • Monitor go-to-market and commercial performance and recommend actions based on customer adoption, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, value capture, and market conditions.
Pricing Strategy, Tender Management & Commercial Governance
Primary Skills: Pricing Support • Revenue Management • Opportunity Management • Risk Analysis
  • Maintain pricing guidance, customer value models, contract structures, and commercial frameworks for the Lower 48 drilling fleet and other assigned business scopes.
  • Conduct commercial reviews for bids, tenders, contract renewals, pricing exceptions, and negotiation strategies, escalating significant or strategic opportunities to leadership.
  • Coordinate tender and bid-strategy development, including win strategy, commercial positioning, cross-functional inputs, milestones, assumptions, risks, and decision points.
  • Support customer negotiations and ensure commercial recommendations and submissions align with approved objectives, risk tolerance, and delegation of authority.
  • Track pricing realization, tender activity, win performance, opportunity status, and lessons learned to improve future decisions and margin performance.
Strategic Partnerships, Business Development & Technology Commercialization
Primary Skills: Business Development and Growth • Business Development Plans • Technology Marketing • Project Leadership
  • Support commercial development of approved strategic partnerships, alliances, technology-integration opportunities, and other growth initiatives.
  • Serve as commercial lead for assigned initiatives from opportunity identification through business-case development, negotiation support, implementation planning, and value realization.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Technology to commercialize Nabors technologies and develop commercial models for deployment opportunities.
  • Support bundling of drilling services, automation, software, and performance-based offerings into differentiated customer solutions and new revenue opportunities.
  • Assess customer value, commercial risk, resource requirements, adoption potential, and expected return for proposed growth initiatives.
Fleet Investment, Customer Economics & Commercial Analytics
Primary Skills: Internal Valuation • Financial Analysis • Capital Budgeting • Research Analysis
  • Perform commercial evaluation of rig reactivations, major rebuilds, capital upgrades, deployments, and fleet-optimization initiatives.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to develop credible project scope, cost estimates, utilization assumptions, commercial inputs, and implementation considerations.
  • Develop customer value models, economic comparisons, investment analyses, and financial models supporting negotiations, capital decisions, and strategic opportunities.
  • Evaluate investment returns, demand, pricing, risk, and value creation and provide leadership with scenarios, tradeoffs, and recommendations.
  • Analyze commercial and financial performance and recommend corrective actions where results differ from approved assumptions or plans.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Organizational Alignment
Primary Skills: Cross-functional Teamwork • Strategic Leadership • Business Judgment • Communication Skills
  • Coordinate Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Marketing, Product, and Technology activities for assigned opportunities and initiatives.
  • Maintain clear accountabilities, review cadences, escalation points, and deliverables for cross-functional work.
  • Drive timely decision follow-through and project execution while escalating matters outside delegated authority.
  • Present commercial insights, recommendations, economics, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders, customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Build commercial capability within the team through standard practices, tools, knowledge sharing, coaching, and lessons learned.
Additionally,
  • Represent Nabors in customer, partner, industry, and internal forums relevant to commercial strategy and growth.
  • Develop commercial playbooks, analytical tools, training materials, case studies, and process-improvement recommendations.
  • Support commercial due diligence, integration planning, and other strategic reviews when requested by leadership.
  • Perform other related duties consistent with the position’s purpose and level.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant commercial leadership experience may be considered.
Required
  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in commercial strategy, market intelligence, go-to-market strategy, sales excellence, pricing, tender management, business development, technology commercialization, fleet economics, or related B2B commercial roles.
  • 3–5 years leading commercial teams, cross-functional initiatives, or matrixed teams.
  • Demonstrated experience with market analysis, customer segmentation, go-to-market planning, pricing, tender or bid support, customer negotiations, business cases, forecasting, and commercial performance analysis.
  • Working knowledge of drilling-business economics, fleet utilization, capital investment evaluation, technology-enabled offerings, and customer value drivers.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop financial models and recommendations for commercial and investment decisions.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and coordinate work across Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Marketing, Product, and Technology.
  • Ability to travel to customer, partner, industry, and company locations when required for essential responsibilities.
Preferred
  • MBA or another relevant advanced degree.
  • Experience in land drilling, oilfield services, industrial technology, or another asset-intensive B2B environment.
  • Experience supporting market-intelligence programs, go-to-market planning, tenders, contract renewals, or pricing governance.
  • Experience commercializing automation, software, performance-based services, or integrated drilling offerings.
  • Experience evaluating rig reactivations, major rebuilds, fleet deployments, capital upgrades, or similar investment decisions.

description:
Job Title: Resourcing Specialist - Cybersecurity

Job type: Full-Time Permanent



About us:


Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by eight Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Paris, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.

With over 900 employees, including more than 600 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.


At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.



The opportunity:



At Integrity360, our people and their expertise are central to the services we deliver. We are looking for a commercially minded and highly organised Professional Services Resource Planning Specialist to help us match the right skills and capacity to customer demand.


You will sit at the heart of our Professional Services operation, working closely with delivery leaders, project managers, sales and finance. Through effective resource planning, reporting and stakeholder coordination, you will help us improve utilisation, support revenue delivery and provide greater visibility of capacity and future demand.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving environment, working with data and collaborating across multiple teams and regions.



What you will do:



  • Coordinate the allocation of Professional Services consultants across customer projects and internal initiatives.
  • Maintain an accurate view of consultant capacity, availability, skills and planned assignments.
  • Work with delivery leaders and project managers to anticipate resource requirements and resolve scheduling conflicts.
  • Partner with sales and delivery teams to understand upcoming demand across the pipeline and backlog.
  • Identify available capacity and connect relevant skills with upcoming customer opportunities.
  • Monitor utilisation and highlight emerging risks, gaps and opportunities.
  • Produce clear, accurate reporting on capacity, utilisation, backlog, pipeline and resource demand.
  • Support revenue forecasting and accrual processes by working closely with Professional Services and finance teams.
  • Monitor time-recording compliance and help resolve missing or inaccurate submissions.
  • Maintain reliable resource planning data across relevant systems and reporting tools.
  • Support workforce planning by identifying skills gaps, recruitment requirements and potential subcontractor needs.
  • Recommend improvements to resource planning processes, reporting and operational ways of working.



What you will bring:



  • Experience in resource planning, workforce planning, Professional Services operations, PMO, project coordination or a similar environment.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Confidence working with data and translating it into clear, practical insight.
  • Advanced or strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with Power BI, resource management platforms, PSA tools or project management systems would be beneficial.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Commercial awareness, with an understanding of utilisation, capacity, revenue, pipeline or project-based delivery.
  • A proactive and solutions-focused approach.
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate information.
  • The ability to work effectively with colleagues across different teams, disciplines and geographical regions.
  • Experience within cybersecurity, technology, consulting or another Professional Services environment would be advantageous, but it does not need to be mandatory.



What success looks like:



In this role, success means:

  • Delivery teams have a reliable view of capacity and availability.
  • Consultants are assigned to work that aligns with their skills and experience.
  • Resource conflicts and delivery risks are identified early.
  • Leadership has clear insight into utilisation, demand and skills gaps.
  • Sales, delivery and finance work from consistent and accurate information.
    Available capacity is proactively connected with customer demand.



Why join Integrity360?



Integrity360 provides an opportunity to build your career within a growing cybersecurity organisation operating across multiple regions.


You will work with talented colleagues across Professional Services, project management, sales and finance, while gaining broad exposure to how a modern cybersecurity services business operates. You will have the opportunity to improve processes, influence decision-making and make a visible contribution to the performance and growth of the business.


We value collaboration, accountability, continuous learning and new ideas. You will be encouraged to bring your experience, challenge existing ways of working and help us build a more scalable and data-led resource planning capability.

title: Senior SQL Database Administrator
description:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing complex database environments to ensure security, integrity, and high availability. This role provides advanced support for mission-critical systems, leads performance tuning initiatives, and contributes to strategic improvements in database architecture. This role operates with minimal supervision and collaborates across teams to deliver scalable and reliable solutions.

The Senior Database Engineer at Zelis is a hands-on technical role responsible for the engineering, administration, performance, modernization, and operational reliability of enterprise database platforms across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This role supports business-critical databases with a focus on performance, availability, monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management. A key priority is modernizing the Zelis database estate, including migrating and re-platforming applications from Microsoft SQL Server to strategic platforms such as PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The Senior Database Engineer will work directly with application and engineering teams to assess schemas, queries, stored procedures, dependencies, and data access patterns and execute the technical work required to migrate, optimize, and operate these workloads. This position requires deep hands-on database engineering and DBA expertise, strong production troubleshooting skills, and experience with cloud database technologies, automation, monitoring, and Infrastructure as Code.



As a Senior Database Engineer at Zelis, you will be responsible for the hands-on engineering, administration, performance, modernization, and operational support of enterprise database platforms across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on-premises environments. This role is focused on the day-to-day engineering and operation of business-critical databases, including database performance, availability, monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management.


A primary focus of this role over the next two to three years will be the hands-on migration and re-platforming of applications away from Microsoft SQL Server where appropriate, with an emphasis on PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. You will work directly with application and engineering teams to analyze existing databases, schemas, queries, stored procedures, and data access patterns and perform the technical work required to migrate and optimize workloads on strategic database platforms.


This position requires strong hands-on DBA and database engineering skills and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve database issues in production environments. You will spend the majority of your time working directly with database platforms, SQL, automation, monitoring, Infrastructure as Code, migrations, performance tuning, and operational tooling.


Key Responsibilities:

· Engineer, administer, maintain, and support enterprise database platforms across AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments, including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS for SQL Server, SQL Server on Amazon EC2, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines.

· Perform hands-on database performance engineering, including query tuning, execution plan analysis, schema tuning, index design and optimization, statistics maintenance and analysis, stored procedure optimization, database configuration, and analysis of application data access patterns.

· Troubleshoot and resolve production database issues involving performance degradation, blocking, deadlocks, locking, resource contention, CPU, memory, storage, connectivity, capacity, availability, and database configuration.

· Perform hands-on migration and re-platforming of databases and applications from Microsoft SQL Server to PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and other strategic database platforms.

· Execute database migration activities including discovery, compatibility assessment, schema conversion, data migration, remediation, testing, performance validation, cutover, rollback, and post-migration optimization.

· Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain SQL Server and PostgreSQL database environments while ensuring database platforms remain current, supportable, secure, and compliant with established standards.

· Configure, maintain, test, and troubleshoot database high availability, backup and restore, disaster recovery, replication, resiliency, and recovery capabilities.

· Implement and maintain database telemetry, observability, monitoring, and alerting using IDERA, AWS-native monitoring capabilities, and other database monitoring tools.

· Analyze database telemetry and performance data to proactively identify query performance problems, capacity constraints, resource contention, configuration issues, and emerging operational risks.

· Participate in 24x7 production support and on-call rotations, responding to database incidents, troubleshooting problems, restoring service, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions.

· Develop and maintain automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for database provisioning, configuration, deployment, maintenance, monitoring, patching, upgrades, and other repeatable database engineering activities.

· Use Git, GitHub, CI/CD, VS Code or other IDEs, peer review, and version control to develop and maintain database scripts, SQL code, automation, Infrastructure as Code, and engineering assets.

· Use AI-assisted engineering tools including ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot to assist with SQL development, troubleshooting, performance analysis, scripting, automation, migrations, and documentation.

· Work directly with application engineers to identify and remediate inefficient queries, database schemas, indexes, stored procedures, data access patterns, and other application-related causes of database performance problems.

Experience migrating Microsoft SQL Server workloads to PostgreSQL or Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL is strongly preferred.

· Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting database monitoring, telemetry, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery. Experience using IDERA, AWS-native observability services, or comparable database monitoring platforms is preferred.

· Experience with Microsoft Azure database platforms, including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and SQL Server on Azure VMs, is preferred but not required. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or GitHub Copilot to improve troubleshooting, scripting, automation, and engineering productivity is also preferred.

title: Alpha Data Services – Product Dependency Lead – Vice President
description:
Alpha Data Services is seeking an experienced Product Dependency Lead to establish and operate the Product Dependency Management capability across strategic programmes and support the function’s transition towards an AI-enabled operating model.

Reporting to the ADS Product Delivery Lead, the role will provide day-to-day leadership of dependency governance and create an integrated view of product commitments, sequencing and delivery constraints. Working across Product, Delivery, Technology, Operations and client-facing teams, the successful candidate will support timely decisions, clear accountability and predictable client outcomes.

This role combines structured governance, cross-functional coordination and data-led insight to strengthen delivery confidence and improve how dependencies are assessed, managed and resolved.

Responsibilities

Capability, Governance and AI Enablement

  • Partner with the ADS Product Delivery Lead to establish, embed and continuously improve the Product Dependency Management capability.
  • Lead the day-to-day operation of dependency governance across strategic programmes, ensuring consistent processes, controls and decision-making.
  • Champion the transition to an AI-first operating model by identifying, prioritising and embedding responsible AI use cases across dependency management workflows.

Dependency Assessment and Planning

  • Assess programme scope and delivery plans to identify cross-product, technology, operational and implementation dependencies at the earliest opportunity.
  • Use AI-assisted analysis to identify emerging dependencies, delivery conflicts, patterns and risks across programme plans, roadmaps and governance data, with appropriate human review and oversight.
  • Maintain an integrated view of product roadmaps, milestones, sequencing and client outcomes, highlighting gaps, conflicts and delivery risk.
  • Own the dependency register, ensuring each dependency has a clear description, impact, accountable owner, target date, status and resolution plan.
  • Support roadmap and release planning by ensuring product commitments are aligned to programme priorities, capacity constraints and client delivery timelines.

Stakeholder Coordination and Resolution

  • Coordinate Product, Delivery, Technology, Operations and programme stakeholders to validate dependencies, agree priorities and drive actions to closure.
  • Facilitate dependency reviews and governance forums, preparing decision-ready materials and escalating unresolved issues through the appropriate channels.
  • Drive dependency resolution by clarifying impacts, developing options, securing decisions and tracking agreed mitigations through to completion.

Reporting, Insight and Continuous Improvement

  • Produce concise dashboards and executive reporting covering dependency status, risks, milestones, ownership, decisions and next steps.
  • Apply AI and automation to streamline dependency tracking, programme assessments, reporting and management information, improving data quality, efficiency and forward-looking insight.
  • Identify recurring dependency themes and recommend improvements to governance, planning, controls, tooling and ways of working, using AI-driven insight where appropriate while maintaining data, security and responsible-use standards.

Skills

Delivery and Dependency Expertise

  • Strong understanding of product roadmaps, delivery lifecycles, programme planning and governance controls.
  • Ability to interpret complex dependencies, delivery constraints and competing priorities within a cross-functional environment.

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with confidence engaging senior leaders and securing accountability across organisational boundaries.
  • Clear, concise communication tailored to governance and executive audiences.
  • Ability to work autonomously while building effective relationships across multidisciplinary and client-facing teams.

Analysis and Execution

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate impact, develop options and facilitate resolution.
  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, with disciplined follow-through across multiple programmes and competing priorities.

Tools, AI and Controls

  • Proficiency with roadmap, delivery and reporting tools such as Jira, Confluence, Power BI, Excel or equivalent platforms.

Make an Impact with Baystate Health

Baystate Health is seeking a Utility Aide to join the Food and Nutrition team. Under the direction of the Supervisor of Utility Aides and/or Manager of Production/Executive Chef, the Utility Aide performs a variety of essential tasks that support the daily operations of a professional healthcare kitchen.


Responsibilities include disassembly of patient meal trays, food cart delivery and retrieval, loading and unloading of dishwasher, equipment cleaning, and maintaining the cleanliness and sanitation of food service and production areas.

This role plays an important part in supporting patient care by ensuring that meal trays are efficiently disassembled, safety standards are followed, and kitchen equipment, utensils, and service areas remain clean, sanitary, organized and stocked. From supporting kitchen operations, you will help ensure that patients, visitors, and team members receive high-quality service.


The Utility Aide Will:

  • Coordinate Tray Delivery and Retrieval: Deliver carts containing assembled meal trays to designated hospital units, retrieve carts with soiled trays, and ensure timely and efficient service.

title: Engineer, Design Enablement PDK
description:
Title: Engineer, Design Enablement PDK

About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high-performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit .

Introduction:

The Process Design Kit (PDK) Engineer develops, deploys, supports and maintains high-quality, feature-rich Process Design Kits used by Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. The role translates semiconductor process requirements, design rules and SPICE model documentation into reliable PDK components, automation solutions and verification test cases. Working with process, modeling, design enablement and customer-facing teams, the engineer helps ensure accurate, error-free PDK releases and clear technical documentation for proper customer use.

Your Job:

  • Develop design components for Process Design Kits, including technology files and runtime code readable by Electronic Design Automation tools.
  • Develop, deploy, support and maintain PDK components that accurately represent semiconductor fabrication processes.
  • Develop, deploy, support and maintain automation tools used in PDK development, validation and release activities.
  • Review and interpret process design rules and SPICE model documentation, and translate the requirements into specifications and data for PDK development.
  • Create and maintain test cases for PDK components, including Design Rule Check (DRC), Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) and Parasitic Extraction (PEX) flows.
  • Perform quality assurance checks and regression testing to support accurate, stable and error-free PDK deliveries to customers.
  • Investigate PDK defects, identify root causes and implement appropriate corrections in collaboration with relevant technical teams.
  • Create and update release notes, application notes and other technical documentation covering proper usage, known limitations, issues and available solutions.
  • Provide technical support for PDK deployment, integration and usage, and collaborate with internal stakeholders and customers to resolve technical issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of PDK development methods, automation, testing coverage, documentation and release quality.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
  • Work collaboratively on other projects and assignments as needed.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Microelectronics, Physics, or a related technical field.
  • Basic knowledge or experience in semiconductor design enablement, PDK development, integrated circuit design, physical verification, EDA application engineering, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor process technology, integrated circuit design flows and Process Design Kit structures.
  • Experience with physical verification area such as Design Rule Check (DRC), Layout Versus Schematic (LVS), or Parasitic Extraction (PEX) will be an advantage.
  • Ability to interpret design-rule documentation, technology specifications and SPICE model information.
  • Programming or scripting capability for engineering automation, data processing, testing or tool integration.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, documentation and problem-solving skills, with attention to accuracy and release quality.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional technical teams and communicate technical information clearly.

title: Director, Annual Planning and Sales Model Design
description:
Director of Annual Planning and Sales Model Design

Location: US Nationwide/Remote

The Opportunity
Oracle is seeking a Director of Annual Planning and Sales Model Design to fundamentally redesign annual go-to-market planning and lead the design of our global sales model. You will determine how we segment customers, allocate sales coverage, and align roles and selling motions to the needs and growth potential of each segment.
You will connect Global Field Organization’s long-term growth strategy to an executable annual plan, bringing customer opportunity, sales capacity, productivity, investment, and field readiness into one coherent process. Your mandate spans diagnosis, design, executive alignment, implementation, and ongoing improvement across regions and the businesses within your remit.
We are looking for a leader who has built and implemented major GTM changes in a complex technology business. You will challenge established assumptions, make clear recommendations on difficult trade-offs, and remain accountable for whether the resulting model improves customer coverage, seller effectiveness, and growth. Redesign annual GTM planning end to end.
  • Rebuild the planning process from strategic choices through fiscal-year launch in alignment with President, Global Field Organization. Diagnose current weaknesses, define the future approach, and lead a sequenced transformation with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Integrate market opportunity, segmentation, coverage, role design, capacity, territories, quota methodology, and investment decisions. Align Marketing, Partners, Customer Success, Finance, HR, Sales Compensation, and regional Sales Operations around shared assumptions and dependencies.
  • Connect annual decisions to a multiyear view of growth. Reconcile leadership targets with customer potential and achievable field capacity; quantify gaps, test alternatives, and recommend where to invest, redeploy resources, or change the model.
  • Own the global planning calendar, decision rights, executive reviews, approval milestones, and exception process. Establish common data definitions and planning standards, with explicit criteria for justified regional variation.
  • Lead deployment with the teams responsible for execution. Ensure account assignments, territories, roles, targets, systems, and field communications are reconciled and ready for the fiscal year; use post-launch reviews to improve subsequent cycles.
Own global customer segmentation
  • Build a segmentation framework grounded in addressable opportunity, customer needs, buying behavior, industry, growth potential, and product adoption. Define account hierarchies, segment assignment rules, and criteria for movement between segments.
  • Validate segment choices against customer and seller evidence, commercial potential, and economics. Establish a repeatable refresh process that keeps the model relevant while preserving continuity for customers and account teams.
Design coverage roles and selling motions
  • Define the coverage model for each customer segment for each region globally, including the appropriate use of dedicated account teams, pooled coverage, digital sales, specialists, partners, and self-service. Balance customer experience and growth potential with capacity and cost to serve.
  • Design role charters, account ownership, specialist engagement, and team responsibilities across the customer lifecycle. Clarify how sellers, technical teams, customer success, renewal teams, and partners work together, with practical rules of engagement and handoffs.
  • Define differentiated motions for acquiring customers, expanding relationships, cross-selling, driving adoption and consumption, and retaining business. Specify the target customer, buying stakeholders, lead role, supporting resources, and success measures for each motion.
  • Model territory potential, account workloads, seller capacity, ramp time, attrition, specialist ratios, and management spans. Assess the implications for productivity, customer reach, quota capacity, and cost of sales before recommending structural changes.
  • Partner with Finance, HR, and Sales Compensation to align targets, job design, performance expectations, and incentives with the intended model and seller behaviors.
Lead transformation and measure results
  • Translate analysis into clear executive recommendations that explain options, assumptions, financial implications, risks, and the decisions required. Resolve conflicting priorities across global and regional leaders and drive agreement on implementation.
  • Pilot material changes where practical, define comparison groups or other credible evaluation methods, and use results to refine the model before broader deployment. Distinguish the effect of design changes from market conditions and differences in customer opportunity.
  • Establish a performance framework covering planning speed and quality, field readiness, coverage effectiveness, seller productivity, customer outcomes, and commercial return. Use evidence to recommend in-year adjustments and future investments.
  • Set business requirements for planning data, analytics, and systems. Partner with technology teams to automate repeatable work, improve scenario modeling, and apply AI where it demonstrably improves speed or decision quality, with appropriate validation.
  • Lead adoption through regional implementation plans, manager and seller enablement, and structured field feedback. Anticipate transition risks, including account disruption and unclear ownership, and hold workstream leaders accountable for resolving them.

  • Build and develop a team with strong capabilities in GTM strategy, quantitative analysis, planning, and sales model design. Set high standards for analytical rigor, commercial judgment, concise communication, and delivery.

#LI-MS1

Experience and capabilities

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in GTM strategy, sales planning, sales strategy and operations, or a related discipline, including substantial experience in enterprise software, cloud, or another complex technology business.
  • 5+ years leading and developing global teams, with a record of delivering major initiatives across global functions and regions in a matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated personal ownership of at least one major GTM planning or sales model redesign, from diagnosis and executive approval through implementation and measurement. Ability to explain the decisions made, trade-offs accepted, and business results achieved.
  • Deep experience designing customer segmentation, coverage models, sales roles, and selling motions, with evidence of translating those decisions into territory, capacity, and annual planning processes.
  • Strong commercial and financial judgment. Ability to build and challenge opportunity, capacity, productivity, and investment models; test assumptions; and distinguish achievable growth from unsupported targets.
  • Experience working across enterprise, commercial, or smaller-customer segments and multiple routes to market. Understanding of how subscription and consumption models affect acquisition, adoption, expansion, and retention.
  • Proven ability to influence senior sales and functional executives, challenge established practices constructively, resolve disagreements, and secure decisions without relying solely on reporting authority.
  • Strong analytical fluency and the ability to interrogate underlying data, assess model quality, and direct advanced analysis. Experience translating business requirements into scalable planning processes and systems.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including concise executive proposals that make the recommendation, supporting evidence, and required decisions clear.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, engineering, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred experience

  • Experience in a large global technology company with multiple product portfolios, regional sales organizations, and an established partner ecosystem.
  • Experience building a planning or sales design capability, modernizing planning platforms, or applying AI and automation to improve planning quality and speed.
  • Strategy consulting experience combined with direct accountability for implementation in an operating business; MBA or relevant advanced degree.

What success looks like

Success means an adopted global sales model with clear segment definitions, coverage choices, role responsibilities, and selling motions; an integrated annual planning cycle that delivers an executable plan on time; and measurable improvement against agreed baselines for planning quality, coverage, productivity, and commercial outcomes. You will establish those baselines early, agree targets with business leaders, and demonstrate progress through implementation and results.

title: Specialist Corporate Communications
description:
Title: Specialist Corporate Communication


About GF


GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high-performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit .


Introduction:


The Corporate Communications Specialist develops and implements communication strategies and programs that strengthen the company brand and communicate its culture and values in alignment with corporate strategy. This role partners with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to establish communication priorities, deliver clear and consistent messages through appropriate media and channels, coordinate external and internal outreach, and measure the effectiveness of communication activities.

Your Job:

  • Develop and implement communication strategies and programs that align with corporate priorities and reinforce the company brand, culture and values.
  • Create, coordinate and deliver communications through a range of media and channels for defined internal and external audiences.
  • Partner with leadership and key stakeholders to develop communication plans, establish priorities and align messages with business objectives.
  • Coordinate the dissemination of company communications with news and trade media contacts, where applicable.
  • Plan and support special events, public-speaking engagements and other communication activities designed to reach target audiences and achieve program objectives.
  • Develop clear, accurate and engaging communication materials while maintaining consistency in messaging, tone and brand standards.
  • Manage communication timelines, stakeholder reviews and approvals to support timely and effective delivery.
  • Measure and evaluate the effectiveness of communication programs and channels, and recommend improvements based on results and stakeholder feedback.
  • Collaborate across functions and regions on communication projects and assignments as required.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
  • Work collaboratively on other projects and assignments as needed.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master / Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Business, or a related field.
  • Basic knowledge or experience in corporate communications, public relations, media relations, internal communications, brand communications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated at least a slight experience developing communication plans and producing content for multiple audiences and channels.
  • Strong written, editing, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and accurately.
  • Ability to collaborate with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities and deliver work within agreed timelines.

Preferred Qualifications / Skills:

  • Social Media savvy
  • Experience in using canva
  • Basic knowledge / experience in photography & film will be an advantage
  • Well-versed in PowerPoint

title: Full Stack Software Developer (.NET/AWS)
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Full Stack Software Developer to join our growing engineering team, building cloud-native SaaS platforms for the insurance industry.

You will help design and develop scalable distributed systems and shared services that support multiple products used by insurers, suppliers, police forces and supporting organisations across the UK and internationally.

Our platform is evolving towards a modern AWS-native architecture, making extensive use of serverless technologies, microservices and event-driven systems to deliver highly scalable and reliable solutions.

You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through to deployment and operational support, collaborating with engineers, product managers and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.

This role is ideal for developers who enjoy building scalable cloud services, solving complex technical problems, and continuously improving how software is delivered.

What you'll be building

Our platform is built around shared cloud services running on AWS, supporting multiple SaaS products across the insurance ecosystem.

You will work with technologies such as:

  • AWS Lambda, Step Functions and API Gateway
  • .NET-based microservices
  • RESTful APIs and shared platform services
  • Event-driven integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments
  • Scalable SaaS systems used across the UK insurance market

The work you contribute to will help insurers process claims faster, improve decision making and deliver better outcomes for customers.

What we're looking for

We’re particularly interested in developers who enjoy building scalable cloud services and shared platform capabilities, and who are comfortable working with modern distributed architectures on AWS.

You should be someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and contributing to the evolution of engineering practices within the team.

What you'll get

  • Opportunity to work with modern cloud-native architecture on AWS
  • Exposure to microservices, serverless platforms and distributed systems
  • Collaboration with experienced engineers across the UK and globally
  • The chance to contribute to platform-level services used across multiple products
  • Opportunities to develop new technical skills and grow your engineering career

#LI-SD2 #LI-Hybrid

  • Design and develop cloud-native SaaS applications and shared platform services
  • Build scalable microservices and serverless components using modern development practices
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrations with internal systems and third-party platforms
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed and event-driven architectures
  • Work across new product development, enhancements and platform evolution
  • Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to refine requirements, estimate work and deliver features iteratively
  • Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, providing third-level technical support where required
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation and architectural artefacts
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling and platform reliability

Essential requirements

  • 3+ years professional experience building commercial software systems
  • Strong experience developing server-side applications using C# and .NET Core
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and JSON-based integrations
  • Experience working with SQL databases (Microsoft SQL Server or PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Experience building or deploying applications on AWS cloud infrastructure
  • Familiarity with microservices or distributed system architecture
  • Experience using Git or modern source control systems
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments, such as ADO
  • Experience using Visual Studio or equivalent development environments
  • A passion for technology and a desire to continuously learn and improve

Highly desirable

  • Experience working with AWS serverless services (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway)
  • Front-end development experience with Vue.js, React, Angular or modern JavaScript frameworks
  • Experience working within Agile / Scrum development environments
  • Knowledge of event-driven architecture or message bus technologies
  • Experience implementing Test-Driven Development (TDD)
  • Understanding of software design patterns and clean architecture principles
  • Experience building microservices-based platforms
  • Familiarity with AI development tools or AI-assisted engineering workflows
  • Knowledge of Low Code / No Code platforms
  • Experience working within the insurance or financial services industry

The primary application that GDIT supports on the HOM Program is the Healthcare Integrated General Ledger Accounting System (HIGLAS) which is a very large complex system with approximately 3,000 total users, processing an average of 4.5 million transactional claim records per day which equates to over 1.2 billion annually. There is an average of 46,000 new accounts receivable, and 168,000 payments processed per day along with 20,000 queries/reports run daily. Utilizing Oracle Federal Financials as the base application of HIGLAS, it provides CMS with a uniform financial management system to account for over $1 Trillion in outlays for healthcare each year across multiple lines of business.

  • Automate routine DBA tasks using Python, shell scripts, and Ansible.

title: IT Vendor Management - Emerging Lead
description:
Who we are looking for:

Global Technology Services (GTS) owns the management of a large and complex set of outsourcing arrangements. These arrangements include relationships with third‑party service providers as well as internal agreements across legal entities and business lines.

The IT Vendor Performance and Outsourcing Management (VPOM) team is established within GTS to:

Provide centralized oversight and administration of outsourcing activities

Support effective and consistent management of IT outsourcing arrangements

The team works closely with IT delivery and relationship management functions, as well as with Global Procurement Services, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), Legal, and Finance.

The Senior Associate – IT Vendor Governance supports the execution of vendor governance processes across IT vendors, ensuring compliance with enterprise policies, contractual standards, and regulatory expectations. The role focuses on operational governance activities, vendor risk data management, reporting, and stakeholder coordination under guidance from senior governance leads.

What you will be responsible for:

Vendor Governance & Oversight-

  • Support execution of IT vendor governance activities in line with established policies, standards, and operating procedures.
  • Assist in onboarding, periodic reviews, renewals, and offboarding of IT vendors.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records, governance artifacts, and documentation repositories

Stakeholder Coordination-

  • Act as a coordination point between vendors, internal IT teams, risk, compliance, and procurement functions.
  • Support governance forums, meetings, and reviews by preparing dashboards, presentations, and minutes of meetings.
  • Track actions and commitments arising from governance reviews.
  • undefine

Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement-


  • Prepare periodic vendor governance dashboards, scorecards, and MIS reports.
  • Ensure data accuracy across vendor inventories, risk trackers, and performance metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve governance processes, automation, and reporting efficiency.



Contract & Commercial Governance-


  • Assist with tracking contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs, and compliance metrics.
  • Support review of statements of work (SOWs), change requests, and governance clauses from a policy‑alignment perspective.
  • Monitor SLA performance data and escalate deviations as required.

Risk & Compliance Support-


  • Coordinate vendor risk assessments (e.g., TPRM, SOC reports, information security reviews) under guidance from senior team members.
  • Track risk findings, remediation actions, and follow-ups with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Support audit and regulatory requests by compiling evidence and governance documentation



What we value:


  • Basic understanding of IT vendor management, outsourcing models, and third‑party risk concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
  • Ability to liaise across multiple stakeholders and functions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Willingness to learn and grow within a governance function.

Mandatory skills / experience:


  • Degree level qualification in Technology/Business or other relevant subject with overall experience of 3 - 5 years in IT/Non IT Vendor Management, IT/Non IT Governance, Outsourcing Management, Third‑Party Management, or a related technology governance / operations role.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
  • Experience working in a regulated financial services, banking, or large enterprise environment preferred, with exposure to internal controls and audit expectations.
  • Demonstrated ability to follow standardized, repeatable governance processes consistently and accurately.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Power BI, Sharepoint) for reporting, governance tracking, and documentation.

Additional requirements / Good to have skills:


  • Certification in Project management, Agile, Kaizen will be a plus.
  • Work experience supporting multiple geographies is an added advantage
  • Experience in execution transformation programs/project is a plus

Mode of work: Compliant with State Street Policy of Work from office/home



Are you the right candidate? Yes!

We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

Why this role is important to us:

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential.
