title: Billing Specialist - 100% On-Site
description:
Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States of America

Extraordinary Care. Extraordinary Careers.

With one of the nation’s largest, most innovative long-term care pharmacy services providers, there is no limit to the growth of your career.

Guardian Pharmacy of Michigan, a member of the Guardian family of pharmacies, has an exciting opportunity for you to join our rapidly growing team in Grand Rapids, Michigan.

Why Guardian Pharmacy of Michigan? We’re reimagining medication management and transforming care.

Who We Are and What We’re About:

Our core focus is delivering customized medication management solutions to support healthcare organizations serving seniors and individuals with complex care needs. With our comprehensive suite of tech-enabled pharmacy services and a dedicated team of professionals committed to enriching the lives of those we serve, we are redefining how pharmacy care is delivered.

We offer an opportunity to learn and grow your career in a fast-paced, diverse, and inclusive environment. If you are looking for a challenging, team-oriented environment in which you can put your expertise to work, then this is the place for you.

Schedule

M-F 8:30 am - 5:00 pm


Pay Range

$20 - $24 per hour Depending on Experience


*This position is 100% On-Site*


Responsible for processing customer bills and insurance claims in an accurate and timely manner. This includes assisting with all daily and month-end billing functions, procedures and reporting. Provides excellent customer service to patients, caregivers, medical providers and insurance carriers.


ATTRIBUTES REQUIRED:

  • Work Ethic/Integrity – must possess intrinsic drive to excel coupled with values in line with company philosophy
  • Relational – ability to build relationships with business unit management and become “trusted advisor.”
  • Strategy and Planning – ability to think ahead, plan and manage time efficiently.
  • Problem Solving – ability to analyze causes and solve problems at functional level.
  • Team Oriented – ability to work effectively and collaboratively with all team members.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS (include the following):

  • Research and establish patient eligibility coverage with insurance providers including private individuals and/or government entities. Reverify benefit coverage criteria as needed for claims follow up. Accurately enters and/or updates patient/insurance information into billing system.
  • Maintain and continually audit patient files and corresponding documentation necessary to defend third party audits and ensure payer and company compliance. Accurately enter patient information into the pharmacy system.
  • Provide assistance and timely response to all billing customer inquiries via phone or electronic communications. Research and resolve patient billing issues regarding insurance eligibility, coverage, and related benefits.
  • Provide guidance and support to resident or responsible party by running Medicare plan comparisons during open enrollment and special enrollment periods. Proactively review patient profiles, drug regimens and insurance coverage to evaluate options to save resident money.
  • Responsible for completion of daily census, admit, discharge, and room changes for the facilities assigned.
  • Process patient payments, returns, and credits. Transmit individual credit card payments as needed.
  • May pursue payment from delinquent accounts and make payment arrangements.
  • Research, identify and organize requested audit documentation in timely manner.
  • Perform prescription claims adjudication including communication with insurance companies regarding rejected claims, eligibility, prior authorizations or other issues as needed. Make corrections as needed and rebill claims as necessary.
  • Develop knowledge and understanding in pharmacy facility billing requirements (Medicare, Medicaid, Prescription Drug Plans (PDPs) and Third-Party Insurances)
  • Develop proficiency in the utilization of pharmacy information systems to meet operational needs and regulatory requirements. This includes using pharmacy systems to process prior authorizations, resolve rejections, produce various reports as necessary, and complete billing functions.
  • Rotate through other departments to gain working/functional knowledge of other department workflows.
  • Follow all applicable government regulations including HIPAA.
  • Work as a collaborative team member to meet the service goals of the pharmacy.
  • Other essential functions and duties may be assigned as needed.

EDUCATION AND/OR CERTIFICATIONS:

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Pharmacy Technician license/certification/registration per state requirements; National Certification preferred (PTCB) may be required (pharmacy specific).

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1+ years of related experience
  • Advanced computer skills; pharmacy information system experience preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver to deadlines.
  • Great attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment working on multiple tasks simultaneously, while adhering to strict deadlines
  • Quality minded; motivated to seek out errors and inquire about inaccuracies.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the job.

  • The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.
  • Due to the collaborative nature of the business and the need to service customers, the employee must be able to interact effectively with others in an office environment, manage conflict, and handle stressful situations and deadlines.
  • Requires desk work in office environment.
  • Ability to work flexible hours.

What We Offer:

Guardian provides employees with a comprehensive Total Rewards package, supporting our core value of, “Treat others as you would like to be treated.”

Compensation & Financial

  • Competitive pay
  • 401(k) with company match

Family, Health & Insurance Benefits (Full-Time employees working 30+ hours/week only)

  • Medical, Dental and Vision
  • Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Company-paid Basic Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment
  • Company-paid Long-Term Disability and optional Short-Term Disability
  • Voluntary Employee and Dependent Life, Accident and Critical Illness
  • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

Wellbeing

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Guardian Angels (Employee assistance fund)

Time Off

  • Paid holidays and sick days
  • Generous vacation benefits based on years of service

The Guardian Difference

Our clients require pharmacy services that aren’t “cookie cutter.” That’s why every Guardian pharmacy is locally operated and empowered with the autonomy to tailor their business to meet their clients’ needs.

Our corporate support offices, based in Atlanta, Ga., provide services such as human resources, business intelligence, legal, and marketing to promote the success of each Guardian location.

Regardless of your role at Guardian, your voice and talents matter. Because healthcare is an ever-changing industry, we encourage innovative thinking, intellectual curiosity, and diverse viewpoints to ensure we stay competitive in today’s dynamic business environment.

At Guardian, we are dedicated to fostering and advancing a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Join us to discover what your best work truly looks like.

title: Ophthalmic Photographer
description:
The Ophthalmic Photographer performs ophthalmic photography and measurements for clinical and research protocols in the department of Ophthalmology. The majority of the photographer's time is spent in direct patient care using cameras, ultrasound and other ophthalmic equipment. Other duties include documenting test results to maintain photographic records for patient care and teaching, developing film, and instructing residents and visiting clinicians in photographic techniques.

High school diploma or GED required. Requires two years photography experience or a degree in photography; ophthalmic photography experience preferred. Computer skills are required. The successful candidate will possess knowledge of ocular anatomy and physiology and ophthalmic photographic techniques or acquire these skills through on-the-job training. CRA, COA, or COT licensure preferred.

description:

Morada Senior Living proudly manages a strong and growing network of care and lifestyle-focused Independent Living, Assisted Living and Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing communities across Texas and Oklahoma serving residents and families throughout our region. title: Senior Analyst/Associate Due Diligence Specialist, Private Credit, Investor Relations (Contract)
description:
About Northleaf Capital Partners


Northleaf is a global private markets investment firm focused on mid-market companies and assets. With US$31 billion in capital commitments raised to date, Northleaf has an established, long-term track record as an investor in private equity, private credit and infrastructure globally.


Northleaf’s 300+ person team, located in Toronto, Chicago, London, Los Angeles, Melbourne, Menlo Park, Montreal, New York, Seoul and Tokyo, is focused exclusively on sourcing, evaluating and managing private markets investments. Northleaf manages closed and open-end funds across a range of global private markets strategies and a series of separately managed accounts with customized investment strategies tailored to meet the specific needs of leading institutional investors and family offices. As part of its ambitious growth strategy, Northleaf is also developing specific private markets products and investment solutions for insurance and wealth management clients.


Position: Senior Analyst/Associate Due Diligence Specialist, Private Credit, Investor Relations


The Private Credit Investor Relations team is responsible for investor relations, business development, product strategy/development and communications for Northleaf’s private credit program. Reporting to the Director, Investor Relations & Product Strategy, the Due Diligence Specialist will support the full investor due diligence process, from the development of core fundraising materials through the coordination and completion of investor-specific requests.


The successful candidate will partner closely with prospective and existing investors and with colleagues across the Investor Relations & Product Strategy, Portfolio Strategy & Analytics, Investment, Sales, Marketing, Product Development, Legal, Compliance and Tax teams. The role offers broad exposure to the private credit platform and an opportunity to build deep knowledge of Northleaf's strategies, portfolios and operating model, while contributing directly to fundraising and investor engagement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Due diligence execution: develop and manage high-quality deliverables that advance investor diligence processes, including DDQs, RFPs, RFIs, quantitative datasets, operational and investment due diligence presentations, case studies and related materials
  • Investor communications: develop content for investor communications such as in-person updates, quarterly reports, annual investor conferences and conference calls
  • Fundraising: develop and maintain content and collateral for fundraising activities such as marketing materials, standard DDQs, investment case studies, RFP responses and online data rooms
  • Data and portfolio analytics: analyze and track asset-level and fund-level KPIs, investment track record and market data to support portfolio analysis and development of investor-facing materials
  • Investor servicing: respond to investors’ information needs, requirements and inquiries
  • Market trends/research: research market trends, competitor positioning and performance benchmarks to support fundraising and investor communications


Independent Contractor


  • 12-month independent contractor engagement
  • Expected commitment of approximately 40-50 hours per week
  • Monthly invoices to Northleaf


Qualifications


  • Undergraduate university degree with strong academic credentials
  • 1-4 years of financial or professional services experience, preferably in private markets, corporate banking, investment banking, management consulting, transaction advisory, direct investing, investor relations, client service or due diligence
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, and comfortable utilizing AI tools in order to generate insights that inform decision-making
  • Strong project management skills, with experience in managing timelines and stakeholders across multiple projects simultaneously with high degree of attention to detail
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate and present ideas and perspectives effectively (with fluency in Word, PowerPoint and Excel)
  • Self-motivated and self-directed, with a high degree of intellectual curiosity; demonstrated ability to be proactive
  • Interest in financial markets, private markets investments, the institutional investment industry and portfolio construction and asset allocation principles
  • Flexible team player with a history of collaborating with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders


Location


Toronto, Canada


What Sets Us Apart


At Northleaf Capital Partners, you’ll be joining a leading global private markets investment firm with a differentiated platform across mid-market private equity, private credit, and infrastructure. Our integrated approach and long-term perspective have made us a partner of choice to a global base of institutional investors – and that begins with our exceptional team of professionals.

At our core, our culture is built on the foundation of trust, openness, respect, integrity, and professionalism. These values guide every interaction with our investors, our partners, and one another. We are focused on building long-term relationships and creating a collaborative, professional environment where everyone feels supported and valued.

We foster a collegial and non-hierarchical workplace where ideas are valued, decision-making is grounded in data, and individuals are empowered to contribute meaningfully. Our success depends on an engaged and inclusive workforce, and we invest in fostering that culture. We celebrate the diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members and are committed to ensuring a workplace built on inclusion and shared success.

We celebrate achievements, encourage teamwork, and work hard to cultivate a sense of community to achieve strong results. Our competitive total rewards package features an employer-funded benefits plan, an attractive retirement offering, which includes a group retirement plan and the ability to invest in Northleaf funds on a no fee/no carry basis, and a range of valuable perks such as fitness and wellness reimbursement, charitable donation matching, and tuition assistance. We also support flexible working arrangements, with our current hybrid work model offering up to two remote days per week and the option to work fully remotely for up to two weeks per year. Flexible work practices are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect business and operational needs.


Contact


Interested candidates are asked to apply on Northleaf Careers. Only those selected to be interviewed will be contacted.

Applications will be reviewed using Northleaf’s recruitment standards to ensure a fair and consistent experience. Our recruitment team will personally review your resume and application. We may use artificial intelligence to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business through candidate sourcing. We are committed to safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly throughout the process.

Northleaf Capital Partners is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. Should you require accommodations during the selection process, please do not hesitate to let us know and suitable arrangements will be made.

title: ERP Production Scheduler/Planner
description:
Please review the job details below.





We are seeking an experienced ERP Production Planner / Scheduler to support spacecraft manufacturing programs through production scheduling, material planning, and ERP data management. This role partners closely with Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Procurement to ensure materials, schedules, and production activities align with program commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Maintain the Master Production Schedule (MPS) within the ERP system.
  • Execute and analyze MRP (Material Requirements Planning).
  • Balance production demand, capacity, and material availability.
  • Manage long-lead material planning (12–24+ months).
  • Monitor production schedules and resolve material or capacity constraints.

ERP & Data Management

  • Manage production and work orders throughout their lifecycle.
  • Maintain accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) and ERP master data.
  • Monitor MRP exception messages and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Track inventory, WIP, and material shortages.
  • Ensure data integrity across ERP, PLM, MES, and related systems.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Program Management.
  • Facilitate production planning meetings and communicate schedule risks.
  • Support KPI reporting, dashboards, and root cause analysis for planning and data issues.
  • Drive continuous improvement of planning processes and system accuracy.

Skills We Are Looking For

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of ERP transactions, MRP/MPS, BOMs, and production planning.
  • Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience with capacity planning, inventory management, and data validation.
  • Understanding of ERP integrations (PLM, MES) and data flow between systems.

Industry Knowledge

  • Configuration management and serialized inventory.
  • AS9100/ISO quality systems.
  • Aerospace manufacturing, traceability, and government contract requirements.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Process improvement and continuous improvement mindset.
  • High attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Work Environment

  • Aerospace manufacturing environment with occasional cleanroom access.
  • Combination of office and manufacturing floor work.
  • Fast-paced, deadline-driven program environment with cross-functional collaboration.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, or related field. Four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree.
  • 5+ years of production planning, scheduling, or materials management experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on ERP experience (SAP, Oracle, or similar).
  • Manufacturing floor experience in production control, inventory, or material management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt.
  • Experience with spacecraft or satellite manufacturing.
  • ERP implementations or system migrations.
  • Experience with inventory control, quality inspection, or cycle counting.

title: System Data Engineer
description:
About this opportunity

Most engineering roles focus on improving what already exists. Ericsson gives the opportunity of creating something entirely new.

Join our Team

We are building an AI-powered engineering platform that keeps design intent and implementation aligned, turns engineering knowledge into a searchable asset, and enables AI to become a true engineering partner. By connecting system design with software implementation, we're laying the foundation for a new way of developing complex systems.

This is a greenfield initiative within Ericsson's RAN organization. You'll work at the intersection of AI, software architecture, and systems engineering, building intelligent agents, knowledge frameworks, and tooling that amplify engineering expertise. The challenges are ambitious, and the solutions have yet to be defined.

The goal is not to replace expertise, but to elevate it. By reducing repetitive work, AI allows engineers to focus on innovation, problem-solving, and high-value technical decisions.

You'll have the opportunity to shape the direction of this work and influence how future wireless systems, from 5G to 6G and beyond, are designed and developed.

As a Systems Data Engineer, you will drive how RAN system knowledge, design decisions, and technical structures are captured, represented, and governed. You will ensure data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, secure handling, and enable analytics/BI. Use Prefect orchestration, Python and SQL, containerization, CI/CD and monitoring; collaborate with architects and product teams to translate requirements into scalable, production-grade data solutions.

What you will do:

  • Design, build, and optimize robust end-to-end data pipelines and reusable processing components that deliver trusted and timely data to product teams and other stakeholders.
  • Develop, maintain, and operate platform-based, event-driven data workflows and S3-backed data flows, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable data movement across the delivery lifecycle.
  • Build and evolve orchestrated data processing workflows using tools such as Prefect, with strong focus on quality, maintainability, and operational support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, architects, and stakeholders to design scalable data solutions aligned with product, analytics, and operational needs.
  • Drive implementation of data ingestion, transformation, validation, and quality assurance frameworks, including support for raw and parsed dataset workflows.
  • Contribute to the evolution of data catalogue, metadata, and lineage capabilities to improve discoverability, governance, and controlled data consumption.
  • Support secure data handling, access control, and consent-aware ways of working in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and governance processes.
  • Enable data consumption for analytics and reporting scenarios, including integration points that support cataloguing, dashboards, and internal visibility of available datasets.
  • Drive improvements to data platform capabilities, pipeline performance, testing, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Use modern engineering practices and AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve development efficiency, documentation quality, troubleshooting, and delivery excellence while following security and governance requirements.
  • Communicate technical solutions, trade-offs, and delivery progress effectively to engineering teams, product stakeholders, and leadership in both technical and plain language.

The skills you bring:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or closely related software engineering role
  • Strong experience in data modelling, scalable batch data pipelines, and data lake or data warehouse patterns
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases, schema design and performance optimization
  • Strong programming skills in Python for data processing and reusable pipeline components
  • Hands‑on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect or equivalent
  • Hands‑on experience building and operating event‑driven data pipelines across different platform services (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Batch, Step Functions, Glue, Athena, EventBridge, S3)
  • Experience with Bash scripting in cloud‑native data processing workflows
  • Practical experience with data catalogue, metadata, lineage, governance, and secure data handling practices

Why join Ericsson?

At Ericsson, you’ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what’s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You’ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You’ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Director for  University Communications
description:
Job Description:

Who We Are

Founded in 1891, Seattle Pacific University has a long and distinguished history in Christian higher education. Located just minutes from downtown Seattle, SPU seeks to be a premier Christian university fully committed to engaging the culture and changing the world by graduating people of competence and character, becoming people of wisdom, and modeling grace-filled community.


University Communications plays a vital role in telling SPU's story, strengthening its institutional identity, and connecting prospective students, families, alumni, donors, and the broader community with the University's distinctive mission and educational experience.


What We Need

Seattle Pacific University is seeking an accomplished, strategic, and creative


Senior Director of University Communications to lead institutional marketing and communications efforts that strengthen the SPU brand, support enrollment and advancement priorities, and elevate the University's visibility and reputation.


Leading a talented eight-member University Communications team, the Senior Director oversees a broad portfolio that includes institutional branding, digital marketing, website strategy, social media, media relations, publications, design, photography, videography, and executive communications. This position serves as a trusted communications partner to University leadership, translating institutional priorities into compelling messages and coordinated strategies that engage key audiences.


The ideal candidate is both a visionary leader and a skilled communications practitioner—an exceptional writer and storyteller who brings strategic insight, creativity, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach to their work. They thrive in a dynamic environment, build strong relationships across departments, and are committed to delivering measurable results.


The Senior Director of University Communications supports Seattle Pacific University's mission by contributing to a Christ-centered learning and working community committed to academic excellence, service, and engagement with the world. In this role, the employee brings their skills, gifts, and professional expertise to work that matters—serving students, colleagues, and the broader University community in ways that reflect SPU's values and purpose. To that end, all University employees are required to be aligned with and supportive of SPU's Statement of Faith and its derivative policies and lifestyle expectations.


What You'll Do

Strategic Communications & Brand Leadership

  • Lead University-wide communications and marketing strategies that advance institutional priorities, strengthen SPU's brand, and engage internal and external audiences.
  • Serve as a strategic communications advisor to University leadership, including the President's Cabinet and Office of the President, on executive messaging, media relations, and crisis communications.
  • Guide institutional storytelling, messaging, editorial standards, and content development across digital, print, and multimedia platforms.
  • Write, edit, and develop compelling communications that reflect SPU's distinctive mission, values, and educational experience.

Digital Marketing & Enrollment Communications

  • Direct the University's website and digital communications strategy, ensuring an engaging user experience, consistent messaging, and effective integration with digital advertising.
  • Oversee social media, photography, videography, and digital content strategies that strengthen audience engagement and institutional visibility.
  • Partner closely with Undergraduate and Graduate Admissions to develop integrated marketing and communications strategies that support enrollment goals.
  • Use analytics, audience insights, and performance measures to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve marketing outcomes.

Team Leadership & University Partnerships

  • Lead, mentor, and develop an eight-member communications team responsible for marketing, web, design, multimedia, writing, publications, and media relations.
  • Collaborate with University Advancement to develop alumni and parent communications, fundraising appeals, case statements, and other materials that inspire engagement and philanthropic support.
  • Build productive relationships with faculty, staff, and campus leaders to ensure coordinated communications and excellent service to University partners.

Operations & Project Management

  • Oversee communications projects, production schedules, and workflows to ensure quality, timeliness, and alignment with institutional priorities.
  • Manage the departmental budget, including forecasting, expense oversight, and responsible allocation of resources.
  • Direct relationships with external vendors, agencies, and partners supporting the University's marketing, advertising, and communications initiatives.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, public relations, business, or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in communications, marketing, public relations, or a related field, including at least three years of supervisory experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing strategic communications and marketing initiatives, preferably in higher education or a similarly complex organization.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling, and verbal communication skills, including proficiency with AP style.
  • Strong leadership skills with demonstrated success building, mentoring, and managing collaborative, high-performing teams.
  • Experience overseeing digital marketing, website content, social media, and integrated communications campaigns.
  • Ability to translate institutional priorities and audience insights into compelling messaging, actionable strategies, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and budget management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Familiarity with content management systems, CRM platforms, digital analytics tools, and emerging AI applications for marketing and communications.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across an organization.
  • Mission Alignment: A personal commitment to the Christian faith and affirmation of SPU's Statement of Faith; enthusiasm for supporting the University's Christian mission; and willingness to uphold the policies and lifestyle expectations of SPU's Christian community.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in communications, marketing, business, or a related field.
  • Experience in Christian higher education or another faith-based organization, particularly one integrating Christian faith and learning.
  • Degree from a college or university that integrates Christian faith and learning such as a Council for Christian Colleges & Universities member institution.

title: Director of Slot Operations
description:
The Director of Slot Operations is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and financial performance of all slot operations for the property. This role oversees the slot floor experience, gaming performance, regulatory compliance, technology initiatives, and team development to maximize revenue, enhance guest satisfaction, and support the organization's overall business objectives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership and direction for all slot operations, ensuring efficient, compliant, and guest-focused operations.
  • Evaluate industry trends, emerging technologies, and guest preferences to continuously enhance the slot product offering.
  • Establish departmental goals, performance metrics, and service standards aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Analyze slot performance data, key operating metrics, and player trends to maximize gaming revenue and profitability.
  • Develop and implement strategies for machine placement, floor layout optimization, game mix, denomination distribution, and promotional effectiveness.
  • Monitor gaming asset utilization and recommend additions, removals, relocations, or conversions to optimize performance.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, tribal, and local gaming regulations, as well as company policies and internal controls.
  • Maintain the integrity and security of slot operations through effective controls, audits, and regulatory reporting.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor managers.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, safety, and exceptional guest service.
  • Promote employee engagement and maintain positive working relationships across departments.
  • Direct slot system operations, game installations, machine conversions, upgrades, and casino floor reconfigurations.
  • Coordinate with manufacturers, vendors, and internal stakeholders regarding equipment sourcing, maintenance, and technology enhancements.
  • Manage capital projects, including new game introductions, slot floor expansions, and technology implementations.
  • Ensure slot equipment and systems are maintained to operational and regulatory standards.
  • Analyze financial performance and implement corrective actions to achieve revenue and expense targets.
  • Prepare and present operational and financial reports to executive leadership.
  • Ensure a high-quality gaming experience through exceptional service standards and efficient issue resolution.
  • Address escalated guest concerns and implement improvements based on guest feedback and operational insights.
  • Support initiatives that enhance player loyalty, satisfaction, and retention.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in casino slot operations, including 3 years in a senior management or leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of slot operations, gaming technology, slot accounting principles, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets, capital expenditures, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Proven ability to analyze data and implement revenue-enhancing strategies.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain all required gaming licenses.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Gaming Management, Finance, or a related field.
  • Multi-property or large-scale casino operations experience.
  • Experience with slot management systems, performance analytics, and casino technology platforms.
  • Certification or advanced training in gaming operations, hospitality, or leadership development.

An exciting opportunity has arisen to recruit a part-time Assistant Practitioner to join the Northern Mental Health Social Care Team. In this permanent role, you will support people across North Norfolk and contribute to the Mental Health Duty Team.

You will play a key role in delivering Community-Led Support (CLS) within Adult Mental Health Social Care. You will work alongside individuals, families, communities and partner agencies to promote independence, recovery, wellbeing and social inclusion through relationship-based practice.

You will focus on preventing, reducing and delaying the need for formal care and support by working creatively with people, recognising strengths, building community connections and supporting access to local assets and opportunities. You will develop meaningful relationships with individuals experiencing mental health challenges and support them to achieve outcomes that matter to them.

You will be joining a passionate, forward thinking, supportive and high performing team of Social Workers, Assistant Practitioners, Living Well Officers and Local Area Coordinators. You may be required to undertake Care Act Assessments, Support Planning and Reviews whilst working collaboratively with partners including Norfolk and Suffolk Foundation Trust and various stakeholders.

You will need to have knowledge and a level of experience of the Care Act (2014), Mental Capacity Act (2005) Mental Health Act (1983) and Safeguarding vulnerable adults, as well as excellent time management and IT skills. All new staff are supported to develop a thorough working knowledge of Norfolk County Council processes and procedures.

We operate a hybrid model of working, which includes working from home, our office base at Hellesdon Hospital. There are also opportunities to work from other Norfolk County Council bases as well as other Community spaces.

Adult Social Services in Norfolk is on an ambitious, exciting transformation journey. We're redesigning how we work to create a system that is flexible, human, and focused on better outcomes. As part of this journey, you'll contribute to an environment where learning is continuous, insight is shared, and innovation is encouraged. We support flexible and hybrid working, with a minimum expectation of two days per week spent in a community or office setting, helping you stay connected with colleagues, communities and the people we support.

If you are interested in this opportunity and have further questions, please don't hesitate to contact Leigh Heyes, Team Manager or Samantha Unsworth, Practice Consultant, via 01603 217644 or email leigh.heyes@norfolk.gov.uk or samantha.unsworth@norfolk.gov.uk

title: Forest Health Specialist
description:
POSITION: Forest Health Specialist

JOB TYPE: Full-time

LOCATION: Tomahawk, WI


WHO WE ARE

Steigerwaldt Land Services, Inc., is a full-service resource solution company, offering a wide range of appraisal, analysis, real estate, right-of-way, environmental, and forestry services to our clients in the Lake States region and beyond. Founded in 1957, Steigerwaldt is a third-generation, family owned and operated company with history and experience spanning more than 65 years. Steigerwaldt employs a staff of over 70 people, with offices in Tomahawk and Hayward, Wisconsin; and Marquette, Michigan.

Becoming a member of Steigerwaldt is more than just an opportunity to follow your passion in forestry. It is an opportunity to be a part of an organization that fosters professional growth, nurtures your talent, and allows you to take ownership of your career path. A strong sense of brand, culture, and values define our company and our team. Our office culture is one that values synergy in the office and in the field.

Steigerwaldt creates a transparent and inclusive environment that involves you in team decision-making, cross-department learning, career path exploration, and hands-on experiences for you to grow your breadth of knowledge.

If this sounds like the supportive, passion-driven, professional environment you will thrive in, please apply to join our team. We are currently seeking a full-time Forester at our Hayward or Tomahawk office location. This is considered an entry-level position, although previous professional experience is helpful.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

This position resides in our Land and Resource Management Division and will support daily operations and projects in the Forest Operations, Environmental, and Tree Farm departments. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Tree farm planting and harvesting
  • Planting logistics and supervision
  • Cover crop research and planning
  • Monitor tree/forest health, research solutions, and complete prescribed treatments
  • Florida retail support in November/December
  • Tree Farm, Environmental, Forest Operations, and arborist (if applicable) crossover support
  • Harvest boundary research and delineation, technical skill with sub-meter GPS unit
  • Timber sale marking, setup, and establishment following site-specific prescriptions on all timber types common to Lake States
  • Inventory data collection with necessary level of speed and precision dependent upon project requirements
  • Stand reconnaissance and silvicultural planning
  • Reforestation supervision and administration
  • Vegetation sampling - Identification of all plants and trees within sample plot area
  • Invasive species identification and control
  • Periodic travel on project may exceed ±50 percent (in and out of state)
  • Other duties as assigned


WHO YOU ARE

You are a supportive and reliable team member that engages in building a great team and work culture. You are driven and motivated to be a part of a successful team and provide high-quality service and results. You show persistence, tenacity, and grit every day, through tough conditions and deadlines with energy and enthusiasm. You are curious and open-minded in exploring solutions and opportunities. You are a caretaker of resources, people, and company. You thrive working in a fast-paced, highly driven environment and can adapt quickly to changing conditions and priorities. You must have an adventurous side, enjoy significant travel, and thrive in high-pressure situations and working with tight deadlines.

  • Engage in active listening to understand and act on the expectations of peers, supervisors, and clients.
  • Embrace change and can modify behavior and plans to effectively achieve goals. Adaptability, flexibility, and change agility is necessary.
  • Has the drive, energy, and initiative to work independently in varied settings, both in the field and with clients and other professionals.
  • A team player who is an ambassador of integrity, respect, curiosity, and flexibility.
  • An individual who uses Steigerwaldt’s mission of ‘Quality work fast, with honesty and integrity; rooted in our passion for stewardship of resources and relationships.’ as a benchmark for decision making and standard of work.
  • An effective problem solver that can identify the root of a problem, provide productive solutions, act decisively, and show good judgement.

PREFERRED SKILLS

  • Desire to develop a career as a professional forester in a fast-paced and diverse consulting business
  • Familiarity with Lake States forest management and timber harvest administration
  • 2 or 4 year degree in Forest Management, Environmental Science, or related field
  • Ability to work independently in varied settings, both in the field and with clients and other professionals
  • Superior written and oral communication skills
  • Competent with Microsoft Office software
  • Experience with GPS data collecting and processing
  • Experience with ESRI GIS software and GIS mapping and data collection principles
  • Ability to travel and conduct overnight work away from the office – travel up to 25-40 percent or more
  • Current valid driver’s license with personal vehicle suitable for forestry work (mileage is reimbursed)
  • ATV and snowmobile certifications
  • A team player who is confident, respectful, curious, flexible, and able to work with other professionals in a growing, successful, and respected business

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Due to the nature of the team approach to our field work and needed access to equipment and company vehicles, the Forest Health Specialist position is considered a resident or office-based position with remote work possible, upon approval from the supervisor. The position is roughly 95 percent field work and 5 percent office work.



The position will be primarily performed in an outdoor setting and includes very frequent exposure to outdoor weather, such as heat, cold, rain, wind, and snow. This job may be frequently performed in a field or forest, and safety precautions must be taken. Overnight travel to project or client sites may be required (some assignments may be 3-4 weeks in length).


The nature of this job will require frequent walking and standing - sometimes for long periods of time. The use of hands for repetitive grasping and fine manipulation is required. Must utilize hearing for discussions, telephone use, and background noise. While performing the essential functions of the job, one may occasionally bend, squat, reach above head, kneel, and push or pull. Some lifting or carrying may be required (up to 35 lbs). While performing this job, one will use a computer, tablet, and/or cell phone. This job will require independent decision-making skills.


COMPENSATION

Salary commensurate with experience.


POSTING DATE

October 14, 2026. Position will be filled within one to three months. Interviews will be scheduled throughout this time period. Please note that these positions may be filled sooner, as there is flexibility in the start date.


CONTACT

For any hiring questions, please reach out to Travis Polinske at travis.polinske@steigerwaldt.com or 715-409-8535

title: AVP, Trade International Operations
description:
Job Purpose:

This role is primarily responsible for supervising , authorizing transactions and acting as a point of contact related to Trade Finance Unit of the respective region (France , Singapore , UK , USA , Bahrain , KSA , Kuwait and India) and to operate during the respective country time zone from UAE location and ensuring compliance with all internal procedures, operational controls, smooth workflow and delivery of high quality / timely service to the clients.   • Developing and introducing robust tools/processes to identify/mitigate operational risks attached to the department.

Working expertise and knowledge of the ICC Publications, ICC banking commission opinions and other compliance / trade related rules and regulations.

title: Supplier Development Engineer
description:
As a Supplier Development Engineer, you will support supplier development initiatives across the North American PPG Aerospace business. This business includes six manufacturing facilities, a Science & Technology organization, and seven distribution centers that procure direct and indirect materials and services supporting the production and distribution of aerospace products.


Based onsite in Sylmar, CA, you will partner closely with Supplier Development Project Managers to drive supplier performance, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role reports directly to the Supplier Development Manager.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development and execution of short-to-long term procurement projects of the Aerospace SBU. These projects may involve alternate materials, 2nd source suppliers, engineering/tooling development, supplier/PPG site qualification, work transfers, new production introduction/development (NPI/NPD), cost reduction efforts (cost avoidance/cost savings), new work bid, supply base consolidation, identifying new dock-to-stock suppliers, return-to-green plans, and enhancing supplier delivery performance and yields.
  • Support the qualification and selection of suppliers, leading to customers' acceptance.
  • Manage communication between internal and external stakeholders and interface between suppliers, leadership, procurement, supply chain, design engineering, operations, and quality teams.
  • Reduce supply risk by identifying & developing key second source suppliers and alternate materials.
  • Lead and/or participate in supplier qualification & development activities such as value stream analysis, capacity/ capability assessments, production rate readiness assessments (PRR/ PRA), PPAP/ APQP, first article (FAI) submission, Kaizen events, continuous improvement projects/ workshops, etc.
  • Support effective closure of open action items within the Supplier RAIL (Rolling Action Item Log).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with procurement, supply chain, quality, operations, and design engineering teams with the common goal of reducing costs while improving the overall quality of sourced goods and services.
  • Work together with quality, manufacturing, or design engineers to improve material reliability/ performance and to minimize recurrence of incoming nonconforming material (increase yields at the supplier).

Qualifications

  • Only U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, and political asylees or refugees are eligible to apply.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Material Science, or related professional degree.
  • 3+ years of related Procurement, Supplier Development, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering experience.
  • Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Lean Manufacturing experience (ASQ, ASCM/ APICS, ISM and/ or other industry recognized certifications/ training are desirable).
  • Must work well in a team environment, balance projects, and make effective presentations.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally to suppliers and other PPG sites (up to 25% of the time).

The impact you will have in this role:

Being a member of the Underwriting team you will excel in delivering range of tasks and procedures and excels in delivering a quality client experience. A keen eye for detail, a focus on excellent customer service and ability to handle a multifaceted workload are essential qualities for a successful specialist.

Underwriting is the entry point for securities to be made eligible for DTC services. An eligible security is one that is freely tradable is qualified to be held at DTC and serviced through DTC's electronic book-entry system. Products and services offered includes the New Issue Eligibility Program which allows underwriters, DTC participants or Issuer Paying Agents to submit eligibility requests for new and secondary security offerings and to create and service Money Market Instruments (MMI). Securities that are eligible for DTC are provided the full set of Asset Services. Securities that do not meet DTC's standards for eligibility can qualify for Custody Eligibility. This is a service that enables DTC Participants to leverage the DTC vault to secure and track such physical certificates and take part in a subset of Asset Services products.

Your Primary Responsibilities:

  • Executes on operational processes by following documented procedures and job aides, able to make suggestions on improving process and efficiency. Processes specialized workflows, resolves exceptions, assists with complex inquiries.

  • Experience working within a CLIA-regulated laboratory performing high complexity testing, reporting patient test results, writing CLIA-compliant SOPs, preparing for CLIA-audits and inspections, and other activities related to the clinical quality management system.

Grant funded position. Compliance with funding requirements such as time and effort reporting, grant deliverables, and contract deliverables, is required.

title: Principal DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Your impact

Are you ready to lead engineers and take on complex automation and DevOps challenges that underpin the UK’s most critical missions? At Leonardo, our Principal DevOps Engineers combine people leadership with technical authority, leading the design, integration, and delivery of secure, automated solutions across hybrid and cloud environments.

Your work at Leonardo UK will see you take the lead in solving customer problems in an agile, innovative and team-centric manner. The role may involve a blended hybrid working model, with a mixture of working from home and working on site at one of our Leonardo offices to ensure close collaboration with the wider team and with our customers.

Leonardo UK is seeking a Principal DevOps Engineer to join the Cyber & Security Solutions Division team. This role combines technical leadership with responsibility for leading and developing engineers and delivering DevOps work packages.


What you will do as a Principal DevOps Engineer

  • Act as the technical authority for automation and DevOps solutions across projects and programmes.
  • Lead the design and implementation of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and container orchestration.
  • Provide domain expertise in secure DevOps/DevSecOps, embedding cyber security into pipelines and environments.
  • Capture and analyse requirements, shaping high- and low-level technical designs.
  • Lead the planning, resourcing and technical delivery of assigned work packages, including estimation, reporting and management of risks.
  • Provide line management, mentoring and coaching for DevOps Engineers and Technicians, supporting their performance, development and wellbeing.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, capability development and knowledge sharing across the DevOps community.
  • Support technology assessments, feasibility studies, and roadmap development.
  • Engage with stakeholders and customers, presenting and defending technical solutions and reporting on delivery progress, risks and mitigations.

What you’ll bring

  • Extensive technical expertise in automation, orchestration, and secure DevOps practices.
  • Ability to balance hands-on engineering and technical authority with people leadership, delivery management and mentorship.
  • Demonstrable experience of leading and developing engineers and coordinating technical delivery.
  • A problem-solving mindset with the confidence to recommend and justify technical approaches.

Core areas (must have):

  • Experience in the design, build and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines (Github Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and version control (Git)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm)
  • Containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift/Tanzu)
  • Scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid deployments
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps and cyber security practices in software delivery
  • Experience leading engineers and planning technical work to cost, quality and schedule

Desirable:

  • Expertise in secrets management and PKI (e.g. HashiCorp Vault)
  • Experience with monitoring/logging tools (ELK stack, Prometheus, Splunk)
  • Familiarity with service mesh and modern networking (Istio, Envoy)
  • Exposure to data engineering and integration (Apache ecosystem, SQL, Python)
  • Recognised technical certifications (AWS/Azure Architect, Kubernetes CKA/CKAD, Terraform)
  • Experience in influencing technical standards, best practices, or contributing to professional forums

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.


Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: Security and Vetting | Leonardo UK


Location

This role is based at one of our UK sites, Bristol, with hybrid/custom working options where appropriate.


Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
  • Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
  • Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
  • Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
  • Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
  • Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
  • Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
  • Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.


Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 53,000 people worldwide including 8,500 across 9 sites in the UK. Our employees are not just part of a team—they are key contributors to shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.

Job Description

Who we are looking for

We are seeking a skilled full stack Software Engineer with deep hands-on engineering expertise and proven leadership experience building production-grade systems. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals, and can drive teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable financial products that create measurable business impact.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design and delivery of technology solutions—from problem framing and solution design to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. You will lead & work with engineering & AI teams on architecture and implementation choices, establish best practices for software engineering, and ensure solutions meet performance, reliability, privacy, and compliance requirements while aligning with business strategy.

What you will be responsible for

· Lead end-to-end development of software application features and services from prototyping to production, aligned to clear product outcomes and KPIs.

· Partner with product and ML/AI engineering teams to translate business problems into end-to-end solution approaches (build vs buy, data needs, evaluation strategy) and executable delivery plans.

· Lead and scale high-performing engineering teams delivering multiple initiatives in parallel (AI-enabled applications, internal platforms, and developer tooling).

· Promote automation and engineering excellence (CI/CD for ML, automated evaluation, red-teaming, monitoring/alerting, and cost/performance optimization) to improve quality and velocity.

· Collaborate closely with product, data, security, legal/compliance, and global engineering teams to align on AI use cases, constraints, and delivery expectations.

· Work with platform teams to ensure reusable components and consistent solution patterns across the portfolio.

· Explore, evaluate, and introduce AI technologies where they add clear business value (models, frameworks, orchestration tools, data platforms), balancing performance, cost, and risk.

· Continuously improve development lifecycle practices (data/versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response) and governance models.

· Collaborate with team on troubleshooting, solution improvements.

What we value

· Strong sense of ownership and accountability for technology outcomes, production reliability, and risk management.

· Ability to think strategically about new technology adoption while remaining hands-on when needed (design reviews, critical debugging, and technical decision making).

· Pragmatic problem-solving skills with a focus on new technologies, iterating quickly with evidence, and delivering business value.

· A collaborative mindset and the ability to influence across product, engineering, data, and risk/compliance stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

· 7+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant leadership experience delivering financial systems in production at scale.

· Strong software engineering fundamentals (distributed systems, APIs, data structures) and proficiency with modern software development stacks (full stack: React/Java/Python), including strong code quality practices.

· Proven experience building and operating workloads on public cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), including scalable model training and low-latency inference deployment.

· Solid experience with data platforms and pipelines (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Spark).

· Deep understanding of modern engineering practices and MLOps (CI/CD, testing, experiment tracking, model/version management, monitoring, incident management).

· Experience working in global or distributed teams across different regions and time zones.

· Strong communication skills in English and Chinese, including the ability to present complex AI topics and decisions to senior stakeholders.

This role serves as a critical link between customers, service operations, engineering, manufacturing, and quality organizations to resolve complex product and application issues. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in applied HVAC systems, particularly air-cooled chillers and rooftop units, and is passionate about delivering exceptional customer support while driving continuous product improvement.

  • 5+ years of experience working with air-cooled chillers, applied rooftop units, or similar Commercial HVAC systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose product, controls, and system-level issues.

Although not necessary, it would be nice if you have:

A reliable traceability view depends on detailed knowledge of how payment instructions, statuses and exceptions move across multiple systems. This role will build that evidence base and help convert it into clear requirements, tested functionality and practical operating procedures.

Join us if contributing to our Payments Business Risk and Resiliency Programs is a challenge you are up for.


What you will be responsible for

  • Conduct workshops and analysis with Operations, Client Service, Technology, Risk and application owners to document current-state payment journeys.
  • Maintain application inventories, process maps, system hand-offs, queue and exception points, ownership details and source-data references.
  • Document requirements and user stories for search, identifiers, statuses, timestamps, processing hops, alerts, exception ownership and evidence export.
  • Map UETR, end-to-end ID, internal reference, client reference and rail-specific identifiers across systems and identify correlation gaps.
  • Define and validate internal operational statuses and client-safe status labels, including masking and entitlement requirements.
  • Prepare test scenarios and data covering normal processing, screening holds, credit holds, anomaly holds, repair, stuck MQ, timeouts, NACKs, cancellations and returns.
  • Execute UAT, record evidence, raise defects and retest fixes across UI, data feeds, reports and access controls.
  • Support definition of alert ownership, response SLAs, escalation paths, operational procedures and training materials.
  • Provide traceability analysis and operations support to the anomaly detection workstream including for event visibility, case management and payment decisions.
  • Provide process and application dependency analysis to Swift Resilience planning and readiness activities.

What we value:

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • Practical understanding of payment or settlement processing and operational exception handling.
  • Strong process mapping, requirements documentation, workshop and analytical skills.
  • Familiarity with SWIFT or ISO 20022 messaging, payment identifiers and market acknowledgements is beneficial.
  • Ability to work with operational and technical stakeholders and manage detailed evidence.
  • Strong risk, client-data and control awareness.

Education & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, technology or a related field.
  • 5+ years of financial services experience, preferably in payments, settlement, operations or change.
  • Business analysis or process-modelling experience is preferred.

From technology to product innovation, we make our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we have helped our clients safeguard and steward investments, providing investment servicing, data and analytics, investment research and trading, and investment management to institutional clients.

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. About This Role

Carrier is the leading global provider of healthy, safe and sustainable building and cold chain solutions with a world-class, diverse workforce with business segments covering HVAC, refrigeration, and fire and security. We make modern life possible by delivering safer, smarter and more sustainable services that make a difference to people and our planet while revolutionizing industry trends. This is why we come to work every day. Join us and we can make a difference together.

The Instructional Designer is responsible for developing technical training on commercial HVAC equipment and controls for Carrier’s internal workforce, customers and external stakeholders.This role partners closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) from engineering, product management, service, and sales to create engaging learning experiences across multiple modalities, including eLearning, virtual instructor-led training (vILT), classroom training, videos, job aids, and performance support tools. The ideal candidate combines strong instructional design, animation and video production skills, experience with technical audiences, and familiarity with HVAC systems and controls.

  • Conduct needs analyses to identify performance gaps, learner characteristics, and business goals for targeted audiences.

Ensure alignment with the new product development process to release training prior to product launch.

  • Monitor trends in learning and development, benchmarking best practices to enhance training programs continuously.

  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and collaboration platforms (SharePoint, Teams, etc.).

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

Serve as a seasoned functional consultant specializing in Informatica cloud data governance and metadata solutions for retail banking translating complex business requirements into scalable data governance frameworks that enhance data trust regulatory compliance and analytical value while collaborating across hybrid teams in a day shift work model.


Responsibilities

  • Drive end to end functional consulting activities by translating retail banking data governance needs into practical configurations across Informatica cloud platforms to improve data quality and regulatory compliance outcomes
  • Define detailed business requirements for data lineage metadata management and data marketplace capabilities ensuring alignment with retail banking processes such as deposits lending cards and digital channels
  • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to design data governance workflows leveraging Informatica AXON and data catalog capabilities that support clear ownership stewardship and approval paths
  • Configure and validate metadata structures in Infa Cloud Metadata Cmd Center and Informatica EDC so that critical banking data elements are consistently documented discoverable and trusted by analytics and reporting teams
  • Develop and refine use cases for Infa Cloud Data Marketplace enabling secure and efficient data sharing across risk compliance marketing and operations while enforcing policy driven access controls
  • Establish robust data quality and governance rules in Infa Cloud Data Gov and Catalog that reflect regulatory expectations for retail banking including KYC AML credit risk monitoring and customer privacy
  • Guide stakeholders through impact assessments of data changes by using catalog and lineage insights to reduce operational risk minimize reporting discrepancies and improve audit readiness
  • Produce comprehensive functional specifications and user stories that describe data governance behaviors exception handling and approval flows enabling engineering teams to implement solutions with clarity and accuracy
  • Conduct functional testing and user acceptance validation for data governance and marketplace features ensuring that metadata lineage workflows and stewardship processes operate reliably under real world banking scenarios
  • Provide structured functional training and coaching to data stewards business analysts and compliance partners so they can effectively use AXON EDC and associated cloud tools to manage their data assets
  • Monitor adoption metrics and user feedback for the implemented governance capabilities and iteratively refine configurations to maximize business value and operational efficiency in hybrid work settings
  • Document governance standards data definitions and usage guidelines in a clear accessible way so that retail banking teams can consistently interpret and apply shared data assets across channels
  • Align daily consulting activities with the organization purpose by enabling ethical transparent and well governed use of customer data contributing to safer financial services and improved societal trust in banking


Qualifications

  • Demonstrate extensive functional consulting experience of more than twelve years with strong focus on enterprise data governance solutions in complex financial services environments
  • Show advanced hands on expertise in Infa Cloud Metadata Cmd Center Infa Cloud Data Marketplace Infa Cloud Data Gov and Catalog ensuring confident design and configuration of integrated governance workflows
  • Apply deep practical knowledge of Informatica EDC to drive effective metadata discovery lineage analysis and asset classification for large scale retail banking data ecosystems
  • Leverage substantial experience in Informatica AXON Data Govern to define governance frameworks stewardship models and collaborative workflows that reflect the realities of regulated banking operations
  • Bring proven domain expertise in retail banking including familiarity with core banking systems customer lifecycle processes product portfolios branch and digital operations and regulatory reporting needs
  • Utilize strong skills in requirements elicitation stakeholder communication and documentation to bridge business expectations with technical implementation in hybrid work models without travel obligations

Certifications Required

Preferred certifications include Informatica Certified Professional in Data Governance or Metadata Management and any recognized data management or banking domain certification.

title: Transfer Center Coordinator (Per Diem, Variable)
description:
At NorthBay Health the Transfer Center Coordinator is a critical role in the NorthBay Health system facilitating both inbound and outbound transfers. The Transfer Center Coordinator is responsible for facilitating and coordinating patient transfers both inbound/outbound, tertiary transfers both emergent and urgent, consults from NorthBay Health to tertiary acute care hospitals. Sets up systems to enable both cost containment and quality patient care. This position requires excellent communication and organizational skills to ensure seamless coordination between various departments, healthcare facilities, and external agencies.

The Transfer Center Coordinator works collaboratively with all areas of NorthBay Health to facilitate timely and appropriate transfer of patients regardless of complaint or need. This position will require liaison with the case management/utilization review team as well as the Administrative Coordinator. Areas of focus are capitated patients, repatriations, emergent and urgent transfers, notification calls to health plans, re-triage of pediatric/trauma/stroke/stemi patients.

title: Principal Product Security Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Your Impact


Would you like the opportunity to work on some of the UK's most progressive defence programmes, influencing the security of ground-breaking technologies that will help protect national security for years to come? In return, you'll join a collaborative team of experts committed to technical excellence and continuous advancement.


Our Integrated Sensors and Protection Systems (ISP) Design Integrity team is looking for a Principal Security Engineer to secure the next generation of defence protection systems. Working closely with engineering specialists, you'll ensure that security is embedded throughout the product lifecycle, helping to develop resilient, compliant and threat-resistant solutions that protect our customers and their missions.


Your responsibilities will include:


  • Defining and managing product security requirements, providing expert guidance to integrated project teams on security standards, methodologies and best practice.
  • Developing and implementing security processes, tools and protocols that enable our technologies to stay ahead of evolving threats.
  • Producing and maintaining key security artefacts, including Risk Assessments, Threat Analyses and Remediation Action Plans.
  • Driving security assurance activities throughout the full product lifecycle, ensuring solutions are secure by design, compliant and operationally resilient.
  • Supporting the continuous improvement of security engineering capability, processes and ways of working across the business.
  • Collaborating with security specialists, including Product Cyber Resilience Managers and the Head of Product Security, to deliver effective security assurance and risk management.

What you’ll bring:


  • Practical experience of ISO27001/27004/27005 and NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF).
  • Experience of supporting a security risk management system for highly regulated products based on recognised frameworks such as aerospace, nuclear, automotive, rail or oil and gas.
  • Understanding and appreciation of the Engineering development lifecycles and how the Product Security specialism aligns.
  • Ability to interpret Penetration Test Reports and support remediation action.
  • Awareness of UK Government Assurance Processes.

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.


Security Clearance


This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting


Why join us


At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.

  • Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
  • Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
  • Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
  • Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
  • Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part-time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.


Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 53,000 people worldwide including 8,500 across 9 sites in the UK. Our employees are not just part of a team—they are key contributors to shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.

description:

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION


Job Title: Program Analyst, Strategic Plan
Team: Strategic Plan Operations
Reports to: Manager, Strategic Plan Operations
