title: Online Crs Developer - Advanced Psychopathology & Psychopharmacology
description:
Position Title: Adjunct Online Course Developer -Advanced Psychopathology & Psychopharmacology
# of Openings: 1
Department/Program: Academic Affairs 41000
Work Location: 100% Remote
Campus Location: Arapahoe Campus
Reports to: Mary McHenry, Senior Director of Innovative Teaching & Learning
FLSA Classification: Exempt/Salaried
FTE: 25% (10 hrs/week)
Compensation: $5,000

Application Deadline: 7/1 or until filled

Job Summary

Naropa University’s Master of Arts in Clinical Mental Health Counseling program seeks an experienced curriculum/content developer to design a hybrid (asynchronous/synchronous) version of the three-credit course CNSG 770E- Advanced Psychopathology & Psychopharmacology during the spring 2027 course development cycle. This position is for developing the online content only, though there may be the opportunity for applicants to teach the course in a future semester.

Course Description: CNSG 770E - Advanced Psychopathology & Psychopharmacology

This advanced graduate course integrates psychopathology, DSM-5-TR diagnosis, clinical assessment, treatment planning, psychopharmacology, neurobiology, and interdisciplinary collaboration. Students develop competency in recognizing mental disorders, conducting differential diagnosis, selecting appropriate assessment strategies, understanding psychotropic medications, collaborating with prescribers, and integrating biological, psychological, developmental, relational, multicultural, and contemplative perspectives into treatment planning.

Particular emphasis is placed on ethical scope of practice, medication referral, integrated care, trauma-informed assessment, and whole-person conceptualization. Additionally, focused attention is given to contextual dimensions of clinical mental health counseling, examining the roles, interdisciplinary relationships, legal/fiscal systems, community needs assessment, levels of care and community intervention, and core administrative and practice-management principles across public, private, and independent practice settings.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

· Create an eight-module, hybrid (asynchronous/synchronous) online course in the timeframe of January – May 2027
· Generate (in conjunction with the Office of Educational Technologies) online content, including recorded lectures, practice sessions, and experiential learning activities; textual material; assignments; and assessment rubrics; and
· Create the online course with support of the Office of Educational Technologies, including the implementation of ADA-compliant readings, study guides, threaded discussions, quizzes, links to web resources, as appropriate with the course.
· Work with the Naropa instructional design team, develop an asynchronous online course, to be taught in Canvas, Naropa’s Learning Management System.
· Incorporate established best practices and follow essential procedures to design a quality online course. · Create and maintain a positive team environment and behave professionally with everyone encountered in the course and scope of the job duties

What Naropa Requires…

The instructor should have:

  • Doctoral degree (preferred) in Counselor Education, Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, or a closely related behavioral health field.
  • Active independent clinical license (e.g., LPCC/LPC, LMHC, Licensed Psychologist, or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated expertise in DSM-5-TR diagnosis, psychopathology, clinical assessment, and treatment planning.
  • Experience collaborating with psychiatrists and other medical providers in integrated behavioral health settings.
  • Graduate-level teaching experience in diagnosis, psychopathology, assessment, or psychopharmacology is strongly preferred.

Understanding of counselor scope of practice, including appropriate medication referral, interdisciplinary collaboration, and ethical practice. Research has long supported psychopharmacology instruction for counselors as an important component of counselor education, particularly to improve collaboration and referral competency.

Naropa recognizes the following holidays throughout the year: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Fall Break, 4th Thursday and Friday in November, and Winter Break, the last two weeks in December encompassing the Christmas holiday as well as New Year’s.

Naropa’s health and welfare benefits include the following: medical, dental, vision, FSA, HSA, employer-paid short-term and long-term disability, employer-paid life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment, an employer-sponsored pre-tax retirement savings plan, which includes up to 2.5% employer matching, and a variety of voluntary, employee-paid supplemental insurance plans.

Employees who work fewer than 20 hours per week are eligible to participate in Naropa’s retirement plan only, which includes up to 2.5% employer matching.

title: Identity Architect
description:
About Astellas

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com.

Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

Purpose and Scope:

As an Identity Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, administering, supporting, and modernizing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services, including Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic key management solutions. The role focuses on enhancing security, automating certificate operations, ensuring compliance, and delivering scalable certificate-based authentication and encryption services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.


Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

  • Administer, maintain, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including Microsoft Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), Registration Authorities (RA), Online Responders, and certificate lifecycle management platforms.
  • Manage certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, validation, and recovery processes for users, servers, applications, devices, and non-human identities.
  • Design, implement, and maintain PKI architectures, certificate templates, certificate policies, trust hierarchies, and cryptographic standards aligned with business and security requirements.
  • Support enterprise certificate lifecycle management solutions, automating certificate enrolment, renewal, discovery, inventory management, and compliance monitoring.
  • Administer and maintain Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), cryptographic key management systems, key backup procedures, and secure key storage practices.
  • Support digital certificate deployments across servers, applications, web services, databases, network devices, cloud services, VPNs, and authentication platforms.
  • Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication solutions, including Smart Cards, FIDO, device certificates, Wi-Fi authentication, VPN authentication, and mutual TLS (mTLS).
  • Monitor PKI infrastructure health, certificate expiration risks, cryptographic compliance, and security vulnerabilities to ensure continuous service availability.
  • Perform PKI assessments, health checks, audits, security reviews, remediation activities, and modernization initiatives aligned with industry best practices.
  • Support cloud-based PKI solutions, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, Azure Key Vault, and integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and security platforms.
  • Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and related scripting technologies to simplify certificate lifecycle management and operational activities.
  • Maintain PKI documentation, operational procedures, governance standards, audit evidence, and compliance requirements supporting regulatory and security obligations.

Job Description

The Standardized Patient is a professional contributor to the simulation experiences of WGU nurse practitioner students with educational experience as a Registered Nurse or Certified Teacher. This role is responsible for playing the part of the patient during the Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) for nurse practitioner students. During each OSCE the standardized patient plays the role of a fictional patient using a scripted case, is responsible for being prepared to play the specific role for each OSCE and is responsible for creating a backup recording of each completed OSCE. The standardized patient is responsible for helping students troubleshoot common technological issues during OSCEs and is punctual for student OSCE experiences. This individual is responsible for cultivating a robust community of practice around innovative and effective simulation experiences.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Responsible for playing the role of the patient during the Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) for nurse practitioner students.

  • Responsible for creating a backup recording of each completed OSCE.
  • Responsible for helping students troubleshoot common technological issues during OSCEs.
  • Remains punctual for student OSCE experiences.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Ability to effectively communicate with students acting as providers and WGU faculty.

  • Must demonstrate technological competency: OSCE recording and communication platforms.

title: Director of Enterprise Security
description:
Our Commitment to You

At Consumer Cellular, recruiting is human. Every application is reviewed by a real member of our Talent Acquisition team because we believe the people behind the résumé matter just as much as what's on it.

All official communication from Consumer Cellular will come from a @consumercellular.com email address or through our verified texting platform, which will only be used to schedule interviews. We will never ask for personal and financial information during the recruiting process. If you receive outreach that doesn't match these criteria, please do not engage and feel free to verify directly at talentacquisition@consumercellular.com.

Position Information
Consumer Cellular is seeking a Director of Enterprise Security to change how security works here. Today it is a central gatekeeper; this role will build it into product delivery and day-to-day operations. You’ll protect Consumer Cellular employees, customers and company data, keep us compliant with regulations and reduce business risk while we move to an AI-first, cloud-native technology stack.

You will lead three areas\:

  • Security Operations, including Resilience & Recovery
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance, including Identity & Access Governance.
  • DevSecOps & Application Security.

You’ll also move security operations to an automation-first, AI-assisted model. The right candidate makes decisions and delivers measurable risk reduction rather than more analysis. They build a lean team of senior people and make security easy for the business to work with.

You will need to reside within 50 miles of our Corporate Headquarters in Scottsdale, AZ as this role has the option of hybrid or onsite.

What You'll Do\:

Strategy & Operating Model

  • Set and carry out the enterprise security strategy. Replace review boards and approval bottlenecks with secure-by-design practices that keep pace with delivery.
  • Rethink how security work gets done. Use automation, and managed services where they fit, to remove low-value manual work so people can focus on high-value decisions.
  • Build and lead a lean, senior team. Hire and coach managers, and hold them accountable to clear KPIs and SLAs.
  • Own the security budget, forecasts and vendor portfolio, including MDR/MSSP partners.
  • Report security posture, risk and results to executive leadership and the board in business terms.

Security Operations & Resilience

  • Lead the move to an automation-first, AI-assisted SOC. AI handles triage, investigation and response under human oversight, and gets more autonomy as audit trails and confidence grow.
  • Set a data-driven baseline for the SOC. Bring alert sources into one operational view, expand SIEM telemetry and report regularly on detection and response.
  • Evaluate and manage MDR/MSSP partners using evidence-based scorecards.
  • Direct incident response, forensics and investigations, and work with Technology Operations on major incidents.
  • Run the threat intelligence and vulnerability management programs, and work with Infrastructure to meet remediation SLAs.
  • Run a resilience program that assumes a breach will happen\: cyber recovery and DR exercises, tabletop tests and checks that every managed device meets security requirements.
  • Oversee email security, endpoint security and encryption services.

Identity & Access

  • Lead an identity-first program\: know who has access to what, enforce least privilege and remove standing privilege.
  • Modernize privileged access and credential management. Consolidate unmanaged credential stores and monitor privileged accounts.
  • Work with HR and Enterprise Systems on role-based access and automated onboarding, role changes and offboarding, with regular access reviews and full audit trails.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Own the compliance programs, including PCI DSS v4.0.1 and telecom obligations such as CPNI, SIM-swap/port-out protections and consumer-protection rules. Keep a map of who is accountable for each control across teams.
  • Move toward continuous compliance, with policy-as-code and automatic detection when systems drift out of compliance.
  • Make security requests easy to track. Vendor risk reviews, exceptions and access requests should go through transparent workflows so the business can see status and owner.
  • Lead third-party and vendor risk management.
  • Run data protection\: data classification, encryption, DLP and privacy controls.
  • Run security awareness and training.

DevSecOps & Application Security

  • Build the DevSecOps and AppSec function. Start with a validated application inventory and data classification, then add SAST, DAST, software composition analysis (SCA) and secrets scanning to CI/CD pipelines.
  • Give engineering teams secure patterns, guardrails and self-service tools so they own the security of their own services.
  • Work with Infrastructure on cloud security (Azure/AWS), guardrails for infrastructure-as-code and Zero Trust networking.

AI Security & Governance

  • Share ownership of governance for AI agents and tools\: agent identity, least-privilege access, audit logging and human approval for high-risk actions.
  • Work with SRE and Platform Engineering on a shared, secure platform for AI agents.

Do you enjoy helping students navigate important financial decisions? Are you equally comfortable interpreting complex regulations, presenting to a room full of students, and developing innovative solutions that improve the student experience? If so, you may be exactly who we're looking for.


Roseman University College of Medicine is seeking an Assistant Director of Financial Aid who can combine financial aid expertise, student-centered service, compliance knowledge, and strategic thinking to support the next generation of physicians.


At Roseman, financial aid is more than awarding funds. It's about helping students make informed decisions that can shape their futures for years to come. As Assistant Director of Financial Aid, you'll play a critical role in guiding medical students through every stage of their educational journey, from admission through graduation and residency transition.


This is also an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing College of Medicine. Today, we support approximately 125 medical students, with enrollment expected to grow to nearly 400 students in the coming years. You'll have the opportunity to influence processes, develop innovative student support programs, and help shape the future of financial aid services during a transformational period of growth.


What You'll Do and Why You'll Love This Role:


Guide and Support Future Physicians

  • Provide individualized financial aid counseling, debt management guidance, and financial wellness support.
  • Help students understand borrowing options, budgeting strategies, and repayment planning.
  • Serve as a trusted resource throughout the student lifecycle, from admission through residency transition.

Shape the Future of Financial Aid Services

  • Play a leadership role in scaling financial aid operations as the College of Medicine grows.
  • Review and process financial aid awarding, verification, and related operational processes
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, enhance the student experience, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Analyze data and trends to support strategic planning and informed decision-making.
  • Serve as a trusted partner to departmental leadership and provide operational guidance in the absence of the Director.

Educate and Empower Students

  • Develop and deliver presentations, workshops, and educational programming.
  • Promote responsible borrowing, financial literacy, budgeting, and debt management.
  • Conduct one-on-one debt management sessions and group financial wellness programs.

Drive Compliance and Continuous Improvement

  • Stay current on federal financial aid regulations, AAMC best practices, and LCME standards.
  • Assist with audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory reporting.
  • Lead operational projects, process improvements, and technology initiatives that enhance service delivery and efficiency.

Partner Across the University

  • Collaborate with Admissions, Student Affairs, and University leadership to support enrollment, retention, and student success.
  • Analyze borrowing trends and financial aid utilization data to support strategic decision-making.
  • Serve as the department's operational lead in the absence of the Director of Financial Aid.

What You'll Bring (Qualifications):


Required

✅ Bachelor's degree in a related field and three (3) years of progressively responsible experience in higher education financial aid, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

✅ Experience advising students or clients regarding financial aid, financial literacy, debt management, or related topics

✅ Experience conducting presentations, workshops, or educational programs

✅ Experience with Anthology Student Financial Aid or similar enterprise financial aid management systems

✅ Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

✅ Ability to manage multiple priorities while exercising sound judgment

✅ Strong knowledge of federal student aid regulations, policies, and compliance requirements

✅ Excellent customer service and relationship-building skills


Preferred

⭐ Experience supporting financial aid programs for medical, health professions, or other graduate/professional students

⭐ Familiarity with LCME accreditation standards and AAMC financial aid best practices

⭐ Experience with financial aid audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory reporting

⭐ Experience analyzing data and developing recommendations to improve operations and student outcomes

Benefits and Perks:


At Roseman University, we believe exceptional employees deserve exceptional benefits. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance at every stage of your career.


Our benefits include:

  • Multiple medical, dental, and vision plan options, including some available at no cost to employees
  • Generous 403(b) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 7.5% and immediate vesting
  • Employer-paid life insurance and disability protection
  • Tax-advantaged healthcare savings accounts
  • Wellness, mental health resources, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation and sick leave, six paid holidays, an extended Thanksgiving break, and up to three weeks of paid campus closures each year

At Roseman, we're committed to creating an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Our benefits and time-off programs reflect our dedication to supporting the people who help make our mission possible.


Why Join Us?

If you're ready to combine financial wellness, student advocacy, strategy, and operational leadership while helping future physicians achieve their goals, we invite you to join our growing team.


Salary Range: $68,000-$72,000


Make an impact. Empower students. Help shape the future of medical education.

Roseman University of Health Sciences is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Financial Reporting, Senior Associate
description:
Who we are looking for

Join the Financial Reporting team and learn the rules and regulations that drive financial statement disclosures and other regulatory filings. As a Financial Reporting Senior Associate you will work with team members to produce and/or review client monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual financial statements, regulatory filings and other periodic reporting as per GAAP requirements. You will engage with clients, auditors and other State Street teams to resolve issues, answer inquiries and process comments while working towards readying client financial statements and filings for finalization. You will also help assist with the activities of offshore teams.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Services (SSGS). SSGS gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for

As Financial Reporting, Senior Associate you will

  • You will prepare and review interim and annual financial statements in accordance with relevant GAAP requirements for alternative investments funds.
  • You will perform 1st level or 2nd level reviews on client financial statements, regulatory reports, process and clear comments and assist with draft and support distribution to client and auditors.
  • You will maintain electronic documentation for each respective fund during a given reporting cycle.
  • You will ensure that all deliverables are completed accurately and within agreed upon time.
  • You will implement all standard practices, processes, tools, and technology enhancements.
  • You will participate in the research and resolution of accounting, client and auditor issues.
  • You will draft and update task lists for both local and offshoring partners, ensure all supporting documentation is available to them and act as primary contact to answer their questions and issues.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Demonstrates strong technology skills, as well as problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Demonstrates an ability to be a leader within their team, as well as be a leader amongst your peers.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, which includes excellent time management skills.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • BS/BA in Business, Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in related accounting or finance field preferred.

About State Street

What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

Work, Live and Grow. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility. We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

$51,000 - $84,000 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Cafeteria Worker
description:
💚 About The WOW Center

At The WOW Center, we believe that every person deserves the opportunity to grow, connect, and thrive. Our culture is rooted in compassion, inclusion, and genuine joy in what we do. We don’t just teach — we empower adults with developmental disabilities to live more confidently, independently, and meaningfully within their communities.

We are guided by our core values of Empathy, Excellence, Passion, Serving, Teamwork, and Continuous Improvement — principles that shape how we support the individuals we serve, collaborate with one another, and grow as an organization every day.

If you’re someone who loves uplifting others, celebrates wins big and small, and thrives in a collaborative environment, you’ll feel right at home here.


You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You're dependable, organized, and detail-oriented, and you take pride in keeping things running smoothly. You enjoy working with food, maintaining a clean and welcoming environment, and making sure everyone receives their meals safely and on time.


You're comfortable following established procedures, keeping accurate records, and managing daily responsibilities independently. Most importantly, you're someone who takes pride in your work, treats others with dignity and respect, and enjoys contributing to a greater purpose.


You enjoy a consistent, part-time schedule! This position works Monday through Friday, approximately 10:00 AM–2:00 PM (20 hours per week), offering predictable daytime hours with no evenings or weekends.


What You'll Do…

As our Cafeteria Worker, you'll play an important role in making sure the individuals we serve receive safe, nutritious meals in a clean, organized, and welcoming environment. You'll oversee daily meal service, receive and distribute catered lunches, monitor food temperatures, and accommodate special dietary needs. You'll also maintain food safety records, manage cafeteria supplies, and help ensure our food program meets applicable health and safety requirements.


Beyond meal service, you'll be a valued part of The WOW Center community, building positive relationships with the individuals we serve and helping make lunchtime a safe, enjoyable, and welcoming part of their day.



🎓 Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or above
  • One (1) year of experience in food service industry preferred
  • Demonstrates good verbal and writing skills in English
  • Dress in a professional manner
  • Consistently reliable and dependable


🌱 Professional Responsibilities and Duties

  • Oversees daily food service and distribution operations, ensuring compliance with Adult Food Care Program requirements and applicable health and safety regulations.
  • Receives catered meals daily, checks food temperatures upon arrival and before serving, and rejects or returns food that does not meet safe temperature standards.
  • Prepares and distributes meals to designated lunch areas, including plating food and transporting meal carts.
  • Monitors and accommodates individuals' special dietary requirements.
  • Records food temperatures and checks refrigerator and freezer temperatures twice daily, maintaining accurate temperature logs.
  • Maintains daily meal counts and required food program documentation.
  • Monitors inventory of food service supplies, including plates, cups, and utensils, and submits supply requests as needed.
  • Coordinates with catering vendors regarding meal service needs, special events, and program activities.
  • Maintains a clean, sanitary, and organized kitchen, including food storage and refrigeration areas.
  • Ensures food quality, handling, and storage meet applicable Department of Health standards.
  • Supports health inspections by maintaining compliance records, responding to inspectors' questions, and addressing identified concerns.

title: Financial & Grants Analyst
description:
Summary

The City of Garland is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical professional to serve as a Financial & Grants Analyst. This position provides financial, accounting, underwriting, auditing, and grant administration support for City programs and initiatives.


The ideal candidate will have a strong financial background with experience or education in accounting, banking, lending, underwriting, auditing, or financial analysis. Municipal accounting or grant experience is preferred but is not required. The position is well suited for an individual who enjoys working with numbers and detailed financial information, learns new processes quickly, and communicates effectively with both internal staff and the public.


Target Pay Range: $55,946.07- 63,596.62 (Depending on qualifications and experience)

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Financial Analysis and Review

  • Review financial statements, tax returns, bank statements, income documentation, budgets, invoices, and other financial records.
  • Assist with financial reviews and underwriting for City loan, housing, rehabilitation, development, and assistance programs.
  • Review applicant and borrower financial information for completeness, accuracy, and program eligibility.
  • Calculate income, debt-to-income ratios, loan-to-value ratios, project costs, funding gaps, repayment amounts, and other financial measures as required.
  • Identify discrepancies, missing documentation, or financial information requiring additional review.
  • Prepare worksheets, financial summaries, and supporting documentation for management review.

Accounting and Financial Support

  • Review invoices, payment requests, purchase orders, reimbursements, and other financial transactions for accuracy and proper documentation.
  • Assist with monitoring program budgets, expenditures, revenues, commitments, and available funding.
  • Reconcile financial records among City accounting systems, program systems, spreadsheets, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with expenditure reports, reconciliations, budget information, fiscal year-end activities, and audit preparation.
  • Research financial discrepancies and work with appropriate staff to resolve issues.
  • Maintain organized and accurate financial documentation in accordance with City procedures.

Grants and Program Administration

  • Assist with the financial administration of federal, state, local, and other grant-funded programs.
  • Review grant-related expenditures and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and eligibility.
  • Assist with grant budgets, reimbursement requests, expenditure tracking, financial reporting, reconciliations, and funding drawdowns.
  • Maintain documentation necessary to support grant and program compliance.
  • Assist with monitoring contractors, nonprofit organizations, subrecipients, developers, borrowers, and other organizations receiving City funding.
  • Learn and apply applicable grant regulations, program guidelines, City policies, and procedures.

Auditing, Compliance and Reporting

  • Assist with internal financial reviews, monitoring activities, and audits.
  • Review files and financial documentation for completeness, accuracy, required approvals, and supporting records.
  • Identify documentation deficiencies and communicate needed corrections.
  • Create and maintain spreadsheets used to track financial and program information.
  • Prepare reports, charts, summaries, and presentations for staff and management.
  • Perform research and compile financial or program information for management review.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Public Administration, Economics, Banking, or a closely related field.
  • One to three years of related professional experience in accounting, banking or lending, loan processing or underwriting, credit analysis, financial analysis, auditing, budgeting, governmental or municipal finance, financial compliance, or grant administration.
  • Recent graduates with a strong educational background and relevant internship or practical experience may also be considered.

Or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

Preferred Qualifications

Education/ Experience:

  • Experience in banking, lending, loan processing, underwriting, accounting, auditing, or financial analysis.
  • Experience in municipal or governmental accounting or finance.
  • Experience in federal, state, or local grant programs.
  • Experience reviewing individual or business tax returns or other financial eligibility documentation.
  • Experience with housing, community development, economic development, or public-sector programs.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with financial or grant-management software.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organization.
  • Good mathematical, financial, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to review financial information and identity discrepancies, missing information, or unusual items.
  • Basic understanding of accounting and financial principles.
  • Ability to understand and follow policies, procedures, contracts, and program requirements.
  • Ability to learn governmental and grant requirements, new programs, and software applications quickly.
  • Ability to maintain confidential financial and personal information.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and customer-service skills.
  • Ability to explain financial or program requirements clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Software and Technology Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is required, with advanced Microsoft Excel skills preferred.
  • Microsoft Excel: formulas and functions, financial calculations, sorting and filtering, data analysis, pivot tables, lookup functions, reconciliations, and financial tracking.
  • Microsoft Word: reports, correspondence, forms, procedures, and financial/program documentation.
  • Microsoft PowerPoint: staff presentations, charts, graphs, and management summaries.
  • Microsoft Teams: meetings, communication, file sharing, document collaboration, and team coordination.
  • Ability to quickly learn City financial, accounting, grant management, loan management, and program administration software.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Valid Class C Texas driver's license

Physical Requirements / Work Environment

The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The incumbent works in a typical office environment; relatively free from unpleasant environmental conditions or hazards.

title: Underwriting Technician - Hybrid
description:

title: Temporary Patient Liaison
description:
Who We Are

At the ASPCA® (American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals), we’re proud to work with a broad and talented team of professionals who help drive our mission to prevent animal cruelty and promote their well-being across the country. Since 1866, we’ve been at the forefront of animal welfare, and every member of our extended team contributes to our hands-on work, advocacy, and education efforts. By working with the ASPCA, you’re helping improve the lives of animals and the people who care about them.


What You’ll Do

The Temporary Patient Liaison (TPL) is a vital member of the Community Medicine(CM) team who works directly with clients and the medical teams to ensure seamless delivery of services and a judgement free, high-quality experience for all. The TPL schedules medical appointments, welcomes clients to the clinic, answers questions about our program, assists with data entry and collects payments for services. The PL is the trusted source of information and support for families seeking assistance for their pets.


Temporary Role Details:


  • This is a temporary, contingent position and the person hired will be employed through a third-party staffing agency.
  • The target hiring range for this temporary role is $25.86 per hour and may be modified in the future.

title: Healthcare Project Manager
description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

PROCEDEO is seeking an experienced Healthcare Project Manager to lead healthcare construction projects in Colorado. This position is responsible for the successful planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of healthcare construction projects, including work within occupied and operational healthcare environments.

The Healthcare Project Manager has primary responsibility for the financial, technical, operational, and client-service success of assigned projects. This individual will lead project teams and trade partners while coordinating closely with healthcare owners, facility leadership, Infection Prevention, Facilities/Engineering, clinical stakeholders, design professionals, and other project partners.

The successful candidate will bring strong commercial construction project management experience combined with demonstrated knowledge of the unique requirements associated with healthcare construction, including infection-control practices, occupied-facility construction, critical system shutdowns, life-safety requirements, phased construction, and maintaining continuity of patient care and healthcare operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain ultimate responsibility for the financial and technical success of assigned projects.
  • Review plans, specifications, and contract documents for accuracy, constructability, scope coordination, sequencing, and potential risk.
  • Establish and maintain baseline and detailed project schedules, including subcontractor activities, owner milestones, inspections, shutdowns, equipment installations, commissioning, and turnover.
  • Track project costs and forecasts and manage change orders, RFIs, owner pay applications, subcontractor pay applications, and other financial controls.
  • Oversee document control, shop drawings, submittals, procurement logs, closeout documentation, and other required project records.
  • Write, negotiate, and administer subcontracts and purchase orders.
  • Manage subcontractor performance and relationships and conduct regular project and jobsite coordination meetings.
  • Lead construction planning and coordination within occupied and operational healthcare environments, including hospitals, medical centers, outpatient facilities, clinics, laboratories, surgical facilities, and other clinical settings.
  • Understand and support implementation of Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA) requirements, including barriers, containment, negative air, HEPA filtration, dust control, pressure relationships, temporary partitions, protected pathways, and construction access controls.
  • Coordinate construction activities with healthcare Infection Prevention, Facilities/Engineering, clinical leadership, Security, Risk Management, owners, and other facility stakeholders.
  • Plan and coordinate construction phasing around active patient-care areas while minimizing disruption to patients, visitors, healthcare personnel, and ongoing facility operations.
  • Coordinate critical shutdowns, utility interruptions, tie-ins, demolition, above-ceiling work, temporary conditions, emergency egress, and fire/life-safety requirements.
  • Ensure project planning accounts for sensitive clinical environments such as operating rooms, emergency departments, ICUs, imaging areas, laboratories, pharmacies, and procedural spaces when applicable.
  • Coordinate required shutdown plans, Safe Work Plans, ICRA documentation, interim life-safety measures, and other healthcare-specific construction documentation with the project team.
  • Proactively identify construction activities that could affect patient care, infection prevention, critical systems, emergency operations, or healthcare facility continuity and develop appropriate mitigation plans before work begins.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for healthcare clients and maintain proactive, consistent communication throughout the project.
  • Build credibility and trusted relationships with healthcare owners, facility leadership, Infection Prevention teams, design professionals, consultants, trade partners, and other project stakeholders.
  • Lead project meetings and communicate project status, schedule, financial performance, risks, changes, and upcoming critical activities.
  • Anticipate client needs and proactively resolve issues that could affect project delivery or healthcare operations.
  • Promote collaboration between project management, field operations, safety, quality, preconstruction, and trade partners.

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 5 years of commercial construction project management experience, with significant experience managing healthcare construction projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing construction within occupied and operational healthcare facilities strongly preferred.
  • Experience with hospital renovations, additions, expansions, new healthcare facilities, outpatient facilities, medical office buildings, clinics, laboratories, or similar healthcare environments.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare construction requirements, including ICRA, infection-control practices, life-safety requirements, construction phasing, shutdowns, utility interruptions, and work adjacent to active patient-care areas.
  • Detailed understanding of construction project sequencing, scheduling, budgeting, cost control, procurement, and change management.
  • Advanced understanding of construction drawings, specifications, constructability, and coordination between architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and specialty healthcare systems.
  • Ability to negotiate, write, execute, and administer subcontract agreements and purchase orders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and competing operational priorities.
  • Strong leadership, problem-solving, organizational, written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with healthcare owners, design teams, facility personnel, clinical stakeholders, subcontractors, and internal project teams.
  • Must work effectively in a team environment and demonstrate a strong commitment to client service.
  • Experience with CMAR and/or Design-Build delivery methods preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Bluebeam, and Procore.
  • Valid Driver's License.
  • Travel and/or relocation may be required based on project assignments.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Construction Technology, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Equivalent education and substantial directly applicable healthcare construction experience may be considered.

PREFERRED HEALTHCARE EXPERIENCE & CREDENTIALS

  • Formal ICRA healthcare construction training or certification.
  • Experience coordinating with healthcare Infection Prevention and Facilities/Engineering departments.
  • Knowledge of applicable NFPA and healthcare fire/life-safety requirements.
  • Familiarity with The Joint Commission, DNV, CMS, and other healthcare regulatory or accreditation requirements as they relate to construction activities.
  • Experience managing construction in highly sensitive clinical environments.
  • OSHA 30-Hour Construction certification preferred.

Employment Benefits:

Employee Benefits include a negotiable salary, 401K (with company match), full medical/dental/vision insurance, paid time off, life and disability insurance, paid maternity and paternity leave, tuition reimbursement, HSA and FSA medical plans as available to fulltime company employees.

About the PROCEDEO Group:

PROCEDEO is a national leader in alternative project delivery methods for architecture and construction, as well as cutting-edge construction technology within the education and municipal sectors. We oversee full portfolios of capital projects for K-12 districts, municipalities and universities from conception through all phases of procurement to completion. Our team prides itself on providing exceptional service while remaining attentive to client needs. We specialize in delivering projects efficiently and effectively, maintaining a client-focused approach. PROCEDEO is an equal employment opportunity company. For more information on our culture, history and portfolio of work and services, please visit www.procedeogroup.com.

Procedeo provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. title: Senior DevOps Engineer – Kubernetes
description:
Are you Prorenata's next Senior DevOps Engineer?

We are looking for an experienced DevOps engineer who knows Kubernetes well. We are growing our DevOps team as we move from managed Kubernetes to building and running our own clusters. You will help us build this platform from the ground up.

Prorenata builds user-friendly, effective and engaging tools for people who are often stuck with old and hard-to-use systems. We have been profitable for more than ten years, we are growing fast, and our office is in central Stockholm.

Our main product, Prorenata Journal, is a record system for school health services. It is used by about 80% of Sweden's municipalities. We are now also launching Flow, a new product for case management. Our products are medical devices under the EU medical device rules (MDR), so quality and security are part of everything we do.

Our platform runs on Kubernetes on OpenStack at the Swedish cloud provider Elastx. We use open source tools such as Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, GitHub Actions, Grafana and OpenSearch.

Prorenata's history

Prorenata was founded in 2010 and has grown on its own by about 25% per year. We are fully funded by our customers, and their needs guide our work.

"We want to build tools that help people make a difference." – Jens Alm, CEO and founder

We are mostly family owned and have about 65 employees.

About the role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Prorenata, you will join our DevOps team of three people and report to the DevOps team lead. Together you will take over the running of our Kubernetes platform.

Our systems hold sensitive health data about children and young people. That is why we invest a lot in security, including hardening our Kubernetes clusters. You will play a key part in this work.

There is no on-call duty outside office hours today. During office hours, the team takes turns being on call. After-hours on-call may be added in the future.

Responsibilities include

  • Setting up, running and improving our own Kubernetes clusters on OpenStack
  • Hardening the clusters and helping keep our platform secure
  • Working with our deploy pipelines and infrastructure code
  • Working with logging and monitoring, so we can see problems early
  • Helping our developers ship code safely and quickly
  • Sharing what you know with the team

What we are looking for

You must have solid hands-on experience of setting up and running Kubernetes clusters.

It is a plus if you have experience with:

  • CI/CD pipelines
  • OpenStack
  • Log management
  • Running databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL)
  • Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, GitHub Actions, Grafana or OpenSearch
  • Using AI agents in DevOps work, for example letting AI tools help you build, run or fix infrastructure

We also like people who are curious and have worked with many different technologies. But hands-on Kubernetes experience is a must.

You can do this job in English. Swedish is a plus, since Swedish is the everyday language at the office.

We offer

  • A workplace with great chances to learn and grow, both in your skills and as a person.
  • A warm and helpful culture with really nice and fun colleagues. We believe in being a team and having fun along the way.
  • A hybrid workplace: we value meeting at the office (3 days a week) for teamwork and culture, and we also offer the freedom to work from home some days.
  • The chance to work on a product that makes a difference for its users.
  • A fair market salary and generous benefits.

Does this sound like you?

This role is critical for managing regulatory information utilizing IDMP requirements as a baseline. It involves building a system landscape that unlocks the potential of data, wherein a centralized repository for accurate and up-to-date regulatory information.

In close collaboration with DigitalX Pod or Value Team Captains and business leads, this role will facilitate IDMP, CMC, and other regulatory requirements through the creation, governance, and maintenance of accurate, unique, and standardized data records and models, reducing time for product approvals. The role will be responsible for defining and implementing data modeling standards, business rules, data structures, and relationships that support regulatory data domains, while fully leveraging platform capabilities and functionality to enforce data standardization, quality, and uniqueness. This will be aligned with IDMP requirements to enable interoperability and seamless data exchange across internal and external systems.

Working with a diverse range of stakeholders across Research and Development (R&D) and DigitalX, the incumbent will be involved in designing and developing solutions including Master Data Management that render a good view of how the Clinical Trial Data, and Regulatory data, including the Pharmaceutical Product master data, is connected to all systems, pre-market, and FDA/EMA approved products, ensuring a molecule to market foundational solution for regulatory compliance

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for modelling Master Data Management (MDM) features and capabilities on Astellas enterprise platform. This role will work cross-functionally and is accountable for Business as Usual and new development activities.
  • Acts as a Subject Matter Expert in Regulatory data (e.g. product data) and associated data standards (e.g. IDMP)
  • Engages with business owners to define key business requirements and converts these requirements into data modelling and technical specifications.
  • In accordance with business requirements, develop all aspects of the solution including but not limited to Data modelling, Data Load/Export, perform complex mapping, matching and survivorship rules, data cleansing, deduplication, standardization, and data model configuration.
  • Be actively involved in testing and validation activities for all new development work. Coordinate with Foundation Data teams ensuring that Data Lakes and consuming systems reflect the accurate data.
  • Partner with Data Governance Specialists and Data Stewards to define business glossary terms, controlled terminology, metadata requirements, stewardship, quality rules, classifications, and semantic standards.
  • Map internal models to approved scientific, clinical, regulatory, and manufacturing ontologies, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, and industry standards.
  • Participate in design and code reviews to ensure solution capabilities deliver value, in partnership with key DigitalX and business stakeholders.
  • Maintain applicable security access and privileges, mapping users’ roles with appropriate Reltio custom roles.
  • Identify use cases to harmonize data across Clinical Trial Management, and Regulatory Data ensuring tracing and tracking of data sets across Pre-commercial to Medicinal Products.
  • Actively participate in maintaining the backlog of activities, on Azure DevOps services.

title: Principal DevOps Engineer - Secure Environments
description:
Job Description:

Your Impact

Are you ready to take on complex automation and DevOps challenges that underpin some of the UK's most critical missions?

At Leonardo, our Principal DevOps Engineers are recognised technical leaders who combine hands-on engineering with technical authority, helping to shape, automate and deliver secure platform solutions across highly controlled environments. You will work alongside platform, infrastructure, security and delivery teams to improve the speed, consistency, resilience and security of solution delivery through automation and modern engineering practices.

Your work at Leonardo UK will see you take the lead in solving customer problems in an agile, innovative and team-centric manner. Due to the nature of the programmes supported, the role will require regular and sustained attendance at secure customer locations, alongside working at Leonardo sites where programme and security constraints permit.

Leonardo UK is seeking a Principal DevOps Engineer to join the Cyber & Security Solutions Division team. This role is focused on developing, deploying, operating and improving automated platform solutions that underpin critical defence, government and public sector services.


What you will do as a Principal DevOps Engineer

  • Act as the technical authority for automation, DevOps and platform engineering practices across projects and programmes.
  • Lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code and platform automation solutions.
  • Develop and maintain secure deployment pipelines supporting highly controlled and regulated environments.
  • Work with Platform Engineers, Security Engineers, Architects and Project Teams to automate the deployment, configuration and operation of infrastructure and applications.
  • Lead the implementation and adoption of DevSecOps approaches, embedding security controls throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Capture, analyse and interpret technical requirements, producing high and low level designs where required.
  • Provide technical leadership for assigned work packages, including planning, estimation, delivery oversight and reporting.
  • Drive the adoption of automation, repeatability and engineering best practice across platform teams.
  • Mentor and coach DevOps Engineers, Platform Engineers and junior engineers, raising technical capability across the wider organisation.
  • Support technology assessments, feasibility studies, innovation activities and future capability planning.
  • Engage with customers and stakeholders, presenting, defending and assuring technical solutions.

What you'll bring

  • Extensive technical expertise across DevOps, automation and modern platform engineering practices.
  • The ability to balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership and mentorship.
  • Strong problem-solving capability with the confidence to recommend and justify technical approaches.
  • Experience driving automation and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
  • The ability to operate effectively within highly regulated, secure or defence-related environments.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work across engineering, delivery, security and customer teams.

Core areas (must have)

  • Design, implementation and operation of CI/CD pipelines.
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management.
  • Containerisation and orchestration technologies.
  • Automation and scripting using technologies such as Python, PowerShell or Bash.
  • Platform deployment pipelines and release automation.
  • DevOps and DevSecOps practices.
  • Secure software delivery and integration of security controls into engineering workflows.
  • Enterprise Git-based version control and branching strategies.
  • Cloud and hybrid platform technologies.
  • Experience delivering within highly controlled, secure or defence environments.
  • Technical leadership and mentoring of engineering teams.

Desirable

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be highly desirable:

  • VMware Aria Automation Suite.
  • VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), vSphere, vSAN or NSX.
  • OpenShift, Kubernetes or related container platforms.
  • Terraform, Ansible and platform automation tooling.
  • Infrastructure and platform monitoring solutions.
  • Secrets management, certificate management and PKI integration.
  • Privileged Access Management integration and automation.
  • Cross-domain or air-gapped deployment environments.
  • Active Directory and broader enterprise service integration.
  • Azure, AWS or hybrid cloud deployments.
  • Security monitoring and integration with SOC tooling.
  • Industry certifications in DevOps, Cloud, Security or Automation technologies.

Candidates are not expected to be specialists in every area. We are particularly interested in DevOps leaders who bring strong automation experience and can apply these skills across complex secure-platform environments.


Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government's Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS).

An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) will apply.

Due to the nature of the systems and environments supported, this role requires Developed Vetting (DV) clearance prior to starting.

For more information and guidance please visit the Leonardo UK careers security and vetting guidance.


Location

This role is based from our Bristol site and will support secure customer programmes delivered from Yeovil site and other secure locations.

Regular and sustained attendance at Yeovil site will be required.

Due to the nature of the environments supported, this is not a traditional hybrid role and candidates should expect significant on-site working throughout delivery activities.

Flexible or remote working may be possible for appropriate activities where programme, customer and security requirements permit.


Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

  • Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
  • Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
  • Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
  • Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
  • Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
  • Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
  • Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

title: Systems Engineer  - TS/SCI
description:

While most work is conducted on-site at our client location in Bethesda, MD, we offer a flexible schedule and, occasionally, some tasks may be performed remotely.


You will work closely with the team on the following key tasks:

  • Manage, direct, coordinate, and provide technical direction for all aspects of the team’s development efforts.
  • Plan, design, and oversee implementation of software development solutions. Provide technical support, coordination, and execution of systems engineering activities such as feature/requirements analysis, design, implementation planning, integration and test, sustainment, documentation, deployment, and system assessment.
  • Ensure sound engineering practices are followed.
  • Provide direction for interpretation and application of policies and procedures to the engineering and development activities.
  • Develop a working knowledge of government business processes and provide recommendations accordingly.
  • Collaborate with other development teams to identify and develop high-value integrations with other systems/applications.
  • Develop, manage and continually improve the backlog of work items for an Agile scrum team. Update and prioritize stories and epics via feedback from various program stakeholders ensuring the team is always working on the highest-value tasks.
  • Support Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) program increment planning and execution through creation of work tickets in GitLab as well as program/system documentation using collaboration software (e.g., GitLab wiki). Lead/participate in all Agile ceremonies to include daily stand up, planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Stay informed of increment and sprint progress and work with the team to identify and remove impediments and dependencies.
  • Perform backlog refinement on a regular basis. This may include decomposing features into workable stories, prioritizing or reprioritizing items in the backlog for upcoming sprints, refining acceptance criteria and complexity estimates or removing tickets that are no longer relevant.
  • Accept or reject completed work based on defined acceptance criteria to ensure delivery of high-quality software.
  • Lead the design and architecture of backend systems and services.
  • Drive initiatives across the engineering team related to scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Develop requirements and design documents
  • Contribute to and review RFCs, and requirements, design, and architecture reviews
  • Coordinate with Test Team to develop and monitor automated system integration tests to identify failed modules and components
  • Manage individual project priorities, deliverables, and deadlines
  • Provides specific input to the software components of system design to include hardware/software trade-offs, software reuse, use of COTS/GOTS in place of new development, and requirements analysis and synthesis from system level to individual software components
  • Foster an environment of collaboration with the different team members in the goal of providing quality service and product to our customers
  • Act as a mentor to mid-level and junior engineers, offering guidance on best practices and career growth


To be successful in this role you need the following (required qualifications):

  • BS in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related field and 12 – 15 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 10 – 13 years of prior relevant experience. Additional years of experience in lieu of degree are acceptable
  • Must have an active Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with Polygraph.
  • Software development experience in languages such as Java or Python.
  • Experience as a Systems Engineer, Product Owner, or a similar role in an Agile software development team.
  • Experience with requirements and design documentation, including process flow diagrams.
  • Demonstrated ability to break down complex problems into actionable steps.
  • Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs effectively.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, and experience with tools like Gitlab, Jira, and Confluence.
  • Experience with facilitating scrum for the team (Planning, Retrospective, Grooming & Review/Demo).
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) to articulate technical and non-technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and project management teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage expectations and maintain strong relationships with government and contractor stakeholders.


You will wow us even more if you have some of these skills:

  • Experience with Kafka or other message passing systems
  • Experience on a production/enterprise system
  • Cloud infrastructure experience
  • Experience with Appian or other low-code software technologies
  • Experience with any of the following technologies:
  • PostgreSQL
  • Containerization, especially with Docker
  • DevOps practices and tools including Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) tools and practices, especially Gitlab or Jenkins
  • GraphQL
  • Keycloak
  • Proactive in identifying tech debt, systemic issues, and areas for team/process improvement
  • Expertise building and maintaining microservices in production in Kubernetes
  • Understanding of Elasticsearch internals: sharding, performance tuning, analyzers, query DSL
  • Elasticsearch certifications or other program stack related certifications
  • Strong Kafka experience: event design, stream processing, performance tuning
  • Familiarity with schema registries and Kafka streaming patterns
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization products such as Keycloak
  • Experience with security best practices for services: authN/Z, secrets management, data protection
  • GraphQL familiarity
  • Hardware on-prem and cloud-based deployments using Kubernetes
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (ie CloudFormation, Terraform, Pulumi)
  • Experience of a production/enterprise systems at scale
  • Knowledge of distributed systems concepts (e.g., idempotency, eventual consistency)
  • Experience leading technical projects and mentoring engineers
  • Strong testing discipline with a focus on automation, coverage, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Hands-on development and/or scripting experience, especially Java and Python
  • Experience with AWS cloud-based architecture, services, and software development

title: Senior Cybersecurity Researcher
description:
Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Researcher in our global Threat Research Unit, you will combine hands-on threat research with customer engagement and public representation of Acronis’s cybersecurity expertise. You will investigate emerging threats, turn findings into actionable intelligence, and work with Sales, Marketing, and Communications to support US customer and partner discussions, industry events, and research publications.

Please note: Security Clearance Requirement: Candidates must hold a valid and active security clearance appropriate to the requirements of the role.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Research emerging and existing cyber threats, malware, attack techniques, and threat actor campaigns using threat intelligence, product telemetry, and other sources.
  • Track threat actors and their tactics, techniques, and procedures, and correlate activity across campaigns.
  • Develop tools to automate the collection, enrichment, and analysis of malware and threat intelligence.
  • Support incident response teams with detailed intelligence and research analysis.
  • Support US sales teams in customer and partner discussions by explaining threat trends, research findings, and the relevance of Acronis’s cybersecurity capabilities.
  • Represent Acronis at security conferences, partner events, webinars, and industry forums through presentations and demonstrations.
  • Produce research reports, articles, presentations, and educational content for technical and business audiences.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Communications on research publications, media briefings, and promotion of research and event participation.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • At least three years of relevant cybersecurity experience, particularly in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or security research.
  • Strong understanding of the threat landscape, threat actor profiling, and MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to produce accurate, actionable research.
  • Strong written and spoken English and the ability to explain technical findings to customers, partners, and business audiences.
  • Confident presentation and public speaking skills, including the ability to connect research insights to customer security challenges.

title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
description:
Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Location: Pune, India


About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit


Introduction

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.


Your Job

  • Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
  • Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
  • Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
  • Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
  • Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
  • Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
  • Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
  • Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
  • Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
  • Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
  • Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 4 to 8 years of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
  • Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
  • Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
  • Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
  • Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
  • Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
  • Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
  • Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
  • Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
  • Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development.
  • Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262.
  • Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms.
  • Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments.
  • Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.
  • Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering.
  • Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams.
