title: Principal Software Architect (Graph Architect)
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Software Architect to provide technical leadership and architectural direction across complex, high-scale software and data platforms.

This role will have a particular focus on Identity Resolution, including the design of systems that accurately identify, match, link, and resolve individuals, households, organizations, devices, and other entities across large and diverse datasets. In addition to Identity Resolution, the Principal Software Architect will be responsible for designing scalable enterprise applications, distributed systems, large-scale data-processing platforms, and low-latency APIs and services.

The ideal candidate will have deep, hands-on expertise across Java, Python, Scala, Apache Spark, and SQL, with strong experience designing systems on AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks.

This is a senior technical leadership role requiring the ability to define architectural direction, evaluate technology choices, solve complex engineering challenges, and work closely with engineering teams to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, maintainable, and performant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the architecture for enterprise-scale Identity Resolution platforms and services.
  • Design systems for deterministic and probabilistic identity matching, entity resolution, identity graphs, record linkage, deduplication, and identity consolidation.
  • Develop architectures capable of resolving identities across large, diverse, and rapidly changing datasets.
  • Design solutions supporting both real-time and batch Identity Resolution use cases.
  • Define strategies for identity matching, confidence scoring, survivorship, source prioritization, identity linking, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Design and optimize low-latency APIs and services capable of supporting high-throughput, highly available production workloads.
  • Architect distributed applications and services using Java, Python, and Scala, selecting the appropriate language and framework based on workload and system requirements.
  • Design high-scale data-processing pipelines and platforms using Apache Spark, including Spark workloads implemented in Scala and Python.
  • Design and optimize data solutions using Snowflake and Databricks for large-scale analytical and operational workloads.
  • Design highly efficient data models and SQL-based solutions supporting transactional, analytical, and Identity Resolution workloads.
  • Define appropriate caching, concurrency, partitioning, indexing, persistence, and data-access strategies to meet stringent performance and latency requirements.
  • Define cloud-native architectures using AWS and modern distributed computing patterns.
  • Design integration patterns between AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, internal applications, APIs, and external data providers.
  • Evaluate technologies, frameworks, databases, processing engines, and architectural approaches based on performance, scalability, reliability, cost, and operational complexity.
  • Establish standards and best practices for application architecture, API design, data architecture, distributed processing, security, observability, testing, and software development.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to translate architectural designs into practical, scalable, and maintainable implementations.
  • Provide technical direction during the development of complex systems and assist engineering teams in resolving difficult performance, scalability, and design challenges.
  • Conduct architecture and design reviews to ensure systems align with established technical standards and long-term platform strategy.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and guide teams in optimizing APIs, applications, Spark workloads, SQL queries, and distributed-processing systems.
  • Define architectural approaches for resiliency, fault tolerance, high availability, disaster recovery, and operational monitoring.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data engineering, product, security, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Mentor senior engineers, technical leads, and architects and help develop architectural capabilities across the engineering organization.
  • Stay current with evolving technologies and industry practices related to Identity Resolution, distributed systems, cloud computing, data platforms, and software architecture.

Identity Resolution Expertise

The Principal Software Architect should have significant experience designing or working with Identity Resolution, Entity Resolution, Customer 360, Master Data Management, identity graph, or similar large-scale matching systems.

Strong candidates should understand concepts such as:

  • Deterministic and probabilistic matching
  • Exact and fuzzy matching techniques
  • Entity and record linkage
  • Identity graphs and relationship modeling
  • Identity stitching and consolidation
  • Match confidence and scoring
  • Attribute normalization and standardization
  • Duplicate detection and resolution
  • Survivorship and golden-record strategies
  • Source reliability and attribute precedence
  • Real-time versus batch identity resolution
  • Incremental identity processing
  • Large-scale identity datasets
  • Data quality and identity accuracy measurement
  • Privacy, security, and governance considerations associated with identity data

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing complex enterprise software systems.
  • Proven experience serving as an Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leader.
  • Deep experience designing and implementing Identity Resolution, Entity Resolution, identity graph, Customer 360, Master Data Management, or similar systems.
  • Strong expertise in Java, including enterprise application development, high-performance services, concurrency, and distributed application design.
  • Strong expertise in Python, including application development, data processing, automation, APIs, and distributed data workloads.
  • Strong expertise in Scala, particularly for distributed systems and large-scale data-processing applications.
  • Deep experience with Apache Spark, including architecture, optimization, partitioning, distributed execution, performance tuning, and large-scale processing.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, relational data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Demonstrated ability to select appropriately between Java, Python, Scala, Spark, and SQL based on performance, scalability, maintainability, and workload requirements.
  • Strong experience designing REST APIs, microservices, distributed applications, and high-throughput backend services.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and optimizing low-latency and low-latency APIs.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency, caching, partitioning, consistency, resiliency, scalability, and fault tolerance.
  • Extensive experience with AWS and cloud-native application architecture.
  • Strong experience with Snowflake, including data modeling, performance optimization, security, data sharing, and large-scale data-processing patterns.
  • Strong experience with Databricks, including Spark-based processing, distributed data engineering, optimization, and production workload management.
  • Experience designing systems that span application, API, distributed-processing, data, and cloud infrastructure layers.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, design patterns, API design, data structures, algorithms, and application performance.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD practices, automated testing, source control, and production software delivery.
  • Strong understanding of security, privacy, authentication, authorization, encryption, and data-protection practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex architectural and performance problems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting large scale Identity Resolution platforms.
  • Experience designing Identity Resolution systems that support both high-volume batch processing and real-time API-based resolution.
  • Experience designing and optimizing large-scale Spark applications using both Scala and Python.
  • Experience with graph databases or graph-oriented data models.
  • Experience with probabilistic matching algorithms, machine learning-based matching, or advanced entity-resolution techniques.
  • Experience designing APIs with stringent latency, throughput, and availability requirements.
  • Experience with event-driven and streaming architectures.
  • Experience with containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience designing multi-region or highly available cloud architectures.
  • Experience establishing enterprise architecture standards and technical governance.
  • Experience modernizing legacy applications and data platforms.
  • Experience working with large-scale consumer, marketing, advertising, financial, or customer identity datasets.

Core Technical Skills

Languages & Data Processing

  • Java
  • Python
  • Scala
  • Apache Spark
  • SQL

Platforms

  • AWS
  • Databricks
  • Snowflake

Architecture

  • Identity Resolution / Entity Resolution
  • Distributed Systems
  • Low-Latency APIs
  • Microservices
  • Enterprise Application Architecture
  • Large-Scale Data Processing
  • Cloud-Native Architecture
  • Real-Time and Batch Processing

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced technical education is a plus.

title: Data Architect & AI Engineering Lead, Cybersecurity - Assistant Vice President
description:
Who we are looking for

The Data Engineer / Data Scientist, Assistant Vice President, will provide technical and strategic leadership for enterprise cybersecurity data, analytics, and AI capabilities. This role will drive the architecture and delivery of scalable data platforms, advanced analytics, machine learning, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI solutions that convert complex security telemetry into actionable intelligence. The AVP will partner with cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, governance, and risk stakeholders to enhance threat detection, risk prioritization, operational efficiency, and executive decision-making while establishing scalable engineering and data science practices across the organization


What you will be responsible for

As a Data Engineer / Scientist, you will:

· Design and deliver scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse architectures, data models, and analytics-ready datasets using Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud technologies.

· Build reusable frameworks for data ingestion, transformation, aggregation, data quality, reconciliation, orchestration, lineage, and observability.

· Develop statistical, machine-learning, and AI models to identify patterns, anomalies, relationships, threats, and risk signals across cybersecurity datasets.

· Apply ML, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI to improve threat detection, vulnerability prioritization, incident enrichment, cyber-risk scoring, and security posture insights.

· Develop AI solutions leveraging LLMs, embeddings, semantic/vector search, RAG, and intelligent workflows to summarize, classify, correlate, and enrich cybersecurity information.

· Operationalize data science and AI solutions through feature pipelines, MLOps, CI/CD, automated testing, model monitoring, and production workflows.

· Engineer and analyze high-volume structured, semi-structured, time-series, graph, and unstructured security data across cloud and enterprise platforms.

· Build Power BI dashboards and self-service analytical products to communicate security trends, operational performance, risk insights, and model outcomes.

· Establish strong engineering and responsible AI practices covering performance, scalability, resiliency, explainability, security, privacy, lineage, governance, and auditability.

· Partner with cybersecurity, data and platform engineering, architecture, governance, risk, and product teams to translate complex security challenges into scalable data and AI solutions.

· Evaluate emerging data engineering, ML, GenAI, graph, cloud, SIEM/SOAR, and cybersecurity technologies and drive their practical adoption.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

· Strong technical expertise across Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI/GenAI.

· Deep understanding of Lakehouse architectures, distributed data processing, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data quality, orchestration, and pipeline optimization.

· Hands-on expertise with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud data platforms.

· Experience with statistical modeling, feature engineering, anomaly detection, supervised and unsupervised learning, experimentation, and model evaluation.

· Practical knowledge of LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, NLP, graph analytics, and responsible AI practices.

· Understanding of cybersecurity concepts including security telemetry, threat detection, vulnerability management, identity risk, threat intelligence, incidents, and SIEM/SOAR workflows.

· Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence architecture and engineering decisions, and communicate effectively with technical teams and senior stakeholders.

· Strong focus on automation, reusable engineering patterns, operational excellence, governance, and measurable business outcomes.

Education & Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

· 15 to 20 years of professional experience across data engineering, data science, analytics, cloud, machine learning, AI, or related technology disciplines.

· Experience applying data engineering, analytics, ML, or AI techniques to cybersecurity, risk, fraud, identity, infrastructure, or other large-scale enterprise datasets.

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

· Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, and large-scale data engineering.

· Experience with Lakehouse/data platform architecture, data pipelines, modeling, data quality, monitoring, lineage, and performance optimization.

· Working knowledge of AWS or comparable cloud data and analytics environments.

· Experience operationalizing analytical and ML solutions using CI/CD, version control, testing, monitoring, and MLOps practices.

· Experience with Power BI or equivalent visualization technologies.

· Strong written, verbal, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

· Master's degree or advanced coursework in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Cybersecurity, or related disciplines.

· Experience with Databricks/Delta Lake and Medallion architecture patterns.

· Experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, NLP, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or AI-assisted workflows.

· Experience developing production-grade ML/AI pipelines, model monitoring, feature pipelines, APIs, or MLOps solutions.

· Experience working with cybersecurity datasets such as endpoint telemetry, authentication events, cloud security logs, vulnerability data, asset inventories, network events, incidents, SIEM data, and threat intelligence.

· Experience in financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise environments with strong security, privacy, governance, and audit requirements.

· Relevant Security+, CySA+, GIAC, CISSP, AWS, Databricks, Data Engineering, ML/AI, or cybersecurity certifications are advantageous.


Technical Skills

Skill Area

Expected Capabilities

Data Engineering

Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, Lakehouse, Delta Lake, data modeling, orchestration, data quality, lineage and observability

Data Science / ML

Statistical modeling, feature engineering, anomaly detection, classification, clustering, experimentation, model evaluation and explainability.

AI & Gen AI

LLMs, NLP, RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search, prompt engineering and AI-assisted workflows.

Cloud & DevOps

AWS, cloud data services, CI/CD, Git, automated testing, scalable processing and MLOps.

Cybersecurity Analytics

SIEM/SOAR workflows, alert enrichment, cyber telemetry, vulnerability data, identity risk, incident and response datasets.

Visualization & BI

Power BI dashboards, operational metrics, executive-ready reporting, trend analysis, self-service analytical products.

· This is an individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration expectations.

· The role will require sound judgment when working with sensitive cybersecurity, risk, operational, and regulated data.

· The candidate should be comfortable balancing exploratory data science, production-minded analytical delivery, and stakeholder communication.


Why this role is important to us

Cybersecurity increasingly depends on the ability to engineer, integrate, analyze, and intelligently interpret large volumes of complex security data. This role will bridge Data Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and AI, building trusted data foundations and intelligent solutions that improve threat detection, risk prioritization, security operations, and enterprise decision-making.

description:
Who We Are Looking For

The Enterprise Data and AI Office is seeking an execution-oriented Enterprise Data Quality Solutions lead to help advance the firm’s enterprise Data Quality Management framework, standards, control capabilities, and technology-enabled solutions.

This role will focus on translating enterprise data quality policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and control requirements into scalable business processes, platform capabilities, and adoption practices across business and technology teams.

The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening enterprise capabilities for data quality management, controls, measurement and reporting, exception and issue management, and BCBS 239-aligned risk data aggregation and reporting outcomes using the Collibra Platform and related technologies.

The ideal candidate combines Data Quality Management expertise, product management experience, and business analysis skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional delivery in a complex global enterprise environment.

Why this role is important to us

This position is part of the Enterprise Data Governance team within the Chief Data and AI Office. The role is important to strengthen the firm’s ability to define, measure, monitor, and improve data quality across critical data, key metrics, critical reports, and related business processes.

Success in this role will be measured through effective implementation of sustainable data quality management capabilities, improved controls, to enable accurate, complete, timely, and well-controlled data.

What you will be responsible for

  • Support implementation of enterprise Data Quality Management standards, procedures, operating practices, and supporting technology capabilities.
  • Translate data quality policies, standards, controls, and regulatory expectations into clear business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive continuous improvement of enterprise Data Quality Error Management and Data Quality Issue Management processes, including escalation, tracking, closure evidence, and management reporting.
  • Partner with Business Data Owners, Data Stewards, Data Governance Leads, and Technology teams to implement practical data quality measurement, monitoring, and governance capabilities for measuring data quality, including accuracy, completeness, timeliness, where applicable.
  • Support the adoption of enterprise Data Quality tools to support data profiling, automated data quality rules and related data quality measurement and governance reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate data quality control execution, monitoring, escalation, and evidence retention through enterprise technology platforms.
  • Define requirements for workflow-enabled data quality control management, control effectiveness reporting, and management oversight dashboards.
  • Prepare materials for use in data quality governance forums related to data quality management and data governance controls.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Enterprise Data Quality Management capabilities within Collibra and related enterprise data governance solutions.
  • Develop and maintain requirements, user stories, epics, process flows, use cases, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria for platform enhancements.
  • Collaborate with technology delivery teams through design, development, testing, deployment, release readiness, adoption, and post-implementation support.
  • Support backlog prioritization, sprint planning, stakeholder demonstrations, user acceptance testing, training materials, and adoption communications.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Strong understanding of data quality management disciplines, including data quality dimensions, DQ rule management, control design, DQ measurement, issue management, and governance reporting.
  • Ability to translate policy, standard, regulatory, and control requirements into practical business processes and technology-enabled solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex requirements into clear deliverables.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across business and technology teams without direct authority.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments and using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or similar platforms.

Education and preferred qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Quality Management, Data Governance, Data Management, Business Analysis, Product Management, Risk Management, or related disciplines.
  • Experience implementing enterprise data quality management frameworks, data governance processes, control frameworks, or supporting technology solutions.
  • Experience with Collibra or similar data governance, metadata management, data catalog, workflow, or data quality platforms preferred.
  • Experience supporting BCBS 239, regulatory remediation, internal audit, risk management, or financial services governance initiatives preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Business/Finance, a related discipline, or equivalent experience required.

title: Wafer Product Engineer
description:
Job Title: Wafer Product Engineer

Location: Ottawa, ON


About Ranovus


Ranovus is a semiconductor company with global operations helping power the data behind next generation AI and data center networks. We design and build advanced hardware that moves massive amounts of information quickly and efficiently between computer systems in data centers around the world. Our technology improves performance while reducing energy use and environmental impact, supporting the rapid growth of AI and cloud services. At Ranovus, you’ll join a collaborative, inclusive team that values learning, flexibility, and meaningful work with global impact.


Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Wafer Product Engineer to lead characterization, yield analysis, statistical validation, and manufacture readiness for semiconductor products from NPI through high-volume production. As the technical bridge between Design Engineering, Test Engineering, Fabs, OSATs, and Operations, you will define characterization plans, corner-lot strategies, SPC methodologies, and release criteria, using DOE, GRR, Cp/Cpk, correlation analysis, and yield modeling to ensure products are manufacturable, testable, and meet quality, reliability, and cost targets.


Key Responsibilities

  • Characterization & Validation: Develop characterization plans and define corner-lot requirements across process, voltage, temperature, and manufacturing lots. Analyze electrical, optical, and functional distributions, set production test limits and guardbands, and drive qualification readiness.
  • Statistical Analysis & Process Capability: Analyze product and manufacturing data; monitor and improve Cp/Cpk, yield, parametric distributions, and process stability. Identify sources of variation, drive corrective actions, and issue reports and recommendations supporting production releases.
  • Design of Experiments (DOE): Plan, execute, and analyze DOEs covering process variables, test conditions, environmental factors, and manufacturing variation to optimize performance and margins; present recommendations to cross-functional teams.
  • MSA & GRR: Lead GRR studies, evaluate measurement capability and repeatability, and improve test robustness and accuracy. Ensure test systems meet statistical requirements and support correlation across engineering systems, ATE, probe, and OSAT test environments.
  • Yield & Quality: Analyze wafer sort and final test yield, lead root cause investigations of yield detractors, assess potential test escapes, and recommend screening improvements. Partner with Design and Test to improve quality and test coverage and drive continuous improvement through defect trend reporting and metrics reviews.
  • Fab & OSAT Interface: Serve as primary technical interface for product-related manufacturing issues. Work with foundries on process performance, excursions, capability trends, and yield programs, and with OSATs on production performance, yield loss, test program implementation, and efficiency.
  • Test Program Quality & Release: Partner with ATE Test Engineers on test effectiveness, guardbands, correlation, characterization coverage, and robustness. Review and approve production test limits, balancing quality, yield, customer requirements, and cost.
  • NPI: Collaborate with Design from concept through volume release while driving DFx. Define manufacturing readiness and release-to-production criteria, participate in design, characterization, and production readiness reviews, complete gate review actions on schedule, and drive successful ramps.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in electrical or computer engineering, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, Applied Statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of semiconductor Product Engineering experience, including NPI and production ramp support.
  • Strong understanding of wafer fabrication, assembly, and test processes, with direct experience working with foundries and OSAT partners.
  • Experience leading characterization and yield improvement programs.
  • Technical expertise in characterization methodologies, yield analysis and improvement, Cp/Cpk, SPC, DOE, GRR/MSA, correlation studies, root cause analysis, semiconductor manufacturing processes, wafer sort and final test operations, and product qualification.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with advanced semiconductor technologies, such as photonic integrated circuits (PICs), silicon photonics, high-speed SerDes, analog, mixed-signal, or optical products.
  • Knowledge of Advantest V93000 (93K) production test environments.
  • Familiarity with JMP, Minitab, MATLAB, Python, and SQL.
  • Understanding of automotive or telecom quality methodologies.


Key Competencies

Strong statistical and analytical thinking; data-driven decision making; excellent problem solving; cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence technical direction across organizations; effective communication with internal teams and external partners; and strong project management and prioritization skills.


Success Metrics

Product yield and Cp/Cpk against targets; characterization quality and completeness; DOE effectiveness; GRR and measurement capability improvements; reduced manufacturing excursions; production ramp success and time-to-production readiness; product quality and customer returns; and yield and cost improvements.

We are committed to an accessible recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.

We are committed to delivering a respectful and transparent candidate experience, with clear and timely communication at every stage of the process. Ranovus Inc. is committed to leveraging new technologies and working efficiently. As a result, artificial intelligence systems may be used to support elements of our hiring process. These tools are designed to enhance consistency and efficiency, not replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by people, guided by care, context, and fairness.

title: Senior Associate, Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Type:

Regular

Plains is an industry-leading transportation and midstream provider specializing in transportation, storage, processing and marketing solutions for crude oil. We own an extensive network of pipeline transportation, terminalling, storage and gathering assets in key oil producing basins and transportation corridors and at major market hubs in the United States and Canada. The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

We’re on the lookout for passionate self‑starters who thrive in fast‑moving, collaborative, and innovative environments.

The Integrity Engineer helps develop, implement, administer, and continuously improve multiple tools, processes, and programs related to pipeline integrity, safety, and regulatory compliance.


The Asset Integrity group works collaboratively across multiple organizations and assets located throughout the United States and Canada. This group also serves as the primary interface for regulatory agencies and industry groups including but not limited to: DOT/PHMSA - Office of Pipeline Safety, Texas Railroad Commission, Canadian Energy Regulator (CER), Alberta Energy Regulator (AER), Ministry of Energy and Resources (MER), American Petroleum Institute, and Pipeline Research Council International.

title: IAM Access Certification & SailPoint Onboarding Analyst, VP
description:
Who We Are Looking For

State Street is seeking an experienced Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Analyst to support our Identity and Access Management (IAM) program, with a focus on access certification optimization and SailPoint application onboarding. This role will drive improvements in entitlement certification effectiveness and efficiency while supporting the integration, onboarding, and governance of applications and entitlement data within the SailPoint platform.

The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders to improve entitlement governance by identifying birthright access, rationalizing entitlements, and implementing scalable certification processes. Additionally, the candidate will work with application owners and technical teams to onboard applications into SailPoint, enabling automated provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and compliance controls through integrations such as Active Directory groups, flat files, databases, and RESTful APIs.

This role requires a strong combination of IAM governance knowledge, SailPoint experience, analytical skills, stakeholder management, and project execution capabilities.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Drive continuous improvement of access certification processes to enhance review quality, reduce effort, and strengthen compliance outcomes.
  • Partner with business units to analyze entitlement models and identify opportunities for birthright access, role optimization, entitlement rationalization, and certification efficiencies.
  • Develop certification metrics, reporting, and governance recommendations to improve certification effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with application owners and technical teams to understand access models, entitlements, and provisioning/deprovisioning processes.
  • Assess and support the onboarding of applications and entitlement data into SailPoint using appropriate integration methods.
  • Guide application teams through SailPoint onboarding standards, governance requirements, and best practices.
  • Configure, test, and support application onboarding activities throughout the SDLC lifecycle.
  • Support integrations leveraging Active Directory, databases, flat files, and RESTful/Web APIs.
  • Ensure IAM controls, certification requirements, and compliance standards are incorporated into onboarding activities.
  • Support UAT activities, issue resolution, and post-onboarding governance processes.
  • Track onboarding efforts through JIRA and maintain project documentation in Confluence and SharePoint.
  • Produce status reports, metrics, and executive-level updates on certification and onboarding initiatives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for SailPoint onboarding, entitlement governance, and IAM best practices.

What We Value

  • Strong knowledge of SailPoint IdentityIQ, Identity Security Cloud (IdentityNow), or similar IGA platforms.
  • Experience with access certifications, entitlement governance, role-based access control (RBAC), and least-privilege principles.
  • Familiarity with application onboarding, entitlement management, and access governance processes.
  • Experience with integrations using REST APIs, web services, Active Directory, databases, and flat-file interfaces.
  • Ability to analyze entitlement structures and identify opportunities to improve certification efficiency and governance.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and utilizing JIRA for project and workflow management.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and reporting skills.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • 3 – 5 year of access certification experience and access certification improvements
  • 3–5 years of experience in SailPoint application integration, onboarding, or administration.
  • 3–5 years of experience within the Identity and Access Management (IAM) domain.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
  • Hands-on experience integrating enterprise applications with SailPoint or comparable IGA solutions.
  • Experience working with APIs, identity data feeds, access provisioning, and entitlement management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of experience using JIRA or comparable Agile project management and ticketing platforms.
  • 1–2 years of experience utilizing Confluence and/or SharePoint for documentation and collaboration.
  • Familiarity with Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD/Entra ID, and enterprise authentication technologies.
  • Experience supporting large-scale IAM transformation or technology modernization initiatives.
  • Professional certifications such as SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, SailPoint IdentityNow certification, CISSP, CISM, or Security+ are a plus.

Why this role is important to us

  • Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.
  • We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.
  • Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

About State Street

  • What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  • Work, Live and Grow. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

title: Senior Executive, Manufacturing Injectables
description:
Description:

This role is responsible for performing a variety of tasks related to the manufacturing of injectable pharmaceutical products within a regulated sterile manufacturing environment at a senior executive level. The position operates and monitors injectable manufacturing equipment and related apparatus to support parenteral product production objectives with greater independence and accountability. It involves the careful handling of raw materials as well as intermediate and finished injectable pharmaceutical products to maintain product integrity, sterility, and quality. The role contributes to the execution and oversight of injectable manufacturing operations including compounding, filling, and related processes in accordance with established formulations and batch manufacturing records. General maintenance activities on injectable manufacturing equipment and related machinery are performed as required to ensure operational continuity. All activities are executed in strict adherence to Standard Operating Procedures and current Good Manufacturing Practices to meet regulatory requirements. Accurate and timely completion of batch records and manufacturing documentation is maintained as a core accountability. The position participates in and may lead process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing quality, reducing costs, and optimizing production scheduling within the injectable manufacturing function.


Essential Functions:
  • Operate and monitor injectable manufacturing equipment and related apparatus with greater independence in accordance with validated procedures and GMP standards.
  • Handle raw materials, intermediate products, and finished injectable goods with care to maintain product quality, sterility, and prevent contamination.
  • Perform and oversee injectable manufacturing operations including compounding, filling, and related processes per approved batch manufacturing records.
  • Mix and compound ingredients for injectable formulations, suspensions, and sterile products per approved procedures.
  • Conduct general maintenance on injectable manufacturing equipment and related apparatus to ensure operational readiness.
  • Execute Standard Operating Procedures and maintain accurate batch documentation records in compliance with cGMP requirements.
  • Ensure all tasks are completed in full compliance with applicable regulatory requirements including FDA and EMA guidelines.
  • Lead or participate in functional team projects focused on developing process improvement methods to enhance quality, cost efficiency, and scheduling.
  • Support area cleaning and sanitization activities and mentor junior team members to maintain a compliant and sterile injectable manufacturing environment.

  • Master Degree (MS/MA) M. Sc. - Preferred

Experience:

title: ALASKA DRILLER
description:
The Alaska Driller is responsible for ensuring that the work in and around the drill floor and BOP as well as the rig up and rig down procedures and the drilling operations occurs in a safe and effective manner thereby meeting and / or exceeding Nabors Drilling Company's and the contracting Company's goals and objective for safety, production and budget. The Driller works under the direction and supervision of the Rig Manager.

Location: Prudhoe Bay, Alaska
Job Type: Full-Time, Rotational Schedule (14/14 or 21/21)
Reports To: Rig Manager

  • Anticipate potential problems, pre plan and implement corrective action in a timely manner thereby helping to ensure outcomes reach company goals for the drilling operations Work with the Rig Manager to assist with post analysis reviews of critical actions and implement ongoing best practice activities for future operations.
  • Ensuring the safety of the drill crew and all support personnel working in and about the drill floor.
  • Oversee proper rig up and rig down, continual preventive maintenance and repair of the equipment used in the drilling operations along with ensuring continual cleaning and housekeeping in and about the drill floor.
  • Ensure drilling operations follow established plan.
  • Substitute for a Floorhand in the absence of a trained Floorhand Together with the Rig manager, continually train and develop employees working on the drilling rig so as to meet the employee's career goals while at the same time meeting the needs of the company.
  • Responsible for monitoring the progress of the drilling operation, determine when bits need to be changed while operating pumps, rotary table, draw-works and drill pipe.
  • Ability to operate rig utilizing rig controls while monitoring operation of various equipment (pump pressures, weight indicator, drill string weight, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Drilling rig equipment capacity and functionality including but not limited to Canrig Top Drives, accumulator units, draw works.
  • Adjust mud pumps to maintain the proper circulation rate.
  • Ability to perform basic math functions.

Essential Functions:

  • Rotational schedule: 14/14 or 21/21, including holidays, weekends, and both day/night shifts.
  • Position may require occasional travel and field-based training.
  • Operations-oriented role that may require being on-call, working overnights, and holidays.
  • Able to work well with others while working in a close environment for extended periods of time with minimal ability to leave the driller's cabin.
  • Make important judgment decisions that affect the safety of the crew.
  • Give verbal instructions clearly and concisely.
  • Advanced knowledge of the emergency shut-in procedures and be able to respond to any emergency efficiently and professionally
  • Occasionally climb steep stairs and walking on steel decking as well as gravel, board roads and area that can be covered in drilling fluids, mud, snow and ice.
  • Assist the Rig Manager with trouble shooting and problem-solving duties and decisive manner.

  • Other duties as required by the Rig Manager.

    Physical & Environmental Requirements:

  • Must be able to maintain good footing while standing and walking for a minimum of 4 hours at a time, including on steel decking and grating.
  • Must be able to repetitively climb stairs and ladders, work in an unprotected environment as well as be able to lift / carry and work with items weighing upwards of 35 lbs.
  • Able to stand or stand and walk throughout the tour while wearing steel toed boots.
  • Must be able to exert a push or pull force of up to 120 lbs. while holding tag lines during loading/offloading.
  • Must be able to identify hand signals at a distance of 150 feet.
  • Able to bend, stoop, kneel, twist, and crawl throughout the work shift while wearing PPE.

  • Attention span to remain alert and attentive for up to a 12-hour tour, even during repetitive tasks.

  • Ability to perform essential functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodations.
  • Previous rig experience as a Floorhand, Motorhand and/or Derrickhand for Nabors Drilling or 1 year experience as a Driller for another drilling company.
  • Ability to wear respiratory protective devices.
  • Must pass a pre-employment physical, drug screen, and background check.
  • Valid driver’s license preferred. - Real ID Compliant w/no restrictions
  • Must have reliable transportation to the crew change point for assigned rig.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma, certificate or equivalent AC and/or SCR Rig experience
  • Completion of Certified Supervisory Well Control course that is unexpired
  • Experience using computer and multiple screens to monitor drilling activities

title: Senior Project Manager - Transformation
description:
Job Description:



Your Impact

We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to join our Value Chain Management (VCM) Programme, a critical strategic initiative driving business transformation across the Electronics Division.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead large-scale digital and business transformation projects that enhance end-to-end value chain capabilities, improve business processes, and deliver lasting organisational change. Working with senior stakeholders, implementation partners, and cross-functional teams, you will play a key role in delivering strategic capabilities that improve how we operate and create value across the business.



  • Reports to the VCM Programme Manager for direction, escalation, governance and project performance management.
  • Responsible for delivery to the approved financial baseline, reviewing variances and developing mitigation or recovery plans where necessary. Report financial performance and maintain quantified benefits realisation tracking against the Business Case.
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships with Business Leads, Product Owners, Change Leads and Technical Leads to ensure solutions are fit for purpose and meet business requirements across the Electronics Division.
  • Lead multi-disciplinary and multi-site teams delivering complex business transformation projects across UK sites and, where required, transnational teams.
  • Maintain and update the Business Case throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage external implementation partners, suppliers and subcontractors contributing to project delivery.
  • Lead multi-functional Leonardo teams to deliver project objectives to agreed scope, quality, schedule and budget.
  • Identify and manage dependencies with other VCM projects, business initiatives and enterprise transformation programmes.
  • Anticipate and manage project risks, issues and changes, implementing mitigation strategies where appropriate and ensuring the VCM Programme Manager and key stakeholders are informed of project status and recovery actions.
  • Identify key milestones and track progress against agreed deliverables, ensuring timely delivery of project outcomes.
  • Through regular engagement with stakeholders and key users, ensure delivered solutions meet approved business requirements and objectives.
  • Work with the Change Lead to support the development and execution of business readiness, communications, training and adoption activities required to realise business case benefits.
  • Ensure full adherence to Leonardo's Lifecycle Management framework, owning required artefacts, stage-gate approvals and presenting project status at governance and gateway reviews.

What you'll bring

  • Experience delivering digital transformation projects from implementation through to successful business adoption.
  • Experience delivering business improvement initiatives, including the management of external implementation partners and suppliers.
  • Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams to achieve project objectives.
  • Applies professional project management concepts in innovative and practical ways to improve business performance and ways of working.
  • Broad knowledge and experience across Supply Chain, Procurement and Value Chain processes within a complex organisation.
  • Holds a recognised project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent) or demonstrates substantial experience in project delivery methodologies.
  • Able to engage with and influence a wide range of stakeholders at varying levels of seniority.
  • Knowledge of change management principles and experience delivering projects that achieve successful business adoption and sustained benefits.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate options and maximise business value.
  • Experience managing third-party implementation partners and technology delivery vendors.
  • Strong financial management, governance, risk and benefits realisation experience.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.
  • Experience in a procurement, supply chain or commercial environment is desirable.

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.


Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit the Leonardo Careers security and vetting page.

Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
  • Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
  • Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
  • Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
  • Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
  • Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
  • Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
  • Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part-time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

title: Executive Director
description:
Provincial Senior Living proudly manages lifestyle-driven Independent Living communities across the United States, united by a shared purpose to enrich the lives of seniors and Team Members alike. Serving thousands of residents and families in more than 13,000 units, we operate with a deep commitment to our foundational Pillars of Excellence, ensuring personalized care, hospitality, and lasting connection. As part of one of the largest senior living families in the U.S., Provincial communities have earned Great Place to Work® certifications from 2022–2026. Provincial is a place where purpose and culture come together to create meaningful work and extraordinary career pathways. We continually aspire and invest in learning and development opportunities that support our team members’ professional growth, helping every team member build a fulfilling and purpose-rich career.

We offer rewarding career opportunities that include:

  • Competitive wages
  • Access to wages before payday
  • Flexible scheduling options with full-time and part-time hours
  • Paid time off and Holidays (full-time)
  • Comprehensive benefit package including health, dental, vision, life and disability insurances (full-time)
  • 401(K) with employer matching
  • Paid training
  • Opportunities for advancement
  • Meals and uniforms
  • Employee Assistance Program

Our community is looking for an Executive Director to join our team.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the operation and management of the community in accordance with the standards and guidelines of the Owners/Board of Directors, Discovery Management Group, and federal/state/local laws and regulations.
  • Communicates and models a clear, customer focused vision, based upon a resident centered model of care.
  • Demonstrates the ability to identify and build relationships within the local area that drives businesses into the community, as well as effectively price the product, thereby maximizing top-line revenue growth and achieves appropriate market position.
  • Ensures the community has an effective external business development strategy in place, with clear accountabilities assigned, is able to articulate results and adjust plan accordingly to maximize referral leads and move-ins.
  • Develops a thorough working knowledge of state regulations, policies and procedures dictated for residents; ensures compliance.
  • Ensures all resident administrative files are well maintained, current and in compliance with state regulations.
  • Meets the financial targets with the goal to maximize capital partners’ return.
  • Functional knowledge of all operating programs including memory care, clinical, dining and social programs.
  • Prepares, adheres to the community budget.
  • Ensures budgeted revenue is achieved or exceeded by maximizing occupancy and room rate.
  • Reviews monthly financial statements, implements plans of action for deficiencies.
  • Manages key, non-labor operating costs in line with budgeted levels.
  • Processes and submits monthly expenses and budget data timely per policies and internal business controls.
  • Meets NOI and occupancy expectations.
  • Oversees all departments, maintaining full responsibility for efficient operations and compliance with the financial goals established in the approved Operating Budget.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration, Hospitality, Hospital Administration, or Health related field.
  • Minimum of three years of managerial experience preferably in the senior living, health care or hospitality industries.
  • Previous management experience including hiring, coaching, performance management, daily operations supervision and discipline.
  • Previous sales experience preferred.
  • Demonstration of success in managing operating expenses.
  • Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; inspires and motivates others to perform well.


If having a direct impact on the lives of others is appealing to you, apply today and join our team!

No agencies, please. We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from agencies under any circumstances. We receive inquiries from agencies daily. Agencies should not direct any inquiries or emails to hiring managers. Thank you.

title: Director, Energy Management
description:
Who We Are

Centurion Asset Management Inc. is a recognized leader in the Investment and Property Management industries. Providing quality investments and housing for all its clients, our experienced team comprised of more than 430 Employees is a core component of Centurion’s success since 2003. Centurion Apartment Real Estate Investment Trust (“REIT”) owns more than 22,000 multi-family apartment units and student housing beds across 46 cities in Canada and the United States. Since day one, our goal has been to provide Residents and their families with clean, safe, and comfortable homes. The REIT provides investors an opportunity to invest in a diversified portfolio of rental apartments and student housing properties, as well as mortgage and equity investments in property developments, across Canada and the United States and participate in the profits derived from them.


Our Mission

Our mission is to be sought after as a leading-edge, reputable, multi-disciplinary alternative asset manager; to capitalize on opportunities in new and interesting investment strategies that meet our mission to Investors; and to embrace change, experimentation, innovation and learning from failure to make continual improvements that drive our success and keep us ahead of our competitors.


Our Values

Our core values can be summarized by the acronym RISE: Respect for our Investors, our Residents, Co-workers, Partners and Communities; Integrity in everything we do, demonstrating sincerity, honesty and the will to do it right; Simplicity free of pretension and hassle, full of value and common sense; and Excellence in offering all our Clients and Partners exceptional products and services quality, as well as providing our Employees with an excellent workplace.


Why Employees Want to Work with Us

We provide an inclusive environment where all employees are valued and supported. Over the years, we developed a work culture where the potential of every employee is maximized, and everyone has equal opportunities for growth. For certain roles, we offer numerous employee perks, including: Competitive Total Rewards Packages; Comprehensive Benefits Plan including Medical, Dental, and Vision Care; Vacation Policy based on Length of Service; Centurion Learning Academy; Opportunities for Growth; Education Reimbursement Policy; Mentoring Program; Employee Referral Program; Discounted Gym Membership; Company-wide Internal Communication Platforms; Employee Volunteer Opportunities; Social Gatherings; Employee Innovation Program; and Corporate Discount Card.


Overview

Reporting to the Vice President of Technical Services and Innovation, the Director of Energy Management is responsible for developing, implementing and overseeing a portfolio-wide energy management, building automation and decarbonization program for Centurion Property Associates Inc. | Centurion Apartment REIT. Accountable for energy strategy, project prioritization, budgets, performance measurement and reporting, the Director will drive improvements in building performance, reduce utility costs and greenhouse gas emissions, and align energy initiatives with operational requirements and long-term asset objectives.


Responsibilities


Relationship Development

Develop and maintain positive relationships with Property Operations, Asset Management, Finance, and other internal stakeholders. Work closely with Property Managers and Site Staff to identify operational priorities and ensure energy initiatives support resident comfort, service delivery and building reliability. Manage relationships with Consultants, Contractors, utility providers and technology partners, addressing performance issues and resolving service concerns in a timely manner.


Energy Management

Develop, implement and manage a proactive energy management program for the portfolio, including energy and water conservation targets, performance benchmarks and continuous improvement processes. Lead energy audits and building performance assessments to identify and prioritize opportunities for utility savings. Oversee utility monitoring, investigate consumption anomalies and direct corrective measures. Evaluate utility procurement, sub-metering and demand management opportunities in collaboration with Finance and Property Operations. Integrate energy priorities into annual operating budgets and long-term capital plans.


Building Automation

Provide strategic and technical oversight of building automation systems, energy monitoring platforms and smart building initiatives. Establish standards for system selection, control sequences, data collection, commissioning and ongoing optimization. Direct the Project Manager in reviewing trend logs, alarms, schedules and set-points to improve HVAC performance and maintain resident comfort. Ensure systems are properly maintained, calibrated and supported, and that operational issues are addressed promptly in collaboration with Site Staff and service providers.


Capital Project Management

Develop and oversee a portfolio-wide program of energy efficiency and building systems projects, including HVAC optimization, lighting and water retrofits, controls upgrades, electrification and renewable energy opportunities. Prepare business cases assessing capital costs, projected savings, payback, lifecycle costs, operational impacts and emissions reductions. Recommend project priorities and budgets to the Vice President of Technical Services and Innovation. Oversee scopes of work, tendering, Contractor selection, schedules, financial tracking, quality control and commissioning. Ensure the Project Manager maintains accurate project files and verifies realized savings following implementation.


Sustainability and Innovation

Develop and maintain a practical decarbonization roadmap aligned with corporate objectives and asset renewal plans. Evaluate emerging technologies, including heat pumps, geothermal systems and renewable energy, for technical suitability, financial return and operational feasibility. Establish consistent processes for energy, water and greenhouse gas data collection and validation. Act as the company’s primary internal lead for GRESB assessments and ESG evaluations, coordinating cross-functional teams and managing relationships with specialized ESG Consultants throughout the assessment and submission process. Collaborate with Finance and Asset Management to ensure the accuracy, completeness and quality of sustainability reporting and stakeholder disclosures. Recommend improvements to energy management policies and standards.


Administration and Reporting

Oversee utility budgets, forecasts, benchmarking and reporting on energy consumption, costs, emissions and project savings. Manage incentive applications, energy-related contracts and records, ensuring accurate and timely regulatory reporting. Provide leadership to the Project Manager, Energy Management, establishing priorities, performance objectives and development plans. Complete performance reviews, provide salary and bonus recommendations, and coordinate training to support effective energy management practices across the portfolio. Complete other duties as assigned.


Risk Management

Monitor applicable energy reporting requirements, building standards and technical safety obligations, ensuring energy initiatives are coordinated with the appropriate internal teams and qualified service providers. Identify project, financial and operational risks and incorporate mitigation measures into planning and execution. Ensure proposed energy measures consider equipment condition, maintenance requirements, service continuity and the long-term performance of the assets.


Requirements

  • A passion for excellence in customer service delivery;
  • Post-Secondary degree or diploma in engineering, energy management, building science, sustainability, mechanical or electrical technology, or a related field; an equivalent combination of relevant technical training and experience will be considered;
  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in energy management, building performance or technical services, including experience leading programs, projects and teams;
  • Experience managing energy initiatives across a multi-building portfolio; multi-residential or national real estate portfolio experience considered an asset;
  • Prior hands-on experience managing GRESB assessments and ESG evaluations for Canadian REITs or institutional real estate portfolios, including coordinating internal teams and working directly with specialized ESG Consultants throughout the assessment and submission process;
  • Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, building automation systems, utility metering and energy efficiency measures;
  • Demonstrated experience with energy audits, utility benchmarking, measurement and verification, and identifying and delivering measurable savings;
  • Experience developing capital business cases, managing budgets, negotiating service contracts and overseeing project delivery;
  • Knowledge of decarbonization planning, greenhouse gas accounting and applicable utility incentive programs;
  • Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) or a related professional designation considered an asset;
  • Familiarity with energy management and sustainability frameworks such as ISO 50001 and GRESB considered an asset;
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present technical and financial information to varied audiences;
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop direct reports;
  • Strong command of MS Office products, particularly Excel, and experience with energy monitoring and reporting tools;
  • Detail-oriented; able to resolve problems using facts, sound reasoning and common sense;
  • Forward thinking with an ability to develop practical strategic solutions and effectively resolve difficult issues in a timely manner; and
  • Experience with Yardi property management systems, Wyse Synergy and Smartsheet considered an asset.


Centurion is an inclusive and equal opportunity Employer committed to creating a positive, supportive and inclusive environment for all Employees. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA), the Ontario Human Rights Code and all other applicable provincial rules and regulations, Centurion will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, as requested. description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: National Account Agency Activation Coordinator

Location: Colombia

Workplace Type: Remote

This role is employed through RemoFirst, Porch Group's Employer of Record partner in Colombia. Your employment will be legally administered through RemoFirst, while your day-to-day work is led by Porch Group.

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love you to be a part of it as a National Account Agency Activation Coordinator


The Agency Activation Coordinator is a high-volume, outbound-focused role dedicated to re-engaging dormant and low-producing branches of National Accounts in HOA/Porch's book of business.


This role sits apart from relationship management functions that focus on high-producing or newly graduated agents — its sole mandate is reawakening activity among agents who have gone quiet or never ramped up. Success depends on volume, persistence, and creative, agent-specific outreach.

What You Will Do As A National Account Agency Activation Coordinator

  • Place a high volume of daily outbound calls to dormant and low-producing agents, following defined dialing and productivity targets.
  • Identify and prioritize dormant and low-producing agents from assigned lists/segments based on prior production history and reactivation potential.
  • Re-introduce agents to current products, incentives, campaigns, and support resources that may re-ignite their interest in writing business.
  • Uncover the reasons behind an agent's drop-off or stagnation (e.g., service issues, competing carrier relationships, lack of awareness) and document findings for follow-up or escalation.
  • Execute structured, repeatable outreach cadences/scripts while adapting tone and approach to the individual agent.
  • Lead agent webinars for large groups covering product updates and announcements, with follow-up calls to attendees to drive activation.
  • Log every call attempt, outcome, and agent response accurately and promptly in the CRM/dialer platform.
  • Meet or exceed daily/weekly KPIs for call volume, contact rate, and successful reactivations (e.g., first quote or bound policy after outreach).
  • Escalate agents who show renewed production momentum to the appropriate Agency Relationship Manager or Agency Development and Success Specialist for deeper relationship management.
  • Escalate agents with service, appointment, or compliance issues to the appropriate internal team.
  • Provide feedback to leadership on recurring objections, trends, or barriers observed across dormant/low-producing agent segments to help refine reactivation strategy and messaging.

What You Will Bring As A National Account Agency Activation Coordinator

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree a plus but not required.
  • Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance license preferred but not required
  • 1+ years of experience in high-volume outbound calling, telesales, collections, or a similar dial-heavy environment; insurance or financial services experience a plus but not required.
  • Demonstrated resilience and comfort with high call volumes, overcoming objections and apathy, and repetitive outreach cadences.
  • Strong verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to build quick rapport over the phone.
  • Comfort using CRM, dialer, or call-center software; ability to accurately log activity in real time.
  • Creative, persistent approach to outreach — willing to try multiple angles/channels to re-engage a non-responsive contact.
  • Basic understanding of, or willingness to learn, independent-agent insurance distribution and how agents produce business.
  • Ability to work assigned shift hours aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • Experience working with global and/or US based business teams
  • Workspace: A quiet space to work, an internet connection of at least 30 Mbps download | 10 Mbps upload

What You Will Get Supporting Porch Group

description:

We’ve earned numerous accolades, including Top Overall Administrator, along with #1 rankings for providing alternative asset services in Accounting, Technology, Client Service, Investor Services, Alternative Fund Expertise, Reporting, and Regulatory Expertise.

Department Overview

The AI Engineering team develops secure, reliable, and reusable artificial intelligence capabilities for HEDGESERV’s business and technology platforms. The team works across application development, cloud engineering, automation, integration, security, data, and operational teams to move AI solutions from experimentation into controlled production use.


Our focus is on building enterprise AI systems that integrate with existing workflows, data, and platforms rather than operating as isolated tools. We emphasize measurable business outcomes, production engineering discipline, responsible AI practices, strong security controls, human oversight, and evidence-based evaluation.


About the Role

We are seeking an AI-focused Full Stack Developer to design and build end-to-end applications that use generative AI models and agentic architectures to solve real-world business challenges across multiple domains.


The successful candidate has experience building, deploying, and supporting production applications and can balance hands-on development with high-level design decisions. This role offers the opportunity to apply technical expertise to deliver meaningful business outcomes while continuing to grow professionally.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design AI-powered workflows and efficient data models that address real business challenges.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and services to embed AI capabilities into existing business applications.
  • Identify and implement innovative uses of AI that reduce friction across business processes.
  • Partner closely with product owners and end users to translate insights quickly into product improvements.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across engineering teams.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and performance of the systems and workflows you build.
  • Develop and maintain code that meets established quality, testing, and development standards.
  • Develop both frontend and backend features.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • At least four years of experience building and delivering production applications.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, programming concepts, and application architecture.
  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, including frequent and regular production deployments.
  • Proficiency in Python or TypeScript.
  • Experience with frontend JavaScript frameworks, particularly Angular.
  • Working knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, including experience handling large datasets.
  • Experience writing tests (unit, integration, and acceptance testing).
  • Experience working in a Scrum or Agile environment, using tools such as Jira and Git, and working with CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with microservices architectures and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with session and cache management.
  • Experience with cloud technologies, preferably AWS.
  • Knowledge of authentication and authorization standards, including OAuth and JWT.
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A), and Agent Communication Protocol (ACP).

Equal Opportunity

We are committed to providing a workplace where employees and applicants are treated fairly, consistently, and with dignity and respect, without discrimination on any characteristic protected by applicable law. title: Client Change Management Specialist, Officer
description:
Job Description

Who we are looking for

As a Client Change Junior Specialist, Officer, you will coordinate the production change lifecycle for Alpha Operations clients.

You will serve as a key contact for our clients across key change initiatives, ensuring clear and timely communication within established SLAs.

You will contribute to the development and implementation of change management strategies, processes, and workflows, using JIRA, Appian, Power BI, MYSS, and other tools, aligned with Global Delivery Change Management guidelines, including monthly progress reporting, KPIs (Key Performance Indicators), and dashboards.


What you will be responsible for

  • Provide support to our clients to successfully navigate change initiatives through our complex cross-functional business and technology teams, ensuring alignment with client expectations and delivering an excellent change management experience.

  • Collaborate with clients and internal cross-functional teams to understand business needs, requirements, and objectives related to proposed changes, as well as assess document impact.

  • Assist in the development and management of detailed project plans and timelines for change initiatives, coordinating activities across internal teams and stakeholders. Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, GCD (Global Clients Division), Alpha and CRD (Charles River Development) Product teams, technical teams, and third-party vendors.

  • Identify and mitigate any risks, regulatory or compliance issues associated with proposed changes, ensuring minimal disruption to client operations and services, following applicable State street guidelines.

  • Coordinate and conduct thorough testing and quality assurance activities to validate the successful implementation of changes and ensure alignment with client expectations and internal SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) requirements.

  • Provide training and support to clients and internal teams as needed to facilitate the adoption of changes, new processes, and SOPs.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of change requests, project plans, costs, key volume and productivity metrics, timelines, and implementation activities for future reference and auditing purposes.

  • Leverage technology, including AI, to evaluate the effectiveness of change management processes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization to enhance client satisfaction and operational efficiency.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent client service skills; a customer-centric mindset and a commitment to delivering high-quality service, support, and change management.

  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, including the ability to interpret complex business problems and solutions in a simplified manner for stakeholders at all levels.

  • Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills to navigate organizational structures and manage change effectively.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic global environment, managing multiple priorities and SLA deadlines effectively.

  • Good time management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively, meet deadlines, maintain a structured workflow, coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, allocate resources efficiently, and adapt to changing priorities with ease.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the full Alpha Front to Back product and service catalogue, SDLC methodology, and industry best practices in change management.

  • A bachelor’s degree in business or finance, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, is required. PMP or Change Management certification is a plus.

  • At least 5 years of financial services experience in front-, middle-, and/or back-office functions is required. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in at least two of the three service areas.

  • Strong knowledge of existing State Street organizational structures and teams is required, in addition to deep business acumen across middle- and back-office systems, functions, and services supported at State Street. Expertise in Alpha Middle Office Services is preferred, whether operational, product-based, or implementation-focused. A strong understanding of investment management principles, financial markets, and institutional client needs and preferences is also required.

  • Expertise in Microsoft Office, including Visio, Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint. Experience with JIRA and/or other demand or change management tools.
